responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: toutes les allocations et primes de politique familiale seront réservées, exclusivement, aux familles dont au moins l’un des deux parents est Français. Cette mesure permettra des économies substantielles, qui seront notamment consacrées à la revalorisation des aides dont bénéficient les nationaux.
responses.translated_justification: All family allowances and bonuses will be reserved exclusively for families in which at least one of the two parents is French. This measure will result in significant savings, which will notably be used to boost the aids that benefit nationals.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: La réforme de l’assurance-chômage est une escroquerie qui n’a qu’un seul but : faire les poches des Français pour renflouer les comptes de l’État.
responses.translated_justification: The unemployment insurance reform is a swindle whose only purpose is to pick the pockets of the French in order to bail out the State's accounts.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: Marine Le Pen a redit mardi vouloir rembourser la dette notamment de la crise sanitaire, mais sans austérité budgétaire et sans toucher aux retraites ni aux impôts, misant sur des "investissements d'avenir" pour doper la croissance.
responses.translated_justification: Marine Le Pen reiterated on Tuesday that she wants to pay off the debt, including that of the health crisis, but without budgetary austerity and without touching pensions or taxes, betting on 'investments for the future' to boost growth.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: Supprimer l'IFI qui taxe l'enracinement et créer un impot sur la fortune financiere., pour taxer la speculation.  Exonérer d’impôt sur le revenu tous les jeunes actifs jusqu’à 30 ans
responses.translated_justification: Eliminate the IFI (Wealth Solidarity Tax) that taxes rooting and create a tax on financial wealth, in order to tax speculation. Exempt all young active people from income tax up to 30 years old.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: Refuser tout allongement de l’âge de départ à la retraite.
responses.translated_justification: Refuse any extension of the retirement age.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification: BAISSER LA TVA DE 20% À 5.5% SUR LES PRODUITS ÉNERGÉTIQUES (CARBURANTS, FIOUL, GAZ ET ÉLECTRICITÉ) EN TANT QUE BIENS DE PREMIÈRE NÉCESSITÉ.
responses.translated_justification: LOWER THE VAT FROM 20% TO 5.5% ON ENERGY PRODUCTS (FUEL, DIESEL, GAS AND ELECTRICITY) AS ESSENTIAL GOODS.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: Je ne retirerai aucun droit aux Français. Le mariage pour tous est et restera un acquis si je suis élue Présidente de la République. / Créer une union civile (PACS amélioré) qui viendra remplacer les dispositions de la loi Taubira, sans effet rétroactif.
responses.translated_justification: I will not take away any rights from the French. Marriage for all is and will remain a right if I am elected President of the Republic. / Create a civil union (improved PACS) that will replace the provisions of the Taubira law, without retroactive effect.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: "Légaliser le cannabis c'est envoyer un signal dramatique en termes de banalisation de la consommation de ce genre de produits", "Au RN, "nous y sommes opposés."
responses.translated_justification: Legalizing cannabis means sending a dramatic signal in terms of trivialization of the consumption of this type of products," "In the National Rally, 'we are opposed to it.'
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: Supprimer le droit du sol et limiter l’accès à la nationalité à la seule naturalisation sur des critères de mérite et d’assimilation. [...] L’attribution d’un titre de séjour à un étranger est subordonnée à la volonté et à l’engagement du demandeur de s’assimiler à la société française. Les étrangers admis au séjour sur le territoire doivent respecter le mode de vie des Français et agir pour s’assimiler à la culture française.
responses.translated_justification: Eliminate the right of the soil and limit access to nationality to mere naturalization based on merit and assimilation criteria. [...] The granting of a residence permit to a foreigner is subject to the will and commitment of the applicant to assimilate to French society. Foreigners admitted to stay on the territory must respect the way of life of the French and act to assimilate to French culture.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: Ainsi Marine Le Pen propose de monter au niveau constitutionnel les dispositions actuelles sur l’avortement inscrites dans le code de santé publique.
responses.translated_justification: Therefore, Marine Le Pen proposes to elevate to a constitutional level the current provisions on abortion currently enscribed in the public health code.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: Mettre fin à l’immigration de peuplement et au regroupement familial. Supprimer l’autorisation de séjour pour tout étranger n’ayant pas travaillé depuis un an en France. Expulser systématiquement les clandestins, délinquants et criminels étrangers. Supprimer le droit du sol et limiter l’accès à la nationalité à la seule naturalisation sur des critères de mérite et d’assimilation.
responses.translated_justification: Put an end to settlement immigration and family reunification. Revoke the residence permit for any foreigner who has not worked in France for a year. Systematically expel illegal immigrants, delinquents, and foreign criminals. Abolish the right of soil and limit access to nationality to naturalization based on merit and assimilation criteria.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: C’est vrai que cette loi pour la parité, j’étais contre, je le dis très clairement. J’avoue qu’à l’usage, incontestablement cette loi a permis à des femmes d’émerger, reconnaît Marine Le Pen. Dans mon propre mouvement, parfois, c’est un peu de force qu’on a poussé les femmes à se présenter, elles ont pris confiance en elles et j’en suis ravie.
responses.translated_justification: It's true that I was against this parity law, I say it very clearly. I admit that in practice, undeniably, this law has allowed women to emerge, recognizes Marine Le Pen. In my own movement, sometimes, it was with a bit of force that we encouraged women to present themselves, they gained confidence and I am delighted.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: RENATIONALISER LES AUTOROUTES POUR BAISSER DE 15% LES PÉAGES.
responses.translated_justification: RENATIONALISE THE HIGHWAYS TO LOWER TOLLS BY 15%.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification: Arrêter les projets éoliens et démanteler progressivement les parcs existants.
responses.translated_justification: Stop wind energy projects and progressively dismantle existing parks.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: Pour l’avenir, le principe de la mutualisation de dettes qui est béatement et unilatéralement acté par M. Macron, ouvre la voie à un impôt européen pour rembourser la dette commune. Cette décision n’est pas seulement contraire à tous les traités européens, elle est, pour les Français, un déni de démocratie manifeste et inacceptable.
responses.translated_justification: For the future, the principle of the pooling of debts, which is blindly and unilaterally endorsed by Mr. Macron, paves the way for a European tax to repay the common debt. This decision is not only contrary to all European treaties, but it is also, for the French, a blatant and unacceptable denial of democracy.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: un responsable politique fait l’éloge de l’intelligence artificielle (IA), balaye « les prophéties les plus sombres » et, condamnant l’excès de régulation, dit l’urgence d’une politique publique européenne en la matière.
responses.translated_justification: A political leader praises artificial intelligence (AI), dismisses 'the darkest prophecies' and, condemning over-regulation, states the urgency of a European public policy in this area.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: Rétablissement d’une monnaie nationale adaptée à notre économie, levier de notre compétitivité / Marine Le Pen souligne que l’abandon de l’euro n’est « plus une priorité ».
responses.translated_justification: Restoration of a national currency adapted to our economy, a lever of our competitiveness / Marine Le Pen emphasizes that abandoning the euro is 'no longer a priority'.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: Ces abus, trop souvent tolérés par les accords commerciaux négociés par l’Union européenne, créent une concurrence déloyale qui ruine des filières entières en imposant des prix trop bas et nuisent à la santé de la population. Les baisses de production induites par ces règles environnementales pourraient provoquer jusqu’à 20% d’augmentation des importations issues des pays non-membres de l’UE. Les aides européennes seront complétées par des dispositifs nationaux.
responses.translated_justification: These abuses, tolerated too often by the trade agreements negotiated by the European Union, create unfair competition which ruins entire sectors by imposing excessively low prices and harms the health of the population. The production decreases caused by these environmental rules could result in up to a 20% increase in imports from non-EU countries. European aid will be supplemented by national measures.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: La diplomatie et la défense sont les attributs de la souveraineté des États.
responses.translated_justification: Diplomacy and defense are attributes of state sovereignty.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Traiter les demandes de droit d’asile uniquement à l’étranger. / Au RN, nous sommes les seuls à avoir clairement rejeté ce Pacte migratoire, qui prévoit la répartition obligatoire des migrants dans nos communes.
responses.translated_justification: Processing asylum requests only abroad. / In the National Rally, we are the only ones to have clearly rejected this Migration Pact, which provides for the mandatory distribution of migrants in our communities.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: La diplomatie et la défense européennes sont une chimère dangereuse. [...] Ce que nous voyons, c'est l'impossibilité d'agir au niveau européen dans le domaine de la défense, et l'Europe n'a même pas été capable de livrer les munitions qu'elle avait promises à l'Ukraine pour sa défense. [...] Ne risquons pas des chimères avec des histoires d'armée de défense (européenne).
responses.translated_justification: European defense and diplomacy are a dangerous chimera. [...] What we see is the impossibility of acting at the European level in the defense field, and Europe hasn't even been able to deliver the ammunition it promised to Ukraine for its defense. [...] Let's not take risks with tales of a European defense army.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: La maîtrise des frontières est une condition indispensable au rétablissement de la sécurité et à la préservation de notre souveraineté. Les graves défaillances dans ce domaine des mécanismes instaurés par l’Union européenne imposent de rétablir une surveillance et un contrôle permanent de nos frontières.
responses.translated_justification: Border control is an indispensable condition for the restoration of security and the preservation of our sovereignty. The serious failures in the mechanisms established by the European Union in this field require the reestablishment of permanent surveillance and control of our borders.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Le Parlement européen a récemment voté la fin des ventes de véhicules thermiques neufs à partir de 2035. [...] Les députés européens du Rassemblement national se sont catégoriquement opposés à cette mesure dogmatique, comme ils se sont toujours opposés à toutes les formes d'écologie punitive.
responses.translated_justification: The European Parliament recently voted to end the sales of new fossil fuel vehicles as of 2035. [...] The Members of the European Parliament from the Rassemblement National have categorically opposed this dogmatic measure, as they have always opposed all forms of punitive ecology.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: Le rôle de la France est d'apporter un soutien logistique et défensif à l'Ukraine [...] un soutien au niveau des munitions et de l'envoi d'artillerie défensive.
responses.translated_justification: France's role is to provide logistical and defensive support to Ukraine [...] support in terms of munitions and the sending of defensive artillery.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: [On whether France in the EU is a good thing or not] Oui, c'est une bonne chose, à condition que la France défende ses intérêts [...] Je suis le candidat d'une Europe des nations, d'une Europe des réalités
responses.translated_justification: [On whether France in the EU is a good thing or not] Yes, it is a good thing, as long as France defends its interests [...] I am the candidate of a Europe of nations, a Europe of realities.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: La proposition du ministre allemand des Affaires étrangères de supprimer le droit de veto de chaque pays membre de l'UE est profondément inquiétante.
responses.translated_justification: The proposal of the German Foreign Minister to abolish the right of veto of each EU member country is deeply worrying.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.justification: Toute forme d’élargissement pourrait accroître le risque d’escalade
responses.translated_justification: Any form of enlargement could increase the risk of escalation.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.justification: il est en revanche indispensable de faire en sorte que la Constitution française prévale sur le droit international. / "En affirmant la primauté de son droit constitutionnel sur la législation européenne, la Pologne exerce son droit légitime et inaliénable à la souveraineté"
responses.translated_justification: However, it is essential to ensure that French Constitution takes precedence over international law. / By asserting the primacy of its domestic legislation over European law, Poland is exercising its legitimate and inalienable right to sovereignty.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: PORTER LE BUDGET DE LA DÉFENSE À 55 MILLIARDS D’EUROS À L’HORIZON 2027.
responses.translated_justification: BRING THE DEFENSE BUDGET TO 55 BILLION EUROS BY 2027.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: « Rembourser à 100 % les soins prescrits par la sécurité sociale en intégrant les mutuelles à l’assurance maladie (…) En investissant massivement dans les secteurs d’avenir, en partageant le travail et en garantissant un emploi aux chômeurs de longue durée, nous retrouverons enfin le plein emploi. »
responses.translated_justification: « Reimburse 100% of the healthcare prescribed by social security by integrating mutual insurance companies into healthcare insurance (...) By heavily investing in sectors of the future, sharing work, and guaranteeing employment to long-term unemployed individuals, we will finally regain full employment. »
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: « Supprimer la réforme de l’assurance chômage de Macron qui diminue les allocations d’une grande partie des chômeurs. Indemniser les chômeurs dès le premier jour de la fin du contrat »
responses.translated_justification: « Eliminate Macron's unemployment insurance reform that reduces the allocations of a large portion of unemployed individuals. Compensate the unemployed from the first day of the end of the contract. »
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: « Le Gouvernement nous entraîne ainsi dans une spirale infernale : baisse des dépenses en supprimant des emplois dans les services publics et en s’attaquant aux plus pauvres ce qui entraînera mécaniquement une baisse de recettes et de nouvelles annonces d’économies tout en refusant de toucher aux cadeaux faits aux plus riches et aux plus grandes entreprises depuis des années… Il faut y mettre fin, voici nos 10 mesures d’urgence. Les seules dépenses à réduire sont celles en faveur des plus riches.
responses.translated_justification: « The Government is leading us into a vicious cycle: a decrease in spending by eliminating jobs in public services and targeting the most vulnerable, which will inevitably lead to a decrease in revenue and new announcements of savings, all while refusing to touch the gifts given to the wealthiest individuals and the largest corporations in recent years... This must come to an end, here are our 10 emergency measures. The only expenses that need to be reduced are those in favor of the wealthiest. »
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: « Rétablir et renforcer l’ISF (Impôt de solidarité sur la fortune) »
responses.translated_justification: « Restore and strengthen the Wealth Solidarity Tax (Impôt de solidarité sur la fortune) »
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: « Le contre-projet de réforme des retraites de La France insoumise inclut le départ dès 60 ans, aucune retraite inférieure au seuil de pauvreté, et pour une carrière complète, aucune retraite inférieure au SMIC, une extension de la reconnaissance de la pénibilité, l’intégration des trimestres au RSA dans le calcul de la retraite, ou encore la suppression de la double peine de la décote. »
responses.translated_justification: The counter-proposal for pension reform by La France insoumise includes the ability to retire at 60 years old, no retirement below the poverty threshold, and for a full career, no retirement below the SMIC, an extension of recognition of hardship, integration of RSA quarters into the retirement calculation, and the elimination of the double penalty of the discount.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification: « Nos solutions : (a) Augmenter le SMIC et les minimas sociaux (b) Bloquer les prix à la baisse sur les produits alimentaires, l’énergie et le carburant (c) Indexer les salaires sur la hausse des prix (d) Geler les loyers »
responses.translated_justification: « Our solutions: (a) Increase the minimum wage and social minima (b) Cap the prices of food products, energy, and fuel (c) Link salaries to the rise of prices (d) Freeze rent prices »
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: « Si les droits des lesbiennes et des gays ont connu une progression réelle avec la loi ouvrant le mariage aux couples de même sexe en 2013, puis l’ouverture de la PMA aux femmes lesbiennes et célibataires en 2021, l’égalité entière des droits reste à conquérir. »
responses.translated_justification: Although the rights of lesbians and gays have made significant progress with the law allowing marriage for same-sex couples in 2013 and the opening of medically assisted procreation (MAP) to lesbian and single women in 2021, full equality of rights still needs to be achieved.'
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: « Portée par nos député·es Eric Coquerel et Danièle Obono, nous proposons un texte visant à organiser la légalisation sous contrôle de l’Etat, de la production, la vente et la consommation de cannabis.  Nous traduisons ainsi simplement dans la loi une proposition de bon sens prévue par l’Avenir en commun : légaliser et encadrer par un monopole d’Etat la consommation, la production et la vente de cannabis à des fins récréatives dans des conditions permettant de lutter contre l’addiction. »
responses.translated_justification: Carried forward by our deputies Eric Coquerel and Danièle Obono, we propose a text aimed at organizing the legalization under state control, of the production, sale and consumption of cannabis. We thus simply translate into law a proposal of common sense provided by The Future in Common: to legalize and regulate by a state monopoly the consumption, production and sale of cannabis for recreational purposes under conditions that allow to fight against addiction.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: « L’accueil fonde notre identité républicaine. Ainsi, le peuple français est le résultat d’intégrations successives et notre pays s’est continuellement enrichi de ces apports extérieurs. Notre mission collective est de respecter la dignité humaine des migrant·es et leur droit fondamental à une vie de famille. Les refuser, c’est être étranger aux principes de la patrie républicaine. »
responses.translated_justification: Welcoming is the foundation of our republican identity. As such, the French people are the result of successive integrations and our country has continually enriched itself from external contributions. Our collective mission is to respect the human dignity of migrants and their fundamental right to a family life. To refuse to do so is to be a stranger to the principles of the republican fatherland.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: « L’Assemblée nationale va étudier le projet de loi visant à inscrire dans la Constitution un nouvel article garantissant le recours à l’interruption volontaire de grossesse (IVG). L’inscription de l’IVG dans la constitution est demandée depuis des années par les associations féministes. Depuis sa création, la France insoumise porte cette mesure dans son programme. »
responses.translated_justification: « The National Assembly will examine the bill project aiming to enshrine in the Constitution a new article guaranteeing the use of voluntary interruption of pregnancy (VGP). The inscription of VGP in the constitution has been requested for years by feminist associations. Since its creation, France Insoumise has supported this measure in its program. »
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: « L’accueil fonde notre identité républicaine. Ainsi, le peuple français est le résultat d’intégrations successives et notre pays s’est continuellement enrichi de ces apports extérieurs. Notre mission collective est de respecter la dignité humaine des migrant·es et leur droit fondamental à une vie de famille. Les refuser, c’est être étranger aux principes de la patrie républicaine. »
responses.translated_justification: « Welcoming is what underpins our Republican identity. Consequently, the French people is the result of successive integrations, and our country has continually enriched itself from external contributions. Our collective mission is to respect the human dignity of migrants and their fundamental right to a family life. To refuse them is to be a stranger to the principles of the Republic. »
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: On these quotas: « Mathilde Panot (Val-de-Marne, La France insoumise, LFI), qui aurait préféré un texte « plus ambitieux »
responses.translated_justification: On these quotas: 'Mathilde Panot (Val-de-Marne, La France insoumise, LFI), who would have preferred a'more ambitious' text
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: « Transports : prioriser les modes de transport en fonction de la quantité de CO2 émise par kilomètre et par personnes transportées »
responses.translated_justification: Transport: prioritize modes of transportation based on the quantity of CO2 emitted per kilometer and per number of people transported.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification: « Des scénarios démontrent qu’une production de 100 % d’énergies renouvelables à l’horizon 2050 est possible. C’est le cas du scénario Négawatt pour l’ensemble du secteur énergétique et dans un système totalement indépendant, c’est-à-dire sans échange avec les autres pays. L’ADEME (Agence de l’Environnement et de la Maîtrise de l’Énergie) propose également un mix 100 % renouvelable pour le sec- teur électrique à horizon 2050. Ces solutions menant à une véritable transition énergétique peuvent ainsi être déployées rapidement, à l’échelle d’une génération, et à grande échelle, dès lors qu’elles sont portées par une détermination politique. »
responses.translated_justification: Scenarios demonstrate that 100% renewable energy production by 2050 is possible. This is the case of the Négawatt scenario for the entire energy sector and in a completely independent system, i.e., without exchanges with other countries. The ADEME (French Agency for the Environment and Energy Management) also proposes a 100% renewable mix for the electric sector by 2050. These solutions leading to a true energy transition can thus be rapidly implemented, on the scale of a generation, and on a large scale, as long as they are supported by political determination.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: « nous bloquerons la contribution française au budget européen tant que l’Union euro- péenne continuera de promouvoir une politique d’inégalités (concurrence dé- loyale, travail détaché, délocalisations in- ternes, inégalités des règles écologiques, etc.) et tant que les règles de déficit public et les rabais ne sont pas revus. D’ailleurs, la France désobéit déjà à certaines règles européennes par exemple sur la qualité de l’air ! Il est donc possible de choisir de désobéir dès à présent. C’est une question de volonté politique. »
responses.translated_justification: « We will block the French contribution to the European budget as long as the European Union continues to promote an inequality policy (unfair competition, detached work, internal relocations, inequalities in environmental rules, etc.) and as long as the public deficit rules and rebates are not reviewed. By the way, France is already disobeying certain European rules, for example, on air quality! It is therefore possible to choose to disobey now. It is a question of political will. »
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: « Mme Sabine Rubin. Afin de lever toute ambiguïté, je tiens à réaffirmer, au nom du groupe La France insoumise, que la crise pandémique que traverse l’Europe exige une réponse concertée de la part des différents pays de l’Union européenne. Un plan de relance à cette échelle n’est pas simplement souhaitable : c’est une nécessité. Cependant je dois aussi confier nos doutes quant aux modalités de financement de ce plan de relance. Celui-ci serait gagé sur un emprunt remboursable à l’horizon de 2058 – très bien, mais avec quelles ressources ? Nous y voyons un manque d’ambition plutôt qu’une avancée majeure. En vérité, la seule chose qui a avancé, c’est une taxe sur le plastique, qui fait consensus. Pour le reste, il s’agit tout simplement d’augmenter les contributions des États membres. Il s’agit certes de ressources propres, mais il faut alors que cet effort soit équitablement réparti. Comment ne pas s’interroger sur les rabais accordés à tel ou tel pays ? L’idéal européen se heurte à l’égoïsme financier, comme l’a montré le récent exemple britannique. D’autres solutions existent. La taxe sur les GAFA – Google, Apple, Facebook, Amazon –, c’est l’Arlésienne, sans cesse repoussée ou minorée. Pourtant, ce serait une manière plus juste de financer ce plan de relance. Il en va de même pour l’instauration d’une forte taxe sur les transactions financières, évoquée depuis des dizaines d’années, ici et au Parlement européen, mais qui ne verra pas le jour avant 2026 – et encore : on en parle au conditionnel. Seule demeure l’austérité : elle conditionne l’obtention par certains États de subventions européennes, et qui ne sont accordées qu’au prix d’ajustements structurels. Non, ce n’est pas une avancée majeure : il y a certes des petits pas, mais ils sont trop petits au regard de la nécessité d’un plan européen. »
responses.translated_justification: « Mrs. Sabine Rubin. In order to clarify any ambiguity, I would like to reaffirm, on behalf of the La France insoumise group, that the pandemic crisis that Europe is going through requires a concerted response from the different countries of the European Union. A recovery plan at this scale is not only desirable: it is a necessity. However, I must also express our doubts about the funding modalities of this recovery plan. It would be secured by a loan to be repaid in 2058 - very well, but with which resources? We see a lack of ambition rather than a major advance. In truth, the only thing that has advanced is a tax on plastic, which has consensus. For the rest, it is simply about increasing the contributions of the member states. It is indeed their own resources, but then this effort must be equitably distributed. How not to question the discounts granted to one country or another? The European ideal collides with financial selfishness, as shown by the recent British example. Other solutions exist. The tax on GAFA (Google, Apple, Facebook, Amazon), it is the Arlésienne, constantly postponed or reduced. Yet, this would be
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: « Moins apocalyptique, quoique fort inquiétant : la possibilité de propager de fausses informations à l’aide de photos et vidéos créées de toutes pièces par des IA, presque impossibles à distinguer des vraies. Dans un contexte d’uniformisation des contenus sur les réseaux sociaux et les plateformes de streaming via les algorithmes, ce genre d’innovation nuira non seulement à la manifestation de la vérité, mais aussi à la culture et sa diversité – et donc à la civilisation. »
responses.translated_justification: « Less apocalyptic, but nonetheless very worrying: the possibility of spreading false information using photos and videos created from scratch by AI, which are almost impossible to distinguish from real ones. In a context of uniformization of content on social networks and streaming platforms through algorithms, this kind of innovation will not only harm the manifestation of truth, but also culture and its diversity – and therefore civilization.»
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: « L’euro doit être transformé pour servir l’emploi et la transition écologique et la BCE doit rendre des comptes à une instance démocratique. »
responses.translated_justification: The euro must be transformed to serve employment and the ecological transition and the ECB must report to a democratic instance.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: « Prix planchers pour les agriculteurs : LFI va redéposer sa proposition de loi (…) Le constat est connu : la masse des agriculteurs souffre de revenus indécemment bas, de dettes permanentes et qui s’alourdissent, le tout conduisant à un suicide d’agriculteur tous les deux jours. Une situation due à l’absence de régulation des prix et à la concurrence déloyale organisée par les traités de libre-échange votés main dans la main par les députés macronistes et du RN au Parlement européen. »
responses.translated_justification: « Floor prices for farmers: LFI will re-submit its legislative proposal (...) The diagnosis is well-known: the mass of farmers suffer from indecently low revenues, permanent and increasing debts, all leading to a farmer's suicide every two days. A situation due to the absence of price regulation and to the unfair competition organized by the free-trade agreements voted hand-in-hand by the Macronist and RN deputies at the European Parliament.»
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: « Mettre en œuvre un accueil digne des migrant·es avec une répartition sur l’ensemble du territoire européen mettant fin à l’approche hotspots »
responses.translated_justification: « Implementing a dignified welcome for migrants with a distribution across the entire European territory, putting an end to the hotspots approach »
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: « La souveraineté appartenant au peuple, la politique de défense – un des éléments centraux, sinon le plus central, de la souveraineté – ne peut relever de l’Union européenne. En effet, il n’existe pas un peuple européen mais des peuples européens, pas de Nation européenne mais des nations ayant chacune leur politique étrangère et de défense. L’idée d’« Europe de la défense » a donc des implications anti-démocratiques très claires. »
responses.translated_justification: « Sovereignty belonging to the people, defense policy - one of the central elements, if not the most central, of sovereignty - cannot fall under the European Union. Indeed, there is no European people but European peoples, no European Nation but nations each having their own foreign and defense policy. The idea of a 'Europe of defense' therefore has very clear anti-democratic implications. »
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: (LFI is aligned with the Greens on this) « “In Brussels, the majority of member states and MEPs from the centre and the right are defending the use of European funds to build walls and barriers on the external borders of the EU”, the Green party members said in the op-ed, adding that the same philosophy infuses the French debate. Instead, left-wing parties “call on MPs and ministers to clarify their position and reaffirm their commitment to a Europe that is fair, inclusive and respectful of human rights” »
responses.translated_justification: (LFI is aligned with the Greens on this) "‘In Brussels, the majority of member states and MEPs from the center and the right are defending the use of European funds to build walls and barriers on the external borders of the EU,’ said Green party members in an op-ed, adding that the same philosophy underlies the French debate. Meanwhile, left-wing parties urge MPs and ministers to 'clarify their position and reaffirm their commitment to a Europe that is fair, inclusive, and respectful of human rights’.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: "On a une échelle de dix ans pour que les voitures qui restent en circulation en France soient des voitures électriques."
responses.translated_justification: We have a ten-year timeframe for the cars still in circulation in France to be electric cars.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: LFI’s leader share the idea that Ukraine should be given the means to defend itself against « unacceptable Russian agression ».
responses.translated_justification: The leader of LFI shares the idea that Ukraine should be given the means to defend itself against "unacceptable Russian aggression.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: Not this Europe. « Nous devons sortir des traités européens actuels, qui alimentent le dumping social etfiscaletnousforcentàmenerdespo- litiques d’austérité, à anéantir nos États et ses investissements publics. Notre in- dépendance ne doit plus être sacrifiée aux obsessions idéologiques de la Com- mission européenne qui empêchent de mener des politiques de progrès social. Cette Union a dévoré nos acquis sociaux. »
responses.translated_justification: Not this Europe. « We must exit the current European treaties, which fuel social and fiscal dumping, and force us to implement austerity policies that aim to annihilate our States and public investments. Our independence must no longer be sacrificed for the ideological obsessions of the European Commission, which prevent the implementation of progressive social policies. This Union has devoured our social achievements. »
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: « Reconnaître le droit à la désobéissance aux règles européennes lorsqu’un État estime que ses intérêts fondamentaux sont mis en cause selon les principes du compromis de Luxembourg et les exemptions accordées à certains États (opt-out) »
responses.translated_justification: « Recognize the right to disobedience to European rules when a State estimates that its fundamental interests are at stake, in accordance with the principles of the Luxembourg compromise and the exemptions granted to certain States (opt-out) »
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.justification: LFI opposes Ukraine’s integration in the EU « as long as there is no social or fiscal harmonization »
responses.translated_justification: LFI opposes Ukraine's integration into the EU 'as long as there is no social or fiscal harmonization'
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.justification: No clear mention of sanction but agrees on the principle. « L’Union européenne ne protège pas les libertés. Elle reste silencieuse devant la montée des extrêmes-droites même quand celles-ci participent à des gouvernements nationaux brutalement les politiques anti-austérité mais s’accommode des politiques contraires aux droits humains ou à l’égalité et de la présence de l’extrême-droite dans plusieurs gouvernements. (…) Ça suffit ! »
responses.translated_justification: No clear mention of sanction but agrees on the principle. "The European Union does not protect freedoms. It remains silent in the face of the rise of far-right movements, even when they participate in national governments and brutally implement anti-austerity policies, but tolerates policies contrary to human rights or equality and the presence of far-right in several governments. (...) That's enough!
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: The document is both critic vis-à-vis « inssuficient » plans from Macron’s government, but very vague about supplementary means.
responses.translated_justification: The document is both critical with regard to « insufficient » plans from Macron's government, but very vague about additional means.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

full_name: Les Écologistes – Europe Écologie Les Verts

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.translated_justification: NUPES Program, Chapter 3 - Sharing of Wealth and Fiscal Justice: - Implement a dignity guarantee that does not leave any individual below the poverty line (1063 euros per month for a single person); - Create an autonomy allowance for young people set above the poverty line (1063 euros for a single person); - Re-evaluate housing personal assistance (APL) in relation to inflation - Make fiscal revolution [...] : Make the income tax and the generalized social contribution (CSG) truly progressive with a 14-bracket scale; Restore and strengthen the solidarity tax on wealth (ISF); Re-establish and reinforce the property tax to make it progressive and so that everyone pays according to their total real estate wealth.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: "Après les réformes libérales de ces dernières années, nous reprendrons le combat pour une reconquête de la protection sociale solidaire (retraite, famille, maladie, accidents du travail, chômage, logement, etc.), pour revaloriser nos acquis sociaux et les étendre."
responses.translated_justification: After the liberal reforms of recent years, we will resume the fight for a reconquest of solidarity-based social protection (retirement, family, illness, work accidents, unemployment, housing, etc.), to revalorize our social benefits and expand them.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification:
"Dimanche, Bruno Le Maire nous a annoncé une baisse de la croissance prévue en France.
Pour “compenser”, l’État dépensera 10 milliards d’euros en moins. Pourtant, ce n’est pas d’austérité budgétaire dont nous avons besoin mais bien d’investissements supplémentaires massifs pour faire face à la crise environnementale."
Interview à France info le 19  février 2024 :
responses.translated_justification: On Sunday, Bruno Le Maire announced a decrease in the predicted growth in France. To 'compensate', the State will spend 10 billion euros less. However, what we need is not budgetary austerity, but rather massive additional investments to face the environmental crisis.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification:
"Il manque 360 milliards d'investissements publics pour atteindre la neutralité carbone en Europe. Comment financer ?
Un ISF Vert sur les 0,5% des plus riches"
responses.translated_justification: 360 billion euros of public investments are missing to reach carbon neutrality in Europe. How to finance it? A Green ISF (Wealth Tax) on the 0.5% wealthiest individuals.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.translated_justification: NUPES Program, Chapter 1 - Social progress, employment and pensions: "Restore the right to retire at 60 with full pension for all and all after forty years of contributions with particular attention to long, discontinuous careers and physically demanding jobs."
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
