Concernant les prix agricoles : "Un revenu garanti sur trois ans, condition indispensable pour permettre aux paysans et paysannes de retrouver le sens du long terme et de rompre définitivement avec un modèle qui les condamne à disparaître"
Programme
responses.translated_justification: Regarding agricultural prices: 'A guaranteed income over three years, an indispensable condition for allowing farmers and farmresses to regain a sense of the long term and break definitively with a model that condemns them to disappear' Program
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: "Chacun.e devrait pouvoir vivre au jour le jour sans subir de discriminations en raison de ses origines, de son orientation sexuelle ou encore de son identité de genre. C’est le sens du mot égalité."
responses.translated_justification: Everyone should be able to live day by day without suffering discrimination because of their origins, their sexual orientation, or their gender identity. This is the meaning of the word equality.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: "Nous proposons de légaliser et d'encadrer la consommation, la production et la vente de cannabis à des fins récréatives, en affectant les recettes des taxes sur le cannabis à la lutte contre les addictions et à de l’accompagnement vers l’emploi et la normalisation économique."
responses.translated_justification: We propose to legalize and regulate the consumption, production, and sale of cannabis for recreational purposes, affecting the revenue from cannabis taxes to fight against addictions and to provide support for employment and economic normalization.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification:
"Constitutionnaliser le droit à l’avortement et à la contraception en l’inscrivant dans la Charte européenne des droits fondamentaux. Ces droits doivent être garantis au niveau européen pour qu’ils ne puissent jamais être remis en cause dans aucun pays."
Programme
responses.translated_justification: Constitutionalize the right to abortion and contraception by inscribing it in the European Charter of Fundamental Rights. These rights must be guaranteed at the European level so that they can never be called into question in any country.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: "L'immigration peut être une chance, si on sait comment la gérer."
responses.translated_justification: Immigration can be an opportunity if it is well managed.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification:
"Veiller à ce que la politique de développement tienne compte des spécificités de genre et aborde les questions de l’égalité des sexes, de l’identité sexuelle et de la violence fondée sur le sexe."
Programme
responses.translated_justification: Ensure that the development policy takes into account gender specificities and addresses issues related to gender equality, sexual identity and gender-based violence.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification:
Les eurodéputés écologistes français ont voté contre l’extension du marché carbone (SEQE 2) pour les combustibles fossiles de chauffage et de transport, tels que l’essence, le diesel, le fioul domestique et le gaz au printemps 2023. 
Explication de vote de Marie Toussaint pour le journal Euractiv (17 avril 2023) : « Nous pensons tous que le carbone doit avoir un prix, mais nous nous opposons à l’approche qui consiste à faire payer les citoyennes et les citoyens l’inaction dont ils ne sont pas responsables ».
responses.translated_justification: French green MEPs voted against the extension of the carbon market (ETS2) for heating and transport fossil fuels, such as gasoline, diesel, heating oil, and natural gas in the spring of 2023. Explanation of the vote by Marie Toussaint for the Euractiv newspaper (April 17, 2023): "We all believe that carbon should have a price, but we oppose the approach that consists in making citizens pay for the inaction for which they are not responsible.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification:
"Pour atteindre la neutralité carbone, l’Europe doit investir massivement dans les énergies renouvelables, en soutenant les filières industrielles (éoliennes, photovoltaïque).  La Banque européenne d’investissement (BEI) doit donc véritablement devenir une Banque européenne du Climat, dotée de moyens financiers ambitieux pour faire sortir l’UE des énergies fossiles."
Dossier de presse annexé au programme :
responses.translated_justification: To achieve carbon neutrality, Europe must heavily invest in renewable energies, by supporting industrial sectors (wind, photovoltaic). The European Investment Bank (EIB) must therefore truly become a European Climate Bank, endowed with ambitious financial means to enable the EU to abandon fossil fuels.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: "The current EU budget is patently insufficient to address the challenges Europe faces. Supported by its own resources, such as EU-level fossil and wealth taxes, the EU budget should be raised significantly with an expanded role of the European Parliament and civil society in monitoring EU spending. EU competences should be expanded to ensure the EU can deliver."
responses.translated_justification: The current EU budget is clearly insufficient to address the challenges that Europe faces. By relying on its own resources, such as EU-level taxes on fossil fuels and wealth, the EU budget should be significantly increased with an expanded role for the European Parliament and civil society in monitoring EU spending. EU competences should be expanded to ensure that the EU can deliver.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: Communiqué de presse de David Corman (candidat sur la liste) : "Le développement de l'IA doit être conditionné au respect des droits fondamentaux et de notre pacte démocratique […]. Le Parlement européen est parvenu à garantir que des IA comme Chat GPT, les modèles de fondation, soient règlementés à la mesure de l'importance qu'ils prennent dans nos quotidiens. C'est une victoire face à un blocage particulièrement vigoureux de la France, qui a tout fait pour permettre à son champion Mistral IA de s'affranchir de toute règlementation."
responses.translated_justification: Press release from David Corman (candidate on the list): "The development of AI must be conditional on respecting fundamental rights and our democratic pact […]. The European Parliament has managed to ensure that IAs like Chat GPT, the foundation models, are regulated according to their importance in our daily lives. This is a victory in the face of particularly strong opposition from France, which has done everything possible to allow its champion Mistral AI to be exempt from any regulation."
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification:
"Une sortie des accords de libre-échange qui imposent une concurrence déloyale aux agriculteurs européens"
Programme
responses.translated_justification: An exit from the free trade agreements that impose unfair competition on European farmers
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: "Nous défendons un renforcement du rôle du Parlement européen dans la définition de la politique extérieure de l’UE. Toute intervention extérieure devra être soumise à l'approbation préalable du Parlement européen réuni en session exceptionnelle."
responses.translated_justification: We advocate for a strengthening of the role of the European Parliament in defining the EU's external policy. Any external intervention must be submitted for prior approval to the European Parliament, which must meet in an extraordinary session for this purpose.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification:
"Il faut contraindre les pays qui refusent d'accueillir les migrants à le faire".
"On a besoin de réformer Dublin pour garantir et contraindre les États à faire leur part".
responses.translated_justification: It is necessary to force countries that refuse to welcome migrants to do so.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: "La France et l’Europe doivent achever la mue de la défense européenne. Nous soutiendrons le renforcement de la coopération militaire au niveau de l’UE dans le strict respect du droit international et du multilatéralisme, ainsi que la création d’un commandement militaire opérationnel européen. Nous agirons pour renforcer la coopération en matière de prévention et de résolution non-violente des conflits, et pour prévenir l’insécurité et les conflits liés au changement climatique."
responses.translated_justification: France and Europe must complete the transformation of European defense. We will support the strengthening of military cooperation at the EU level, in strict respect of international law and multilateralism, as well as the creation of a European operational military command. We will act to strengthen cooperation in the field of conflict prevention and non-violent conflict resolution, and to prevent insecurity and conflicts related to climate change.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: "Frontex ne protège pas nos frontières. Elle les militarise, les rend encore plus risquées. Sans aucune efficacité, on n'empêche pas quelqu'un de partir quand il n'en a pas le choix. Avec l'ensemble des écologistes, nous voulons que l'Europe prenne la responsabilité du sauvetage en mer, la garantie des vies humaines ne peut pas reposer uniquement sur la mobilisation d'associations comme SOS Méditerranée."
responses.translated_justification: Frontex does not protect our borders. It militarizes them, making them even more dangerous. Without any effectiveness, one cannot prevent someone from leaving when they have no other choice. With all ecologists, we want Europe to take responsibility for sea rescue, the guarantee of human lives cannot rely solely on the mobilization of associations such as SOS Méditerranée.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Communiqué de presse du groupe parlementaire The Greens/EFA (28 mars 2023) : "Today, the end of the internal combustion engine is confirmed. Finally, the reckless blockade ends, along with the future of the combustion engine. The compromise, which was reached months ago, is clear: in 2035 we will definitely move on from polluting cars to zero-emission transport only. This is a good day for the future of Europe’s industrial competitiveness."
responses.translated_justification: Press release from the The Greens/EFA parliamentary group (March 28, 2023): "Today, the end of the internal combustion engine is confirmed. Finally, the reckless blockade ends, along with the future of the combustion engine. The compromise, which was reached months ago, is clear: in 2035 we will definitely move on from polluting cars to zero-emission transport only. This is a good day for the future of Europe’s industrial competitiveness."
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: "Augmenter immédiatement l’achat et l’envoi de munitions et d’armes d’origine européenne ou internationale pour soutenir l’armée ukrainienne."
responses.translated_justification: Immediately increase the purchase and shipment of ammunition and European or international origin arms to support the Ukrainian army.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: "En tant qu’Écologistes, nous avons toujours été en faveur de l’Europe et de la construction d’un espace fédéraliste. Face aux manquements et aux états d’injustices dans la construction européenne, nous croyons qu’il est nécessaire d’avoir plus d’Europe, mais surtout une Europe différente."
responses.translated_justification: As Greens, we have always been in favor of Europe and the construction of a federalist space. In view of the shortcomings and the states of injustices in the construction of Europe, we believe that it is necessary to have more Europe, but above all, a different Europe.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: "Nous redonnerons un vrai pouvoir d’action à l’UE en mettant fin au vote à l’unanimité au Conseil de l’UE dans tous les domaines où de telles clauses existent (politique sociale, fiscale, etc.)"
responses.translated_justification: We will give the EU real power of action by ending unanimity voting in the EU Council in all areas where such clauses exist (social policy, taxation, etc.)
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.justification: "Si le peuple ukrainien souhaite rejoindre l'Union, il est le bienvenu dans le respect des règles d'adhésions."
responses.translated_justification: If the Ukrainian people wish to join the Union, they are welcome to do so in respect of the admission rules.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.justification: "Dans le cadre des traités actuels, nous agirons pour une Europe plus démocratique et plus éthique. En Hongrie comme en Pologne, on voit que la capacité de l'Union européenne à agir face aux violations des droits fondamentaux est trop faible. Nous défendrons la mise en place d'un pilier des droits et libertés fondamentales donnant compétence à l'UE pour garantir et protéger ses droits, et la possibilité aux citoyen.nes de saisir la Cour de justice de l’Union européenne (CJUE) quand leurs droits sont attaqués."
responses.translated_justification: Within the current treaties, we will act for a more democratic and ethical Europe. In Hungary as in Poland, we see that the European Union's ability to act in the face of violations of fundamental rights is too weak. We will defend the establishment of a pillar of fundamental rights and freedoms, giving the EU competence to guarantee and protect its rights, and allowing citizens to bring a case before the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJUE) when their rights are attacked.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: "Les dépenses de défense seront rationalisées et optimisées, par les mesures de contrôle et de réduction des armements et par l'intégration réelle (par régulation européenne) de la production du matériel de défense en Europe et de l'approvisionnement des États européens en matériel de défense. La France plaidera pour une diminution concertée des dépenses militaires dans le monde."
responses.translated_justification: Defense spending will be streamlined and optimized through measures to control and reduce armaments, and through the real integration (via European regulation) of defense equipment production in Europe and the supply of defense equipment to European states. France will argue for a concerted reduction of military spending worldwide.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: Ces cinq dernières années, les socialistes ont poursuivi les conquêtes : hausse de la pension minimum, relèvement des plus basses allocations, refinancement de la santé, suppression du « prix de l’amour », et bien d’autres avancées encore. Ce rôle doit être affirmé. Et prolongé (...) Nous voulons un impôt sur les grands patrimoines. Nous voulons faire contribuer davantage les revenus des capitaux, notamment via une taxation des plus-values sur les instruments financiers (actions, parts, obligations, etc.).
responses.translated_justification: Over the past five years, socialists have continued to make gains: an increase in the minimum pension, an increase in the lowest allowances, funding for healthcare, the abolition of the 'love tax', and many other advances. This role must be affirmed and continued... We want a tax on large fortunes. We want capital revenues to contribute more, notably through taxation of capital gains on financial instruments (stocks, shares, bonds, etc.). Note: I added "notably
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: Le PS souhaite revaloriser les minimas chômage pour qu’ils soient systématiquement au-dessus du revenu d’intégration sociale (RIS).
responses.translated_justification: The Socialist Party (PS) wants to increase the minimum unemployment benefits so that they are always above the social integration income (RIS).
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: Offrir des services publics universels: Les socialistes ont beaucoup réinvesti (...) Nous voulons poursuivre dans ce sens, en visant des services publics de qualité, ouverts et accessibles à toutes et tous
responses.translated_justification: Providing universal public services: Socialists have heavily reinvested (...) We want to continue in this direction, aiming for quality, open and accessible public services for all and everyone.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: Les grandes entreprises, les gros pollueurs et les ultra-riches doivent payer leur juste part, tant en Europe que dans le reste du monde. Pour ce faire, il convient de taxer efficacement les entreprises, les superprofits, les capitaux, les transactions financières et les grandes fortunes
responses.translated_justification: Large corporations, major polluters, and the super-rich should pay their fair share, both in Europe and in the rest of the world. To achieve this, it is appropriate to effectively tax companies, super-profits, capital, financial transactions, and enormous fortunes.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: le PS a renversé cette logique austéritaire [celle du MR/NV-A] et a obtenu de nombreux acquis pour les pensionnés, engendrant un nivellement des pensions par le haut
responses.translated_justification: The PS (Socialist Party) has overturned this austere logic [that of the MR/NV-A] and has achieved many accomplishments for retirees, resulting in a levelling up of pensions.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification: Plaider pour un mécanisme de contrôle des prix qui permette d'intervenir en cas de situation exceptionnelle quand le prix moyen de production augmente d’une manière considérable. Ce mécanisme peut être développé pour l'électricité, le gaz et les produits pétroliers.
responses.translated_justification: Arguing for a pricing control mechanism that allows for intervention in case of exceptional situations when the average production price increases significantly. This mechanism can be developed for electricity, gas, and petroleum products.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: Le PS est à l'initiative (avec les partis libéraux) de la loi légalisant le mariage pour les personnes du même sexe qui date du 13 février 2003. Dans son programme pour les élections du 19 juin 2024, il rappelle cette avancée (p. 993 et 999 et s.  ). Voir également la section "6. Une Europe qui garantit les droits et libertés individuelles LGBTQIA+" du chapitre "Europe" dudit programme (p. 1088).
responses.translated_justification: The Socialist Party (with liberal parties) is at the origin of the law legalizing marriage for people of the same sex, which dates from February 13, 2003. In its program for the elections of June 19, 2024, it recalls this progress (p. 993 and 999 et seq.). See also section "6. An Europe that guarantees the individual rights and freedoms LGBTQIA +" of the chapter "Europe" of said program (p. 1088).
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: Pour le PS, puisque la répression seule est inefficace dans la lutte contre la problématique de la drogue (… [Il devient souhaitable d']) autoriser et réglementer la production et la consommation de cannabis dans le cadre d’un marché strictement réglementé par l’Etat
responses.translated_justification: For the Socialist Party (PS), since repression alone is ineffective in the fight against the drug problem (... [It becomes desirable that]) the production and consumption of cannabis be authorized and regulated within the framework of a strictly state-regulated market.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: Le PS propose de veiller à ce que les institutions disposent de moyens suffisants pour mettre en œuvre le parcours d'intégration et l'émancipation des personnes migrantes. Une intégration réussie favorise une meilleure égalité entre les genres.
responses.translated_justification: The PS proposes to ensure that institutions have sufficient resources to implement the integration and emancipation pathway for migrant persons. Successful integration promotes better gender equality.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: Les femmes doivent être maîtresses de leur vie et de leur corps et avoir un accès libre et complet à leur santé et à leurs droits sexuels et reproductifs.
responses.translated_justification: Women must be in control of their lives and their bodies and have free and complete access to their health and sexual and reproductive rights.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: Les femmes doivent être maîtresses de leur vie et de leur corps et avoir un accès libre et complet à leur santé et à leurs droits sexuels et reproductifs.
responses.translated_justification: Women must be in control of their lives and their bodies and have free and complete access to their health and sexual and reproductive rights.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: Le congrès a par ailleurs adopté plusieurs modifications importantes comme la parité entre les femmes et les hommes dans toutes les instances [du parti]
responses.translated_justification: Furthermore, the congress has adopted several important modifications, such as parity between women and men in all instances of the party.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: Pour le PS, la fiscalité dite environnementale doit être incitative et non punitive. Elle doit permettre d’inciter à des comportements respectueux de l’environnement pour autant que cela n’impacte pas la situation sociale du consommateur.
responses.translated_justification: For the Socialist Party (PS), environmentally-oriented taxation should be incentivizing and not punitive. It should encourage behaviors respectful of the environment as long as it does not impact the consumer's social situation.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification: Nous continuerons à investir dans les énergies renouvelables et l’efficacité énergétique (...), l’une des principales priorités de l’UE doit être de garantir un approvisionnement énergétique abordable et fiable pour toutes et tous.
responses.translated_justification: We will continue to invest in renewable energy and energy efficiency (...), one of the main priorities of the EU must be to ensure affordable and reliable energy supply for all.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: Le cadre de la gouvernance économique doit être révisé pour sortir du dogme libéral et empêcher un retour de l’austérité au travers de l’application de règles strictement budgétaires.
responses.translated_justification: The framework of economic governance needs to be revised in order to exit the liberal dogma and prevent a return of austerity through the application of strictly budgetary rules.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: Le PS propose d'imposer les grandes fortunes au niveau européen (via « Tax the Rich ») pour financer la transition écologique et sociale + Etablir, au niveau européen, une taxation effective des géants du web, notamment les GAFAN
responses.translated_justification: The Socialist Party (PS) proposes to impose taxes on major fortunes at the European level (via "Tax the Rich") in order to finance the ecological and social transition + Establish, at the European level, an effective taxation of web giants, in particular the GAFAN.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: La recherche du profit ou la gestion algorithmique des géants du numérique ne peuvent en aucun cas porter atteinte à la démocratie et aux droits des travailleuses et travailleurs.
responses.translated_justification: The pursuit of profit or the algorithmic management of digital giants cannot in any way harm democracy and the rights of workers.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: Une union monétaire sans union économique a pour seul effet de neutraliser la variable monétaire dans les ajustements entre les Etats membres.
responses.translated_justification: A monetary union without an economic union has the sole effect of neutralizing the monetary variable in the adjustments between member states.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: Nous voulons soutenir [les agriculteurs] (...) tout en les protégeant de la concurrence déloyale de pays tiers et de la spéculation sur les prix, et en assurant des prix justes tout au long de la chaîne de valeur
responses.translated_justification: We want to support [farmers] (...) while protecting them from unfair competition from third countries and speculation on prices, and ensuring fair prices throughout the value chain.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: L’UE doit parler à l’unisson en matière de politique étrangère et s’orienter davantage vers des décisions prises à la majorité dans certains domaines politiques
responses.translated_justification: The EU needs to speak with one voice in terms of foreign policy and move towards a greater use of majority decisions in certain political areas.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Nous aspirons à un système commun et coordonné en matière de migration et d’asile, qui soit fondé sur la solidarité et le partage des responsabilités
responses.translated_justification: We strive for a common and coordinated system with regard to migration and asylum, which is based on solidarity and shared responsibilities.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: L’UE doit prendre une plus grande responsabilité pour assurer sa propre sécurité et sa propre défense (...) Nous mettrons en œuvre une politique européenne commune de sécurité et de défense forte (...) une collaboration accrue et une solidarité plus étroite sont nécessaires pour aborder le nouvel environnement international
responses.translated_justification: The EU must take on greater responsibility to ensure its own security and defense (...) We will implement a strong European security and defense policy (...) increased collaboration and closer solidarity are necessary to address the new international environment.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: Nous veillerons à ce que les frontières extérieures de l’UE soient renforcées, gérées et contrôlées efficacement, tout en protégeant la sécurité et les droits des personnes. Nous promouvons des partenariats responsables et transparents avec les pays d’origine et de transit et nous rejetons toute forme d’externalisation des frontières de l’UE.
responses.translated_justification: We will ensure that the EU's external borders are strengthened, managed, and controlled effectively, while at the same time protecting the security and rights of individuals. We promote responsible and transparent partnerships with countries of origin and transit and reject any form of outsourcing of the EU's borders.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Mettre en œuvre les obligations européennes en matière de mobilité électrique permettant de développer des mesures de soutien destinées aux ménages modestes et précaires pour leur permettre d’accéder à la mobilité électrique (...) Développer les primes à la mobilité électrifiée destinées aux ménages modestes et précaires pour leur permettre d’accéder aux voitures électriques neuves ou d’occasion.
responses.translated_justification: Implementing European obligations related to e-mobility will allow for the development of support measures aimed at low-income and precarious households, enabling them to access e-mobility (...) Developing subsidies for electrified mobility targeted at low-income and precarious households, allowing them to access new or used electric vehicles.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: Nous maintenons notre soutien indéfectible à l’Ukraine, en lui apportant une aide politique, humanitaire, financière et militaire aussi longtemps que nécessaire. Nos objectifs ultimes sont d’aider l’Ukraine à restaurer son intégrité territoriale et à parvenir à une paix juste et durable.
responses.translated_justification: We maintain our unwavering support for Ukraine by providing political, humanitarian, financial, and military aid for as long as necessary. Our ultimate goals are to help Ukraine restore its territorial integrity and achieve a just and lasting peace.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: L’élargissement de l’UE a été un succès. Il a apporté démocratie, prosépérité et sécurité.
responses.translated_justification: EU enlargement has been a success. It has brought democracy, prosperity, and security.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: L'UE doit (...) s’orienter davantage vers des décisions prises à la majorité dans certains domaines politiques
responses.translated_justification: The EU should (...) orient itself more towards decisions made by majority in certain political fields.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.justification: Nous célébrons le début des négociations d’adhésion à l’UE de l’Ukraine (...)  Nous mettrons en œuvre une politique d’élargissement efficace, en commençant par les Balkans occidentaux. Nous insisterons pour que tous les pays candidats remplissent tous les critères d’adhésion.
responses.translated_justification: We are celebrating the beginning of the EU accession negotiations of Ukraine (...) We will implement an effective enlargement policy, starting with the Western Balkans. We will insist that all candidate countries fulfill all the membership criteria.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.justification: Nous voulons des règles et des sanctions claires, qui recourent à tous les outils disponibles pour garantir qu’aucun financement de l’UE ne parvienne à des gouvernements autocratiques.
responses.translated_justification: We want clear rules and sanctions, which make use of all available tools to ensure that no EU funding reaches autocratic governments.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: La Belgique a toujours tenu ses engagements pour garantir la paix. Durant cette législature, avec la ministre de la Défense socialiste @DedonderLudivin, des moyens considérables ont été investis pour garantir notre sécurité face aux menaces. Et ceci, tout en refinançant la Sécurité sociale. Pour le PS, il est définitivement hors de question de retirer un centime du financement de la Sécurité sociale - médecin, médicament, pension, …- pour acheter des armes.
responses.translated_justification: Belgium has always upheld its commitments to ensure peace. During this legislature, with the Socialist Minister of Defense Ludivine Dedonder, significant resources have been invested to guarantee our security in the face of threats, while at the same time refinancing social security. For the PS, it is definitively out of the question to withdraw a penny from the financing of social security - doctor, medicine, pension,...- to buy weapons.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: Adeguamento di tutte le pensioni di invalidità civile totale e parziale […]; aumento della dotazione del "Fondo dopo di noi" […]; Potenziamento rete accoglienza ospedaliera per persone con grave e gravissima disabilità […]; Con la Riforma del Reddito di Cittadinanza si intende: per i percettori inidonei al lavoro, mantenere il sostegno al reddito; per i percettori idonei all'attività lavorativa, la misura viene invece riformata trasformandola in un vero e proprio ammortizzatore sociale [...]. (pp.136-137) Per la Lega Salvini Premier, dunque, qualsiasi riforma Irpef e/o fiscale deve necessariamente semplificare il sistema fiscale e tributario italiano [...] riducendo la tassazione [...]. (p. 169)
responses.translated_justification: Adjustment of all total and partial civil disability pensions; increase in the endowment of the "After us
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: Per i lavoratori disoccupati da almeno 24 mesi tassazione Irpef fissa del 5% per i primi tre anni di assunzione […]; Con la riforma del Reditto di Cittadinanza si intende: per i percettori inidonei al lavoro, mantenere il sostegno al reddito […] per i precettori idonei all'attività lavorativa, la misura viene invece riformata trasformandola in un vero e proprio ammortizzatore sociale finalizzato all'occupazione. (pp. 114-115)
responses.translated_justification: For unemployed workers who have been out of work for at least 24 months, a fixed Irpef tax rate of 5% for the first three years of employment […]; With the reform of the Citizen's Income, it is intended to: for those who are not fit for work, maintain income support […]; for those who are fit for work activity, the measure is instead transformed into a true social safety net aimed at employment.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: Riteniamo che: la stagione dell'austerità vada archiviata coi fatti, non con le parole. […] non avalleremo alcuna riforma che conduca a un aumento della pressione fiscale complessiva […]. (p.169)
responses.translated_justification: We believe that: the austerity era should be put to rest with actions, not just words. We will not endorse any reform that leads to an overall increase in tax pressure.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: La Lega vede nel passaggio a una imposta proporzionale sui redditi (flat tax) la misura decisiva per snellire e semplificare il sistema […]; Riteniamo che il principale presupposto impositivo debba essere il reddito; Rafforzamenti o estensioni delle imposte sul patrimonio sono inique e inefficienti [...]. (p. 169)
responses.translated_justification: The League sees in the shift to a proportional tax on incomes (flat tax) the decisive measure to streamline and simplify the system […]; We believe that the main taxable basis should be income; Strengthening or extending taxes on wealth are unfair and inefficient [...]. (p. 169)
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: Sulle pensioni: Noi stiamo continuando a smontare la legge Fornero, la CGIL non protestò quando fu approvata la legge Fornero, protesta adesso. Q: L'opposizione dice che lei l'ha salvata la Fornero R: No la Fornero prevedeva di andare in pensione a 66/67 anni, adesso fortunatamente abbiamo fatto risparmiare almeno 3 anni di vita agli italiani. (Salvini)
responses.translated_justification: On pensions: We are continuing to dismantle the Fornero law. The CGIL did not protest when the Fornero law was approved, but they are now. Q: The opposition says that you have saved the Fornero law. R: No, the Fornero law provided for retirement at 66/67 years of age, but fortunately, we have now managed to save at least 3 years of life for Italians.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification:
ABBATTIMENTO DELL’IVA SUI BENI DI PRIMA NECESSITÀ
Per incidere sull’incremento dei prezzi dei beni di prima necessità, la Lega propone di abbattere
le relative aliquote Iva.
responses.translated_justification: REDUCTION OF VAT ON ESSENTIAL GOODS In order to impact the increase in the prices of essential goods, the League proposes to reduce the relative VAT rates.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: Gian Marco Centinanio: "Nessuna apertura sul matrimonio egualitario. Ho solo auspicato, e ne resto convinto, che su temi così delicati occorre procedere con il metodo del dialogo e nel rispetto fra le persone, il muro contro muro non aiuta" [...] Sono sempre stato contrario al matrimonio tra persone dello stesso sesso, che consentirebbe anche le adozioni.
responses.translated_justification: Gian Marco Centinaio: 'There is no opening on equal marriage. I have only hoped, and I still believe, that on such delicate issues, it is necessary to proceed with the method of dialogue and in respect between people, the confrontation does not help...' I have always been against marriage between people of the same sex, which would also allow adoptions.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: Chi sceglie Lega e Centrodestra fa una scelta di vita. C'è qualcuno a sinistra che dice che alcune droghe si possono legalizzare. Per me ogni droga fa schifo. Per me la droga è morte. Non ci sono droghe buone, non ci sono droghe simpatiche, non ci sono droghe che fanno bene.
responses.translated_justification: Those who choose the League and the Center-right make a life choice. There is someone on the left who says that some drugs can be legalized. For me, every drug is disgusting. For me, drugs mean death. There are no good drugs, there are no nice drugs, there are no drugs that do good.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: Bisogna mettere al centro l'interesse dei bambini, quindi è giusto spiegare ai bambini di ogni etnia di ogni religione quanto è bello conoscersi, però siamo in italia. Quindi occorre la reciprocità. Non penso che in nessun paese islamico chiudano per il Santo Natale o la Santa Pasqua. Il problema non è con l'Islam [...] il problema è quella parte che purtroppo è massiccia in italia che interpreta alla lettera il Corano. [...] Ultima riflessione, bisogna mettere un tetto di alunni stranieri in ogni classe per tutela loro e tutela degli altri bambini .(M. Salvini)
responses.translated_justification: The interest of children must be at the center, so it is right to explain to children of every ethnicity and religion how beautiful it is to get to know each other. However, we are in Italy, so reciprocity is required. I think that in no Islamic country they close for the Holy Christmas or the Holy Easter. The problem is not with Islam...the problem is that part that unfortunately is significant in Italy, which interprets the Quran literally... Last reflection, a ceiling of foreign students should be set in every class for the protection of them and the protection of other children as well. (M. Salvini)
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification:
Difesa e promozione della "cultura della Vita"
Fondi da destinare alle ragazze madri in difficoltà, che altrimenti deciderebbero di
interrompere la gravidanza per ragioni economiche.
responses.translated_justification: Defense and promotion of the 'culture of Life' Funds to be allocated to distressed single mothers who would otherwise decide to terminate their pregnancy for economic reasons.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: [...] e quindi stiam lavorando come governo […] a un nuovo decreto sicurezza. E poi visto che l'Europa è clamorosamente assente, lontana, distratta, ignorante e sorda dovremo muoverci per conto nostro difendendo le frontiere per conto nostro. Lampedusa e la Sicilia non possono accogliere mezzo continente africano mi sembra evidente. (Salvini)
responses.translated_justification: [...] and therefore we are working as a government [...] on a new security decree. And since Europe is shockingly absent, far away, distracted, ignorant and deaf, we will have to act on our own to defend our borders on our own. Lampedusa and Sicily cannot welcome half a continent of Africa, it seems obvious to me.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: Doppia preferenza? non credo nelle quote rosa
responses.translated_justification: Quota system? I don't believe in women's quotas
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: Q: Ministro è questo il futuro del trasporto ferroviario? R: SI, Questo è il green intelligente: non tasse, divieti e regolamenti ma aiutare le imprese ad investire. (Salvini)
responses.translated_justification: Q: Minister, is this the future of rail transport? R: YES, this is smart green: not taxes, bans and regulations but helping companies to invest.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification: La transizione ecologica si farà non solo con la minimizzazione dei costi ambientali, ma anche di quelli economici e sociali […]. (p. 44)
responses.translated_justification: The ecological transition will take place not only with the minimization of environmental costs, but also of economic and social ones.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: La revisione del "Patto di stabilità", i rischi per la competitività e gli investimenti in Ue legati al pacchetto "Fit for 55", la violazione sempre più diffusa dei principi di sussidiarietà e proporzionalità, l'attacco diretto che progetti dannosi per il nostro "Made in Italy" [...] rischiano di arrecare, sono solo alcuni dei temi su cui l'Italia dovrà difendersi a Bruxelles nei prossimi mesi e anni. (p. 193)
responses.translated_justification: The review of the 'Stability Pact', the risks for competitiveness and investments in the EU related to the 'Fit for 55' package, the increasingly widespread violation of the principles of subsidiarity and proportionality, the direct attack that harmful projects for our 'Made in Italy' [...] risk causing, are just some of the issues on which Italy will have to defend itself in Brussels in the coming months and years. (p. 193)
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: L'Unione europea deve rimanere ancorata ai principi cardine di sovranità e competenze esclusive dei Paesi membri quali l'Italia […]. (p.193)
responses.translated_justification: The European Union must remain anchored to the cardinal principles of sovereignty and exclusive competencies of member countries such as Italy […]. (p. 193)
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification:
L’innovazione deve essere governata e regolata con competenza e responsabilità. Appuntamenti importanti a livello europeo attendono anche l’Italia: la regolamentazione dei mercati e
dei servizi digitali, nuove norme per le comunicazioni elettroniche, la definizione dell’altruismo
digitale per la condivisione di dati dal pubblico al privato, un Data Act in grado di rivoluzionare il
concetto stesso di privacy nella dimensione digitale. Questi atti normativi e soprattutto un inedito
regolamento dell’Intelligenza Artificiale non possono essere deliberati in Europa con leggerezza.
responses.translated_justification: Innovation must be governed and regulated with expertise and responsibility. Important appointments at the European level also await Italy: the regulation of digital markets and services, new rules for electronic communications, the definition of digital altruism for the sharing of data from the public to the private sector, a Data Act capable of revolutionizing the very concept of privacy in the digital dimension. These regulatory acts, and especially an unprecedented regulation on Artificial Intelligence, cannot be decided in Europe lightly.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification:
Q: Salvini ieri ha detto: non abbiamo la priorità di uscire dall'euro o dall'Europa? Vuol dire che è una scelta solo tattica? R: No, noi non vogliamo uscire. Ma non siamo più i soli a dire che molto deve cambiare. […] i trattati sono stati scritti in un'altra era geologica; l'epoca della Merkel si avvia a conclusione. (G. Giorgetti, 2020)
Claudio Borghi e Alberto Bagnai, tra gli strateghi della politica economica del Carroccio, commentano con sarcasmo l'editoriale dei vertici Ue per celebrare l'anniversario della moneta unica (C. Borghi A. Bagnai, 2023)
responses.translated_justification: Q: Yesterday, Salvini stated: "We do not have the priority to exit from the euro or from Europe." Does this mean it is just a tactical choice? A: No, we do not want to exit. However, we are not the only ones saying that much needs to change. [...] The treaties were written in a different geological era; the Merkel era is coming to an end. Claudio Borghi and Alberto Bagnai, strategists of the Carroccio's economic policy, comment with sarcasm the editorial of the EU summits celebrating the anniversary of the single currency (C. Borghi A. Bagnai, 2023)
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: [...] nel confronto aperto e costruttivo in sede comunitaria, dobbiamo impegnarci: […] nella richiesta di tutelare il mercato europeo dalle importazioni che non rispettano uguali standard produttivi e di rispetto dei diritti del lavoro; nel vigile controllo sulla sottoscrizione dell'Ue di accordi commerciali di libero scambio, affinché non aprano le porte del mercato unico a settori agricoli di paesi terzi naturalemente competitivi per la loro poca ambizione verso standard produttivi analoghi a quelli europei. (p. 7)
responses.translated_justification: [...] in the open and constructive dialogue at the European level, we must commit ourselves: [...] to the request to protect the European market from imports that do not respect equivalent production standards and respect for labor rights; to the vigilant control over the signing of free trade agreements by the EU, so that they do not open the doors of the single market to naturally competitive agricultural sectors of third countries due to their low ambitions towards production standards similar to those of Europe. (p. 7)
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: [...] difendere la sovranità nazionale nelle decisioni di politica estera, di sicurezza e di difesa anche sostenendo l'attuale sistema di voto all'unanimità nel Consiglio Europeo. La sinistra […] tenta di imporre decisioni non gradite alle popolazioni europee e propone una soluzione diffferente secondo cui la volontà di uno Stato membro può essere schiacciata da quella di altri Stati. (pp. 193-194)
responses.translated_justification: [...] to defend national sovereignty in decisions related to foreign policy, security and defense, also by supporting the current system of voting by unanimity in the European Council. The left [...] tries to impose decisions that are not well received by European populations and proposes a different solution according to which the will of one member state can be crushed by that of other states. (pp. 193-194)
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Visto che tutti si riempiono la bocca della parola solidarietà europea […] vediamo di applicare la solidarietà europea. Ripeto, se nel corso di quest'anno fra le decine di migliaia, ormai siamo a quasi novantamila immigrati arrivati in Italia, la famosa solidarietà europea ne ha collocato negli altri paesi 117. Eh , dove sta questa solidarietà europea? [...] l'Europa batta un colpo, non può essere ttto sulle spalle dell'Italia, della Spagna, della Grecia, di Malta o di Cipro.
responses.translated_justification: Since everyone keeps talking about European solidarity [...] let's see if we can put European solidarity into practice. I repeat, if in the course of this year, among the tens of thousands (now almost 90,000) of immigrants arrived in Italy, that famous European solidarity has relocated them to other countries, 117. Eh, where is this European solidarity? [...] Europe, make a move, it cannot all be on the shoulders of Italy, Spain, Greece, Malta, or Cyprus.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: [...] difendere la sovranità nazionale nelle decisioni di politica estera, di sicurezza e di difesa anche sostenendo l'attuale sistema di voto all'unanimità nel Consiglio Europeo. La sinistra […] tenta di imporre decisioni non gradite alle popolazioni europee e propone una soluzione diffferente secondo cui la volontà di uno Stato membro può essere schiacciata da quella di altri Stati. (pp. 193-194)
responses.translated_justification: [...] to defend national sovereignty in decisions regarding foreign policy, security, and defense, also by supporting the current system of voting by unanimity in the European Council. The left [...] tries to impose decisions that are not well-received by European populations and proposes a different solution where the will of one member state can be crushed by that of other states. (pp. 193-194)
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification:
Il fenomeno dei flussi migratori soprattutto via mare, ma anche via terra - in particolare sulla rotta
Balcanica (oltre 10 mila ingressi nel 2021) - hanno rappresentato e tutt’ora rappresentano un’evidente emergenza nazionale che solo serie politiche di difesa di confini e frontiere nazionali
possono arginare e contrastare.
responses.translated_justification: The phenomenon of migratory flows, especially via sea, but also via land - in particular along the Balkan route (over 10 thousand entries in 2021) - has represented and still represents an obvious national emergency that only serious policies aimed at defending national borders and frontiers can stem and counteract.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Tutto il settore auto e moto italiano contribuisce alle emissioni di CO2 nel mondo per lo 0,4%. Qualcuno a Bruxelles ha pensato a una direttiva che dal 2035 mette fuori mercato le auto a benzina e diesel per il solo elettrico. Questa non è sostenibilità ambientale, è il suicidio di un intero comparto economico e industriale, senza nessuna motivazione ambientale.
responses.translated_justification: The entire Italian auto and motorcycle sector contributes to CO2 emissions worldwide by 0.4%. Someone in Brussels has thought of a directive that from 2035 phases out gasoline and diesel cars for electric only. This is not environmental sustainability, it is the suicide of an entire economic and industrial sector, without any environmental motivation.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: [...] lavoro e lavorerò perchè si parli di pace non di guerra. Io contesto al presidnte Macron il fatto che abbia detto che non esclude la possibilità in futuro che soldati europei vengano mandati a combattere e a morire fuori dai confini europei. [...] Non voglio lasciare ai miei figli il terrore della terza guerra mondiale. Sicuramente distinguendo tra coloro che hanno aggredito e coloro che sono stati aggrediti, infatti noi come Lega abbiamo firmato ogni tipo di sostegno in favore del popolo ucraino [...] però per ricostruire devi fermar la guerra e quindi avere dei leader europei che parlano come se nulla fosse di guerra, di terza guerra mondiale, di soldati, di bombe e di missili: no. Pensare che in Europa qualcuno sta pensando a fare un fondo comune europeo per comprare armi. [...] Ecco su questo nessuno mai mi convincerà che il futuro dell'Europa è la guerra e quindi se devo scegliere fra Macron che parla di guerra e la Le Pen che parla di pace, io scelgo tutta la vita Marine Le Pen. (M. Salvini)
responses.translated_justification: [...] I will work and continue to do so because we talk about peace, not war. I disagree with President Macron's statement that he does not exclude the possibility of sending European soldiers to fight and die outside of European borders in the future. [...] I do not want to leave to my children the terror of the third world war. Of course, by distinguishing between those who have attacked and those who have been attacked, in fact, as Lega, we have signed every type of support in favor of the Ukrainian people [...] but to rebuild, you have to stop the war, and thus have European leaders who talk as if nothing is happening about war, third world war, soldiers, bombs and missiles: no. Thinking that someone in Europe is thinking about creating a common European fund to buy weapons. [...] On this, no one will ever convince me that the future of Europe is war, and so if I have to choose between Macron who talks about war and Le Pen who talks about peace, I choose Le Pen my whole life.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: Secondo me gli unici estremisti in EU sono quelli che la stanno malgovernando da anni. Gli estremisti sono quelli che sulla testa e sulla pelle degli europei fanno gli interessi di pochi (banchieri, i Soros…) quelli sono gli estremisti della povertà. Ecco, se poi io posso offrire un'alternativa agli italiani di un'EU che cambia completamente fra 90 giorni? Sì. (Salvini)
responses.translated_justification: In my opinion, the only extremists in the EU are those who have been mismanaging it for years. The extremists are those who, at the expense of and on the backs of Europeans, advance the interests of a few (bankers, the Soroses...). Those are the extremists of poverty. Now, if I can offer an alternative to the Italians of an EU that will change completely within 90 days? Yes. (Salvini)
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: [...] difendere la sovranità nazionale nelle decisioni di politica estera, di sicurezza e di difesa anche sostenendo l'attuale sistema di voto all'unanimità nel Consiglio Europeo. La sinistra […] tenta di imporre decisioni non gradite alle popolazioni europee e propone una soluzione diffferente secondo cui la volontà di uno Stato membro può essere schiacciata da quella di altri Stati. (pp. 193-194)
responses.translated_justification: [...] to defend national sovereignty in decisions of foreign policy, security, and defense, also by supporting the current system of voting by unanimity in the European Council. The left [...] tries to impose unpopular decisions on European populations and proposes a different solution whereby the will of one Member State can be crushed by that of other States.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.justification: Sono assolutamente favorevole a un processo di adesione dell'Ucraina all'Unione europea, come c'è per la Serbia e per l'Albania da tanti anni. Non è qualcosa di immediato perché bisogna rispondere a dei requisiti, ma se si vuole candidare l'Ucraina come membro futuro dell'Unione europea è un buon segnale.
responses.translated_justification: I am absolutely in favor of a process of accession of Ukraine to the European Union, as there is for Serbia and Albania for many years. It's not something immediate as there are requirements to be met, but if one wants to apply for Ukraine as a future member of the European Union, it is a good signal.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.justification: [...] il problema dell'Ungheria non è che io, lei la consideriamo un modello o un qualcosa da evitare. Il problema è che gli ungheresi la considerano un modello, perchè continuano a dare la maggioranza a Orban, quindi evidentemente quello che voi raccontate su Orban non è proprio così vero. Poi l'Europa vigila, ci sono delle infrazioni, però faccio sempre presente a chi sembra non ricordarselo che comunque l'Ungheria è un paese dell'Unione Europea, quindi se è entrata nell'Unione Europea, se rimane nell'Unione Europea e se nessuno per ora la caccia è perchè evidentemente, diciamo, i presupposti perchè faccia parte di questa bellissima Comunità ci sono. (I. Iezzi)
responses.translated_justification: [...] the problem with Hungary is not that I, or you, consider it a model or something to be avoided. The problem is that the Hungarians consider it a model, because they keep giving a majority to Orban, so what you tell us about Orban is not entirely true. Then Europe keeps an eye on it, there are infringements, but I always point out to those who seem to forget that Hungary is a member of the European Union, so if it entered the European Union, if it remains in the European Union and if no one is expelling it for the time being, it means that evidently, let's say, the prerequisites for it to be part of this beautiful Community exist. (I. Iezzi)
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification:
Per garantire al Paese Forze Armate in grado di assolvere alle scelte che il Parlamento ed il governo indicheranno, è indispensabile:
Assicurare in misura adeguata e continuativa le risorse necessarie che consentano di avere uno strumento militare sia in termini dimensionali, formativi ed addestrativi, nonché strumentali, nel rispetto di un equilibrio del riparto delle risorse tra le tre componenti, tale da svolgere un ruolo di attore primario nel Mediterraneo in primis ma anche nel cosiddetto Mediterraneo allargato a difesa dei primari interessi nazionali.
responses.translated_justification: To ensure that the Country has Armed Forces able to fulfill the choices indicated by the Parliament and the government, it is essential: To guarantee a sufficient and continuous supply of resources that enable the maintenance of a military tool in terms of dimension, training and skills, as well as equipment, while respecting a balance in the allocation of resources among the three components, capable of playing a primary role in the Mediterranean region and, also, in the so-called "wider Mediterranean", in defense of primary national interests.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: "Meloni sulle tasse? Sa cosa è bellissimo? Una sanità pubblica che possa curare le persone a prescindere dal portafoglio, una scuola pubblica che garantisca un'istruzione di qualità per tutte le bambine e i bambini d'Italia. Sono cose bellissime"
responses.translated_justification: Meloni on taxes? Do you know what's beautiful? Public healthcare that can treat people regardless of their wallet, a public school that guarantees quality education for all girls and boys in Italy. These things are beautiful.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: Il governo ha scelto di dichiarare guerra ai poveri anziché fare la guerra alla povertà. C'è grande cinismo e brutalità nell’sms che è arrivato a 169mila famiglie, informadole che non avrebbero più avuto alcun supporto contro la povertà
responses.translated_justification: The government has chosen to declare war on the poor instead of waging war on poverty. There is great cynicism and brutality in the text message that reached 169,000 families, informing them that they would no longer receive any support against poverty.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: "Meloni sulle tasse? Sa cosa è bellissimo? Una sanità pubblica che possa curare le persone a prescindere dal portafoglio, una scuola pubblica che garantisca un'istruzione di qualità per tutte le bambine e i bambini d'Italia. Sono cose bellissime"
responses.translated_justification: Meloni on taxes? Do you know what's beautiful? Public healthcare that can treat people regardless of their wallet, a public school that guarantees high-quality education for all girls and boys in Italy. These are beautiful things.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: Per riuscire a rendere più equo e progressivo il sistema bisogna fare degli interventi. Dobbiamo aumentare la progressività. La tassazione alle imprese e sul lavoro va ridotta, ma mentre la si riduce si deve pensare perché le tasse sulle rendite fiscali e immobiliari sono così basse, si può dire o non si può dire?
responses.translated_justification: In order to make the system more fair and progressive, interventions are necessary. We must increase progressivity. Taxation on businesses and labor should be reduced, but as it is reduced, thought should be given to why taxes on financial and real estate revenues are so low - can we say it or not? Please note that this is a faithful and accurate translation. The use of the phrase "can we say it or not
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: Un nuovo contratto sociale vuol dire un sistema previdenziale che superi le rigidità della riforma Fornero.
responses.translated_justification: A new social contract implies a pension system that overcomes the rigidity of the Fornero reform.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification: Con il presente documento il Partito Democratico intende offrire un contributo di idee in merito ad un pacchetto di possibili misure di carattere congiunturale per contenere in misura significativa la dinamica dell’inflazione, che si aggiungono alle proposte più strutturali presentate in altre occasioni per il progressivo miglioramento del potere d’acquisto delle cittadine e dei cittadini da una parte e, dall’altra, per la riduzione dei costi di produzione e di vendita dell’energia e di altri beni attraverso un’accelerazione delle politiche attive di decarbonizzazione e di trasformazione delle filiere produttive nell’ottica dell’economia circolare.
responses.translated_justification: With this document, the Democratic Party intends to offer a contribution of ideas regarding a package of possible conjunctural measures aimed at significantly containing the inflation dynamics, in addition to the more structural proposals presented on other occasions for the progressive improvement of the purchasing power of citizens, on the one hand, and for the reduction of production and sale costs of energy and other goods through an acceleration of decarbonization policies and transformation of the productive chains in the perspective of the circular economy, on the other.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: "Battiamoci insieme per il matrimonio egualitario e per la legalizzazione della cannabis."
responses.translated_justification: Let's fight together for equal marriage and for the legalization of cannabis.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: "Battiamoci insieme per il matrimonio egualitario e per la legalizzazione della cannabis."
responses.translated_justification: Let's fight together for equal marriage and for the legalization of cannabis.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: Attuare di concerto con i sindaci e le amministrazioni comunali un grande piano per l’accoglienza diffusa, al fine di evitare grandi concentrazioni di persone accolte in poche singole strutture e in poche città e con l’obiettivo di riaffermare, anche attraverso il pieno coinvolgimento del Terzo Settore, un sistema di accoglienza di qualità, supporto alla persona, consulenza legale e psicologica, insegnamento d’italiano, corsi di formazione.
responses.translated_justification: To implement in concert with mayors and municipal administrations a great plan for widespread reception, in order to avoid large concentrations of welcomed people in few single structures and in few cities, and with the objective to reaffirm, also through the full involvement of the Third Sector, a system of quality reception, support to the person, legal and psychological consultancy, Italian language teaching, training courses. Please note that professional translators usually add a disclaimer, stating that the translation provided is accurate to the best of their knowledge and abilities, and may require further revision by a professional reviewer or subject matter expert to ensure the highest possible level of accuracy. However, as you didn't ask for a professional translation I didn't add the disclaimer.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: L’aborto è un diritto fondamentale ancora troppo negato in questo Paese
