responses.justification: Q: Lei contesta al presidente del Consiglio di portare l'Italia in una economia di guerra. R: "Ma, purtroppo, [...] è in buona compagnia. E un po' sono tutti i governanti europei che si stanno avviando in questa direzione. Ormai c'è un delirio collettivo per cui siam passati dalla transizione energetica e digitale alla transizione militare. Non c'è neppure un vero progetto di difesa comune europea, che se fosse effettivo ed efficace porterebbe economie di scala, razionalizzazione. C'è semplicemente un riarmo. (G. Conte)
responses.translated_justification: Q: Are you accusing the Prime Minister of leading Italy towards a war economy? R: "Unfortunately,...he is not alone. All European leaders are heading in this direction. We have gone from an energy and digital transition to a military transition. There isn't even a real common European defense project, which would bring about economies of scale and rationalization. It's simply a matter of rearmament." (G. Conte)
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: Tajani: "Chi è troppo debole deve essere aiutato [...] Ma tutto questo può avvenire soltanto nel quadro di una moderna economia di mercato: solo il mercato, solo il libero gioco della domanda e dell'offerta, solo l'impegno e le scelte che ogni giorno milioni di persone compiono per sé stesse e le proprie famiglie assicurano il benessere della collettività, e senza il benessere non c'è impegno sociale possi
responses.translated_justification: Tajani: 'Who is too weak must be helped [...] But all this can only take place within the framework of a modern market economy: only the market, only the free play of supply and demand, only the commitment and the choices that millions of people make every day for themselves and their families ensure the well-being of the community, and without well-being there is no possible social commitment.'
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification:
Latest national election manifesto of the party
"Riforma del reddito di cittadinanza come politica di sostegno
all’occupazione e trasformazione in una misura di sussistenza specifica".
responses.translated_justification: Reform of citizens' income as a policy to support employment and transformation into a specific subsistence measure.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: "Forza Italia è garante del fatto che il Governo continuerà sulla strada delle privatizzazioni. Forza Italia è garante anche dell'impegno al contenimento della pressione fiscale e alla razionalizzazione del sistema impositivo."
responses.translated_justification: Forza Italy guarantees that the Government will continue on the path of privatizations. Forza Italy also guarantees a commitment to containing tax pressure and rationalizing the tax system.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: "Voglio essere chiaro: finché saremo al governo non ci sarà mai una patrimoniale nel nostro paese."
responses.translated_justification: I want to be clear: while we are in government, there will never be a wealth tax in our country.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification:
"La libertà economica per noi non è soltanto la dottrina più efficace che l'umanità abbia mai creato, è [...] uno dei diritti naturali della persona. Lo Stato ha il compito di definire le regole, deve coordinare e indirizzare, ma non deve mai sostituirsi al
mercato."
responses.translated_justification: Economic freedom for us is not only the most effective doctrine that humanity has ever created, it is also one of the natural rights of the person. The State has the task of defining the rules, of coordinating and guiding, but it must never replace the market.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: "Mettere al centro la famiglia: intendo la famiglia naturale, costituita da una donna e da un uomo, e orientata alla procreazione e all'educazione dei figli. [...] La famiglia ha una funzione sociale, riconosciuta anche dalla Costituzione, che merita una tutela particolare."
responses.translated_justification: To put the family at the center: I mean the natural family, constituted by a woman and a man, and oriented towards procreation and the education of children. [...] The family has a social function, recognized also by the Constitution, which deserves special protection.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: "L’unica cosa che non farà mai questo governo è legalizzare la cannabis perché è profondamente sbagliato, faremo un torto ai ragazzi, non è come bere un bicchiere di vino".
responses.translated_justification: The only thing that this government will never do is legalize cannabis because it is deeply wrong, we would be doing a disservice to the youth, it's not like having a glass of wine.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: "Difesa e promozione delle radici e identità storiche e culturali classiche e giudaico-cristiane dell'Europa."
responses.translated_justification: Defense and promotion of the classical and Judeo-Christian historical and cultural roots and identity of Europe.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: "Poi bisogna aiutare le donne che non vogliono abortire a non abortire, perché l’aborto è sempre un trauma. Bisogna permettere a chi è obiettore di coscienza di fare l’obiettore, ma non è assolutamente nella nostra intenzione mettere a repentaglio la legge".
responses.translated_justification: Then we need to help women who do not want to abort not to abort, because abortion is always a trauma. We must allow those who are conscientious objectors to exercise their objection, but it is absolutely not our intention to jeopardize the law.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: Tajani: "Non consentiremo che le ragioni della legalità e quelle della umanità vengano messe in contrapposizione, perché entrambe sono ragioni essenziali in una democrazia liberale: salvare vite e nello stesso tempo rispettare le norme è possibile, e noi vogliamo farlo anche stringendo accordi bilaterali"
responses.translated_justification: Tajani: 'We will not allow the reasons of legality and those of humanity to be set in opposition, because both are essential reasons in a liberal democracy: saving lives and at the same time respecting the rules is possible, and we want to do it by also signing bilateral agreements'
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: "Le azioni positive come le quote rosa, che in astratto sono contro i nostri principi, in concreto però sono uno strumento indispensabile"
responses.translated_justification: Positive actions such as gender quotas, which in abstract are against our principles, are however an indispensable tool in practice.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: "La lotta al cambiamento climatico va fatta ma richiede obiettivi raggiungibili. Io, come parlamentare europeo - ha spiegato il ministro degli Esteri - ho votato fin dalla prima volta contro quella proposta, perchè noi dobbiamo difendere anche la nostra industria automobilistica. Con questa riforma rischiamo di perdere oltre 70 mila posti di lavoro"
responses.translated_justification: The fight against climate change needs to be done but requires achievable objectives. As a European parliamentarian, the Minister of Foreign Affairs explained that he has always voted against the proposal, because we must also defend our automotive industry. With this reform, we risk losing over 70 thousand jobs.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification:
"La necessità di ridurre drasticamente il contributo delle fonti fossili nel mix energetico del Paese
impone di orientare le future scelte di politica energetica nazionale verso una energy security supply
che consenta il progressivo affrancamento dalle forniture estere di gas e materie prime di cui non
disponiamo a sufficienza garantendo, nell’attuale, precario, contesto geopolitico internazionale, la
piena indipendenza energetica per cui si ritiene necessaria la reintroduzione del nucleare in Italia
anche al fine di garantire la stabilità della rete sopperendo all’intermittenza delle fonti eolica e
fotovoltaica"
responses.translated_justification: The need to drastically reduce the contribution of fossil fuels in the country's energy mix implies orienting future national energy policy choices towards an energy security supply that allows for progressive emancipation from foreign gas and raw material supplies of which we do not have enough, ensuring, in the current, precarious, international geopolitical context, full energy independence, for which the reintroduction of nuclear power in Italy is considered necessary also to ensure the stability of the grid, overcoming the intermittence of wind and photovoltaic sources.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: "Revisione del patto di stabilità"
responses.translated_justification: Review of the stability pact
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: "Per quanto riguarda il completamento dell’Unione economica e monetaria [con strumenti fiscali e di bilancio europei], credo sia fondamentale finire l’edifico che abbiamo cominciato a costruire negli anni Novanta. Non possiamo rimanere in mezzo al guado, dove rischiamo di essere travolti da una nuova crisi. L’Italia ha sempre sostenuto la necessità di una maggiore integrazione europea in ambito economico"
responses.translated_justification: Regarding the completion of the Economic and Monetary Union [with European fiscal and budgetary tools], I believe it is fundamental to finish the building that we started to construct in the 1990s. We cannot remain in the middle of the river, where we risk being overwhelmed by a new crisis. Italy has always supported the need for greater European integration in the economic field.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: "Credo che abbia fatto molto bene il Parlamento Europeo a dare delle regole all'utilizzo dell'Intelligenza Artificiale perché sicurezza cibernetica e Intelligenza Artificiale non possono essere separate"
responses.translated_justification: I believe that the European Parliament did very well in setting rules for the use of Artificial Intelligence, because cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence cannot be separated.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: "L’Italia ha sempre sostenuto la necessità di una maggiore integrazione europea in ambito economico. Questo lo abbiamo dimostrato mantenendo una posizione coerente e costante nel dibattito europeo"
responses.translated_justification: Italy has always supported the need for greater economic integration in the European Union. We have demonstrated this by maintaining a consistent and steady stance in the European debate.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: "con la Cina lavoreremo per tutelare i nostri agricoltori dalla concorrenza sleale per evitare speculazione prezzi"
responses.translated_justification: With China, we will work to protect our farmers from unfair competition in order to avoid price speculation.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: "Serve avere una politica estera più forte, una vera politica estera europea. [...] Abbiamo bisogno di una difesa europea."
responses.translated_justification: We need to have a stronger foreign policy, a real European foreign policy. [...] We need a European defense.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Tajani: "La soluzione non è nel buonismo né nel filo spinato, la soluzione deve essere europea, perché chi sbarca a Lampedusa non vuole andare in Sicilia, vuole andare in Germania, in Francia, in Finlandia, in Svezia"
responses.translated_justification: Tajani: 'The solution is not in being nice or in barbed wire, the solution must be European, because those who disembark in Lampedusa do not want to go to Sicily, they want to go to Germany, France, Finland, Sweden'
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: "Serve un commissario europeo alla difesa, finalmente dobbiamo avere un esercito unico che permetta all'Europa di contare di più all'interno della NATO. [...] Dobbiamo avere una nostra forte consistenza militare e di industria della difesa"
responses.translated_justification: We need a European Commissioner for Defense, finally we must have a unified army which will allow Europe to have more weight within NATO. [...] We need to have a strong military and defense industry presence.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: "Tajani: controlli ai confini perché c'è ancora allarme"
responses.translated_justification: Tajani: border controls because the alarm is still ongoing
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Pichetto Fratin: "[...] risposta all'ideologia ambientalista a cui ci hanno abituati per troppi anni senza alcun risultato: questo vale per il settore automotive, con l'impegno sui biocarburanti, e naturalmente sui motori endotermici, con un divieto assurdo al 35 di produzione - perché se il problema è l'emissione, è l'emissione che devo verificare"
responses.translated_justification: Pichetto Fratin: "[...] response to the environmentalist ideology to which they have accustomed us for too many years without any result: this applies to the automotive sector, with a commitment to biob fuels, and of course to internal combustion engines, with an absurd ban on 35% of production - because if the problem is emissions, it is emissions that I must verify"".
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: "Siamo favorevoli a sostenere l'Ucraina, l'indipendenza dell'Ucraina, [...] lo abbiamo fatto in questi due anni e continueremo a farlo senza esitazione, almeno per quanto riguarda l'Italia e il Governo italiano, ricordando che non siamo in guerra con la Russia"
responses.translated_justification: We are in favor of supporting Ukraine, the independence of Ukraine, [...] we have done it in these two years and we will continue to do so without hesitation, at least as far as Italy and the Italian government are concerned, remembering that we are not at war with Russia.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: Tajani: "Non esiste altra forza politica in Italia per cui l'Europa e l'Occidente siano così concretamente essenziali alla propria identità"
responses.translated_justification: Tajani: 'There is no other political force in Italy for which Europe and the West are so concretely essential to their own identity'
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: "Il voto all’unanimità ha dimostrato di avere limiti e di essere spesso causa di inefficienze e immobilismi. Il Consiglio deciderebbe in modo più agile e efficace con il voto a maggioranza qualificata in settori chiave quali la fiscalità e la politica estera"
responses.translated_justification: Unanimous voting has demonstrated that it has limitations and is often the cause of inefficiencies and inaction. The Council would decide more nimbly and effectively with qualified majority voting in key areas such as taxation and foreign policy.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.justification: Tajani: "Kiev entri nell'Unione"
responses.translated_justification: Tajani: 'Kiev should join the Union'".
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.justification: "Perché se Fratelli d’Italia e Lega (insieme ai rispettivi gruppi dei Conservatori e Riformisti Europei e di Identità e Democrazia) si schierano a sostegno di Viktor Orbán, Forza Italia e il Partito Popolare Europeo non sono disposti a fare concessioni nemmeno alla stessa Commissione che sostengono. La stessa che, solo un mese fa, ha deciso di sbloccare – in modo quantomeno controverso – 10,2 miliardi di euro in fondi Ue a Budapest"
responses.translated_justification: Because if Brothers of Italy and League (together with their respective groups of European Conservatives and Reformists and Identity and Democracy) align themselves in support of Viktor Orbán, Forza Italia and the European People's Party are not willing to make any concessions, not even to the same Commission that they support. The same one that, just one month ago, decided in a controversial manner to unblock 10.2 billion euros in EU funds in Budapest.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: "Investimento del 2% del PIL nella Difesa, nel rispetto degli accordi NATO"
responses.translated_justification: An investment of 2% of GDP in Defense, in compliance with NATO agreements.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: La povertà non è un destino scritto, ma il risultato di politiche sbagliate, come quelle del governo Meloni. Serve il salario minimo. Serve aiutare chi è in difficoltà. Serve detassare gli aumenti contrattuali. Serve investire in servizi e welfare. Serve mandare a casa questo governo colpevole.
responses.translated_justification: Poverty is not a written fate, but the result of wrong policies, such as those of the Meloni government. A minimum wage is needed. Help is needed for those in difficulty. Tax cuts are needed for contractual increases. Investment is needed in services and welfare. This government, which is to blame, needs to be sent home.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: “Questi dati confermano che il governo Meloni non solo ignora le esigenze dei giovani, ma aggrava la situazione con politiche che non solo non creano nuove opportunità, ma riducono anche quelle già esistenti. Il governo deve porre fine alla sua guerra contro l’innovazione e di adottare politiche concrete che promuovano la creazione di lavoro dignitoso e sostenibile per le generazioni presenti e future”. BONELLI
responses.translated_justification: These data confirm that the Meloni government not only ignores the needs of young people, but worsens the situation with policies that not only do not create new opportunities, but also reduce existing ones. The government must end its war on innovation and adopt concrete policies that promote the creation of dignified and sustainable work for both present and future generations.' BONELLI Please note that the text in quotation marks seems to be a statement made by someone, most likely a politician or a public figure. The sentence 'BONELLI' at the end may indicate the name of the person who made the statement.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: "In Italia ci sono 69 supermiliardari, con un patrimonio da 210 miliardi di euro. E c'è chi dice che bisognerebbe tagliare la spesa pubblica, cioè sanità e trasporti. Forse chi ha qualcosa di più rispetto agli altri dovrebbe dare qualcosa di più in termini di tasse. Perciò ritengo che una patrimoniale sui super ricchi sia assolutamente necessaria in questo Paese" lo ha detto il deputato Angelo Bonelli di Alleanza Verdi e Sinistra.
responses.translated_justification: In Italy, there are 69 billionaires, with a wealth of 210 billion euros. And there are those who say that public spending should be cut, that is health and transportation. Perhaps those who have something more than others should give something more in terms of taxes. Therefore, I believe that a wealth tax on the super-rich is absolutely necessary in this country,
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: Sposti la tassazione su grandi ricchezze e redditi più alti, faccia pagare chi ha fatto miliardi di extraprofitti senza muovere un muscolo, aumenti le buste paghe e garantisca i servizi essenziali, a partire dalla sanità pubblica. Questo è il minimo.
responses.translated_justification: Shift the taxation to large wealth and higher incomes, make those who have made billions in excess profits without moving a muscle pay, increase wages and guarantee essential services, starting with public health. This is the minimum.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: Per questo noi proponiamo che si possa uscire dal lavoro a 62 anni o con 41 anni di contributi, riconoscendo inoltre i periodi di disoccupazione involontaria, il lavoro di cura non retribuito, la maternità.
responses.translated_justification: For this reason, we propose that it be possible to leave work at 62 years of age or with 41 years of contributions, also recognizing periods of involuntary unemployment, unpaid care work, and maternity.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification: Protezione del potere d'acquisto [...] tornare ad un sistema in cui a cadenza almeno semestrale si proceda automaticamente ad alzare i salari e le pensioni in proporzione alla crescita dell'inflazione, in assenza di accordi intervenuti in questo senso nel periodo fra le parti sociali. Allo stesso tempo si deve prevedere nelle fasi di crescita dei prezzi indotta da meccanismi speculativi, la possibilità di blocco degli stessi, limitatamente ad un paniere di beni e servizi essenziali. (L'Italia del Lavoro)
responses.translated_justification: Protection of purchasing power [...] returning to a system in which, at least every six months, wages and pensions are automatically increased in proportion to inflation growth, in the absence of agreements reached in this sense among the social parties. At the same time, the possibility of freezing certain prices, limited to a basket of essential goods and services, must be provided for in phases of price growth induced by speculative mechanisms. (Italy of Work)
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: Una legge che preveda l’estensione dei diritti e dei doveri delle coppie eterosessuali anche alle coppie dello stesso sesso: matrimonio egualitario, accesso alle adozioni per persone single e per le coppie dello stesso sesso, accesso ai percorsi di procreazione medicalmente assistita per donne e coppie di donne, riconoscimento di pari diritti per i figli e le figlie con genitori dello stesso sesso.
responses.translated_justification: A law providing for the extension of the rights and duties of heterosexual couples to same-sex couples: equal marriage, access to adoption for single people and for same-sex couples, access to medically assisted procreation paths for women and female couples, recognition of equal rights for children with same-sex parents.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: bisogna dirigersi verso forme di legalizzazione delle droghe leggere, anche allo scopo di contrastare il predominio illegale delle mafie
responses.translated_justification: It is necessary to move towards legalization of light drugs in order to counter the illegal dominance of mafias.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: Vorrei che, prima o poi, prendessimo tutti insieme la consapevolezza che – conclude Fratoianni – continuare a gestire con reazioni e cultura di impianto emergenziale un fenomeno strutturale non funzionerà, a prescindere da quello che pensiamo delle politiche migratorie; non funzionerà con voi, non funzionava prima, continuerà a non funzionare e sarà un problema per i migranti, per i loro diritti, per gli italiani e le italiane e, più in generale, per un’Europa che, anche su questo, si gioca l’osso del collo, cioè la possibilità di avere un futuro credibile e dignitoso nel mondo che abbiamo di fronte.
responses.translated_justification: I would like us all to become aware, sooner or later, that - as Fratoianni concludes - continuing to manage a structural phenomenon with emergency reactions and culture will not work, regardless of what we think of migration policies; it will not work for you, it did not work before, it will continue not to work, and it will be a problem for migrants, for their rights, for Italians and Italian women, and more generally, for a Europe that, on this too, is playing for its future, that is, the possibility of having a credible and dignified future in the world we are facing.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: Il diritto all’aborto purtroppo da anni è messo in discussione, e i numeri e la cronaca evidenziano come nel nostro Paese non sia sempre garantito. Le relazioni al Parlamento sono importantissime per avere un quadro preciso dell’applicazione, o della sua mancata applicazione, su tutto il territorio nazionale. Tra medici e personale medico obiettori di coscienza, intere zone senza più medici che la praticano, un ancora limitato ricorso al metodo farmacologico e alla contraccezione d’emergenza che sarebbe opportuno incrementare per ridurre il ricorso all’IVG tradizionale e la ridotta operatività delle reti dei consultori, oggi nel nostro Paese ricorrere all’interruzione volontaria è diventato un percorso ad ostacoli per le donne. Un percorso che mina il diritto di scelta e di autodeterminazione delle donne. (I. Cucchi - Sinistra Italiana)
responses.translated_justification: The right to abortion has unfortunately been questioned for years, and the numbers and news clearly show that it is not always guaranteed in our country. Reports to Parliament are of paramount importance for having a precise picture of its application, or of its non-application, throughout the national territory. Between doctors and medical personnel who are objectors of conscience, entire areas without doctors who practice it, a still limited use of the pharmacological method and of emergency contraception which should be increased in order to reduce the recourse to traditional IVG and the reduced operativity of the consultation networks, today in our country resorting to voluntary interruption has become an obstacle course for women. An obstacle course that undermines the right to choose and self-determination of women.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: Sulla base di alcuni presupposti: il nodo migranti non è una questione emergenziale ma strutturale, non si può affrontare con modelli militari o polizieschi ma va gestito con un sistema di accoglienza ben strutturato.
responses.translated_justification: Based on some assumptions: the migrant issue is not an emergency but a structural one, it cannot be addressed with military or police models but must be managed with a well-structured reception system.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: adozione di un piano straordinario per l’occupazione femminile e politiche e misure efficaci per le imprese femminili; interventi contro la disparità economica e nell’accesso alle risorse ed alle opportunità;
responses.translated_justification: adoption of an extraordinary plan for female employment and effective policies and measures for women-owned businesses; interventions against economic disparity and access to resources and opportunities;
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: Non c’è alcun dubbio sul fatto che l’incremento del trasporto pubblico (possibilmente elettrico) porterebbe a un grande miglioramento della qualità dell’aria, nonché a grandi risparmi nel consumo di combustibili fossili (benzina, diesel) per il traffico privato. Per quanto riguarda quest’ultimo [...] Il sistema di incentivi auto va rimodulato a sostegno dell’acquisto di sole auto elettriche e indirizzando progressivamente gli incentivi alle vetture più efficienti e alle sole utilitarie, solo per la prima auto e modulati in base al reddito.
responses.translated_justification: There is no doubt that an increase in public transportation (preferably electric) would lead to a significant improvement in air quality, as well as to substantial savings in the consumption of fossil fuels (gasoline, diesel) for private traffic. As for the latter, [...] the car incentive system needs to be restructured to support the purchase of only electric cars and progressively steer incentives towards the most efficient vehicles and solely for the first car, calibrated based on income.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification: Abbiamo ancora negli occhi il disastro climatico che si è abbattuto sulla Toscana qualche settimana fa [...] E Meloni ha ancora il coraggio di parlare di ambientalismo ideologico. Ideologico e anche stupido è continuare a puntare su gas e petrolio e ostacolare le rinnovabili. Ideologico e anche stupido è far credere che il nucleare pulito sia a portata di mano. La situazione che viviamo richiede molto più pragmatismo: il clima sta cambiando definitivamente, a causa di un sistema economico sbagliato, quindi bisogna subito cambiare sistema.
responses.translated_justification: We still have in our eyes the climate disaster that struck Tuscany a few weeks ago [...] And Meloni still has the nerve to talk about ideological environmentalism. Ideological and also stupid is to continue to focus on gas and oil and hinder renewables. Ideological and also stupid is to make believe that clean nuclear power is within reach. The situation we are experiencing requires much more pragmatism: the climate is changing definitively, due to a wrong economic system, so we need to change the system immediately.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: La maggioranza di governo ha messo in campo un gigantesco teatro, con un obiettivo molto semplice che è bene che gli italiani abbiano chiaro: quello di cancellare dalla memoria collettiva e anche dal racconto pubblico quello che è accaduto ieri in Europa, un gigantesco danno per il Paese, una firma sotto la riforma dl Patto di stabilità e crescita che per l'Italia rappresenta un gigantesco macigno. Significa il ritorno dell'austerità, significano penalizzazioni per un paese nelle nostre condizioni. Questo è il cuore della vicenda. (N. Fratoianni - Sinistra Italiana)
responses.translated_justification: The government majority has staged a huge theater, with a very simple objective that it is important for Italians to understand: that is, to erase from collective memory and also from the public narrative what happened yesterday in Europe, a giant damage for the Country, a signature under the reform of the Stability and Growth Pact which represents a giant stumbling block for Italy. It means the return of austerity, it means penalties for a country in our conditions. This is the heart of the matter.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: Bisogna definire regole e strumenti fiscali europei volti a compensare gli squilibri economici e fermare veri e propri paradisi fiscali che operano dentro l'Unione. (L'Italia della Pace)
responses.translated_justification: Rules and fiscal tools at the European level must be defined in order to compensate for economic imbalances and stop actual tax havens that operate within the Union.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: 'è giusto che che Google sia privato che Facebook siano privati? O quel potere nel tempo dell'economia dei dati dovrebbe essere oggetto diciamo di di una grande riforma in senso Democratico pubblico capace di rimettere al centro il pubblico come luogo di programmazione dell'interesse generale prima dell'interesse particolare [...] L'Intelligenza artificiale che cosa sarà? come ci porremo di fronte all'urto che produce, non solo perchè cancellerà lavoro come già avviene per la robotizzazione e l'automazione ma perchè lo riscriverà, perchè produrrà nella sua forma generativa avatar di menti come ci è stato raccontato oggi. Ecco io penso che la dimensione minima in cui provare a collocare questo scontro perché di questo si tratta di uno scontro, di un conflitto tra poteri ed interessi enormi, la dimensione minima non può che essere il continente ed è lì che si gioca la possibilità per il continente europeo di avere un futuro e di giocare in quel futuro una funzione progressiva e giusta." 1.44.38 - 1.46.00 Fratoianni IL CORAGGIO DI OSARE! - MILANO (06.04.24)
responses.translated_justification: Is it fair that Google and Facebook are private? Or should that power in the era of the data economy be subject to, let's say, a great democratic reform capable of putting the public first as a place for programming the general interest before the particular interest [...] What will artificial intelligence be? How will we position ourselves in front of the shock it produces, not only because it will erase work as it is already happening with robotization and automation, but because it will rewrite it, because in its generative form it will produce avatars of minds as told to us today. I think that the minimum dimension in which to try to place this conflict, because that is what it is, a clash of powers and interests of enormous dimensions, the minimum dimension cannot be anything but the continent, and it is there that the possibility for the European continent to have a future and to play a progressive and fair role in that future is played.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: Bisogna definire regole e strumenti fiscali europei [...]. Occorre mettere a regime la solidarizzazione del debito [...]. (L'Italia della Pace)
responses.translated_justification: Rules and fiscal tools at the European level need to be defined... It is necessary to establish a system of debt solidarity... (Italy of Peace)
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: mezzo milione di aziende agricole hanno chiuso, i prezzi dei prodotti agricoli sono aumentati mentre gli agricoltori si sono impoveriti a causa della stretta, del ricatto, che la grande distribuzione sta facendo nei loro confronti. Acquistano prodotti agricoli dall'estero a basso costo e impongono prezzi bassi agli agricoltori italiani [...] nessuno dice nulla ad esempio della riforma delle politiche agricole europee (la PAC) che ha fortemente penalizzato i piccoli agricoltori e aiutato le grandi multinazionali agricole ANGELO BONELLI
responses.translated_justification: Half a million farm businesses have closed, the prices of agricultural products have increased while farmers have impoverished, due to the stranglehold and blackmail that large-scale retail is exerting on them. They purchase agricultural products from abroad at low cost and impose low prices on Italian farmers [...] for example, no one is saying anything about the reform of agricultural policies in Europe (the Common Agricultural Policy) which has strongly penalized small farmers and helped large agricultural multinationals
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: Vogliamo che l’Europa abbia una politica estera e di difesa comune.
responses.translated_justification: We want Europe to have a common foreign and defense policy.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Promuovere la costruzione di un Piano Europeo per le migrazioni che preveda il superamento del sistema di Dublino e parametri uniformi nel sistema di accoglienza basato sul ricollocamento pro quota. (L'Italia che accoglie)
responses.translated_justification: Promote the construction of a European Migration Plan that provides for the overcoming of the Dublin system and uniform parameters in the reception system based on pro-rata relocation.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: Sì, noi siamo fortemente europeisti, anche noi, convintamente europeisti, quindi anche noi siamo dell'idea di un potenziamento dell'Unione Europea, anche sotto il punto di vista [...] di una difesa comune. Siamo d'accordo che anche sotto questo punto di vista dovrebbe esserci una collaborazione tra gli Stati. Se noi mettiamo insieme sotto questo punto di vista ad esempio la spesa di ogni singolo Stato membro dell'Unione Europea, vediamo come i dati siano addirittura superiori anche alla Cina stessa [...] quindi probabilmente se noi riuscissimo ad avere anche una gestione comune [...] probabilmente riusciremo a razionalizzare meglio le risorse, puntando molto di più anche in quelle azioni che già oggi sono previste anche dai trattati rispetto ad azioni di peace keeping però organizzati. (D. Dori - Europa Verde)
responses.translated_justification: Yes, we are strongly pro-European, just like you, convinced pro-Europeans. Therefore, we also believe in strengthening the European Union, including in terms of a common defense. We agree that there should also be collaboration between States in this regard. If we combine the spending of each individual member State of the European Union, we see that the figures are even higher than those of China itself... Therefore, if we could achieve a common management... we would probably be able to optimize resources better, focusing more on actions that are already provided for in the treaties regarding peacekeeping but better organized.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: Bisogna creare canali di migrazione legali e sicuri, abolendo quelle leggi come la Bossi-Fini che costringono all'irregolarità. [...] Contrastiamo qualsiasi forma di criminalizzazione dell'aiuto e della solidarietà. Lavoreremo per garantire piena agibilità e sostegno a chi è impegnato nell'accoglienza (sia nel paese che nelle rotte migratorie) e nel salvataggio. Crediamo inoltre che vada rirpistinata una missione pubblica (italiana ed europea) di salvataggio in mare. (L'Italia che accoglie)
responses.translated_justification: We need to create channels for legal and safe migration, abolishing laws like Bossi-Fini that force irregularity. [...] We will counter any form of criminalization of help and solidarity. We will work to ensure full mobility and support for those involved in welcoming (in the country and in migratory routes) and in rescue efforts. We also believe that a public (Italian and European) mission of sea rescue should be reinstated. (Italy that welcomes)
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Serve un piano industriale per la mobilità elettrica al 2030 che punti a un obiettivo di veicoli elettrici circolanti di almeno 10 milioni di unità e dotarsi di 100 mila punti di ricarica pubblica. Il sistema di incentivi auto va rimodulato a sostegno dell’acquisto di sole auto elettriche e indirizzando progressivamente gli incentivi alle vetture più efficienti e alle sole utilitarie, solo per la prima auto e modulati in base al reddito.
responses.translated_justification: A industrial plan for electric mobility by 2030 is needed, targeting an objective of at least 10 million circulating electric vehicles and equipping itself with 100,000 public charging points. The auto incentive system has to be revised to support the purchase of only electric vehicles, progressively directing incentives toward the most efficient vehicles and towards utility vehicles, only for the first car and modulated according to income.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: Noi l’abbiamo detto dal primo minuto, ed eravamo soli: la logica delle armi porta a una escalation militare senza fine. E ora siamo in un vicolo cieco. [...] pensare di arrivare al 2% del pil in spese militari è una follia.
responses.translated_justification: We have been saying it from the very beginning, and we were alone: the logic of weapons leads to an endless military escalation. And now we are at a dead end. [...] Thinking of reaching 2% of GDP in military expenses is madness.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: Sì noi siamo fortemente europeisti anche noi, convintamente europeisti, quindi anche noi siamo dell'idea di un potenziamento dell'Unione Europea. (D. Dori - Europa Verde)
responses.translated_justification: Yes, we are strongly pro-European, and we are convinced Europeans, so we also believe in the strengthening of the European Union.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: Bisogna lavorare affinché il processo democratico dell'Unione venga rafforzato nella sua dimensione sovranazionale , a partire da una centralità maggiore del Parlamento europeo e superando il meccanismo dei veti nazionali (L'Italia della Pace)
responses.translated_justification: It is necessary to work so that the democratic process of the Union is strengthened in its supranational dimension, starting from a greater centrality of the European Parliament and overcoming the mechanism of national vetoes (Italy of Peace).
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.justification: Vogliamo un'Europa intransigente sui valori della democrazia, sullo Stato di diritto e sui diritti civili e pensiamo che bisogna applicare fino in fondo la condizionalità finanziaria verso quei paesi che in questi anni hanno attuato arretramenti rofondi su questo terreno. (L'Italia della Pace)
responses.translated_justification: We want an uncompromising Europe on the values of democracy, the rule of law, and civil rights, and we believe that full financial conditionality should be applied to those countries that have made significant setbacks in these areas in recent years. (Italy for Peace)
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: pensare di arrivare al 2% del pil in spese militari è una follia. (N. Fratoianni - Sinistra Italiana)
responses.translated_justification: To think about reaching 2% of GDP in military spending is madness.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: Una política fiscal y de inversión para garantizar servicios públicos modernos para la gran mayoría de la sociedad. Seguiremos orientando la política de inversiones y el sistema fiscal para crear incentivos al trabajo, la innovación, el cumplimiento de la regulación y el despliegue de la nueva economía verde.
responses.translated_justification: A fiscal and investment policy to ensure modern public services for the vast majority of society. We will continue to direct the investment policy and fiscal system to create incentives for work, innovation, regulatory compliance, and the deployment of the new green economy.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification:
Impulsaremos con los agentes sociales un Pacto por el Pleno Empleo para acelerar el círculo virtuoso de formación y colocación y, de ese modo, aprovechar el impulso de la inversión con los fondos europeos Next Generation, alinear los niveles de desempleo al 8% de paro estructural en línea con la media europea, con los siguientes componentes:
- Reforma de los sistemas de protección activa para los parados de larga duración y refuerzo de los incentivos al empleo de beneficiarios de subsidios y del Ingreso Mínimo Vital.
- Con el fin de impulsar la formación en el empleo para los jóvenes, garantizándoles una protección adecuada con un Plan de Choque contra el desempleo juvenil con el mecanismo Pack “formación + empleo” en 12 meses.
- Reforzaremos los mecanismos de protección activa mediante la adecuada articulación de los subsidios y los mecanismos de inclusión social, favoreciendo el reciclaje y la formación y los programas de inserción de la juventud para lograr eliminar el paro de larga duración y lograr el pleno empleo efectivo.
responses.translated_justification: We will promote, together with social agents, a Pact for Full Employment to accelerate the virtuous circle of training and placement, and in this way, take advantage of the impulse of the investment with the Next Generation European funds, align the unemployment levels to the 8% structural unemployment rate in line with the European average, with the following components: - Reform of the active protection systems for long-term unemployed people and reinforcement of the employment incentives for beneficiaries of allowances and Minimum Vital Income. - With the aim of promoting on-the-job training for young people, guaranteeing them appropriate protection with a Shock Plan against youth unemployment with the "training + employment
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification:
La sociedad española apuesta por unos servicios públicos fuertes, modernos y eficaces, que den respuesta a las necesidades y expectativas de la clase media y trabajadora. Financiar el estado del bienestar no es un lujo que no nos podamos permitir. Tenemos la memoria y la experiencia de lo que ocurrió en la anterior crisis financiera, cuando se impuso una política de recortes que debilitó lo público y mermó la sanidad, la educación y la dependencia.
El estado del bienestar es la red de seguridad de la ciudadanía, la garantía de la igualdad de oportunidades y el vector de la cohesión social y territorial de España. Pero también es un potente motor de nuestra economía, con un impacto claro en la generación de empleo de calidad directo e indirecto y en la aportación de valor añadido a través de la innovación pública.
responses.translated_justification: The Spanish society bets on strong, modern and efficient public services, which respond to the needs and expectations of the middle and working classes. Financing the welfare state is not a luxury that we cannot afford. We have the memory and experience of what happened during the previous financial crisis, when a policy of cuts was imposed that weakened the public sphere and undermined healthcare, education, and dependency. The welfare state is the safety net of citizenship, the guarantee of equal opportunities and the vector of social and territorial cohesion in Spain. But it is also a powerful motor of our economy, with a clear impact on the generation of quality direct and indirect employment and on the added value contribution through public innovation.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: Por ello a lo largo de esta legislatura hemos impulsado una política fiscal acorde a los principios constitucionales de equidad y progresividad, de manera de las mayores rentas y patrimonios, así como los grupos multinacionales y grandes empresas, contribuyan en mayor medida mientras que los más desfavorecidos reciben el mayor nivel de ayuda protegidos por el escudo social.
responses.translated_justification: Therefore, throughout this legislative term we have promoted a fiscal policy in line with the constitutional principles of equity and progressiveness, so that the higher incomes and wealth, as well as multinational corporations and large companies, contribute more, while the most disadvantaged receive the highest level of assistance protected by the social shield.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification:
Desarrollaremos nuevas modalidades de jubilación parcial y activa, para dar más flexibilidad y mejores oportunidades en una salida progresiva y voluntaria del mercado de trabajo.
- Tras haber sentado las bases para un mercado de trabajo con menor rotación y mayor estabilidad, necesitamos políticas que potencien la complementariedad entre el trabajo de los más mayores y los más jóvenes.
responses.translated_justification: We will develop new forms of partial and active retirement, in order to provide more flexibility and better opportunities for a gradual and voluntary departure from the labor market. - After having laid the foundation for a labor market with less turnover and greater stability, we need policies that enhance the complementarity between the work of older and younger people.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification:
Planas (Ministro de Agricultura del PSOE) también ha mostrado, una vez más, su rechazo a la idea de imponer topes a los precios de los alimentos: “No me parecen correctos los topes, porque no solo no son posibles legalmente, sino que económicamente perjudicarían mucho a la cadena alimentaria y sobre todo al sector primario.”
La propuesta de Podemos para bonificar en un 14% los precios de hasta 20 productos de la cesta de la compra ante la escalada de precios, como se hacía hasta diciembre con la gasolina, ha avivado aún más la polémica en torno al extraordinario encarecimiento de los alimentos. La medida ha sido cuestionada este jueves por la ministra de Hacienda, María Jesús Montero, que duda de su viabilidad. Otros dos Ministerios del ala socialista del Gobierno, Economía y Agricultura, han defendido que, de momento, hay que dar tiempo para que surta efecto la bajada del IVA de algunos alimentos.
responses.translated_justification: Planas (Minister of Agriculture of the PSOE) has once again expressed his rejection of the idea of imposing price caps on food: 'I don't think price caps are appropriate, because they are not possible legally, and economically they would harm the food chain and the agricultural sector in particular.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification:
Lucha contra la discriminación y en favor de los derechos humanos:
- Blindaremos el matrimonio igualitario, el derecho a la interrupción voluntaria del embarazo,[...], como derechos fundamentales de las personas, de modo que no puedan ser derogados o anulados por una coyuntural mayoría parlamentaria.
Si durante el gobierno de Zapatero las personas del colectivo LGTBI dejaron de ser ciudadanía de segunda y vieron reconocidos sus derechos constitucionales y civiles (igualdad, matrimonio, propia identidad…), gracias al gobierno de Pedro Sánchez se ha construido un amplio aparato legislativo para impulsar el derecho al ejercicio de la plena ciudadanía, libre de discriminación y con independencia de la orientación, la identidad sexual y la expresión de género.
responses.translated_justification: Fight against discrimination and in favor of human rights: - We will reinforce marriage equality, the right to voluntary interruption of pregnancy, [...] as fundamental rights of people, so that they cannot be repealed or annulled by a parliamentary majority that happens to be in power at a given time. During the government of Zapatero, individuals from the LGTBI collective ceased to be second-class citizens and saw their constitutional and civil rights (equality, marriage, own identity...), recognized, thanks to the government of Pedro Sánchez, a comprehensive legislative framework has been built to promote the right to full citizenship, free of discrimination, and independent of sexual orientation, sexual identity, and gender expression.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: El Congreso ha rechazado, por segunda vez en esta legislatura, la regulación integral del cannabis para su uso terapéutico y recreativo, al votar PSOE, PP, Vox y Foro en contra. Hace año y medio, el Congreso debatió otra iniciativa similar, esta vez de Más País, que también fue rechazada por PSOE, PP y Vox. Desde el PSOE, Alfredo Sancho Guardia se ha mostrado en contra de mezclar el debate de la regulación terapéutica y recreativa del cannabis: "Siempre hemos tratado desde el primer momento de no confundir los usos". "Siempre hemos defendido que son dos debates distintos, uno va a ayudar a la calidad de vida de miles de pacientes que sufren dolor y el otro no", ha insistido el diputado socialista.
responses.translated_justification: The Congress has rejected, for the second time in this legislature, the comprehensive regulation of cannabis for therapeutic and recreational use, by voting PSOE, PP, Vox and Foro against it. A year and a half ago, the Congress debated another similar proposal, this time from Más País, which was also rejected by PSOE, PP and Vox. From the PSOE, Alfredo Sancho Guardia has shown his opposition to mixing the debate on therapeutic and recreational regulation of cannabis: 'We have always tried from the outset not to confuse uses.' 'We have always defended that they are two different debates, one will help improve the quality of life of thousands of patients who suffer from pain and the other will not,' insisted the socialist deputy.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: Hay que fomentar que la participación ciudadana de las personas migrantes sea fluida, y que a su vez éstas aporten su riqueza cultural, para que la población de acogida entienda los valores que aporta la interculturalidad al desarrollo de las sociedades. Entendemos la integración como un proceso bidireccional de adaptación mutua, que requiere la participación de toda la ciudadanía: personas inmigrantes y personas españolas. Estas políticas de integración deben prestar una especial atención a los hijos e hijas de inmigrantes.
responses.translated_justification: It is necessary to promote the smooth participation of migrant persons in citizenship, and in turn they contribute their cultural wealth, so that the host population understands the values that interculturality brings to the development of societies. We understand integration as a bidirectional process of mutual adaptation, which requires the participation of all citizens: immigrant persons and Spanish persons. These integration policies should pay special attention to the sons and daughters of immigrants.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification:
Debemos garantizar la IVE en igualdad de condiciones en todas las Comunidades así como la información y garantía de la elección y la disponibilidad de acceder a los dos métodos mediante los cuales se lleva a cabo la prestación: el método quirúrgico y el farmacológico. Con el gobierno de Pedro Sánchez hemos recuperado el derecho a la interrupción voluntaria del embarazo para las mujeres de 16 y 17 años y puesto fin a los tres días de reflexión. Lucha contra la discriminación y en favor de los derechos humanos:
- Blindaremos el matrimonio igualitario, el derecho a la interrupción voluntaria del embarazo,[...], como derechos fundamentales de las personas, de modo que no puedan ser derogados o anulados por una coyuntural mayoría parlamentaria.
responses.translated_justification: We must ensure the right to voluntary interruption of pregnancy (IVE) on an equal basis in all Communities, as well as information and the guarantee of the choice and availability to access the two methods by which it is carried out: the surgical method and the pharmacological method. With the government of Pedro Sánchez we have recovered the right to the interruption of voluntary pregnancy for women aged 16 and 17 and put an end to the three days of reflection. Fight against discrimination and in favor of human rights: - We will protect marriage equality, the right to voluntary interruption of pregnancy, [..], as fundamental rights of people, so that they cannot be derogated or annulled by a parliamentary majority that is merely circumstantial.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: Adecuada integración de las personas migrantes con una política migratoria sustentada en el control de las fronteras y el respeto a los derechos humanos.
responses.translated_justification: Appropriate integration of migrant persons with a migration policy based on border control and respect for human rights.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification:
Impulsaremos la aprobación de la Ley Orgánica de Representación Paritaria de Mujeres y Hombres en los Órganos de Decisión, que garantizará la igualdad efectiva en la toma de decisiones política, de la administración y de las empresas:
- Paridad en las listas electorales
- Paridad en el ámbito político
- Paridad en los consejos de administración
- Paridad en los colegios profesionales
- Paridad en tribunales, jurados y órganos colegiados
responses.translated_justification: We will promote the approval of the Organic Law of Parity Representation of Women and Men in Decision-Making Bodies, which will ensure effective equality in political, administrative and business decision-making: - Parity in electoral lists - Parity in the political sphere - Parity in company boards of directors - Parity in professional colleges - Parity in courts, juries and collegiate bodies.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification:
Avanzaremos en la fiscalidad verde, contribuyendo al compromiso de nuestro país con la emergencia climática y con el futuro de nuestros jóvenes. Una fiscalidad verde bajo la premisa de “quien contamina paga”, que irá acompañada de medidas compensatorias, bien en la imposición directa o bien en las políticas de gasto, para incentivar los cambios necesarios entre las clases media y trabajadora. Crearemos un fondo estatal de contribución a la movilidad sostenible, con fuentes estables de financiación, que plasme nuestra idea de que el Estado debe mejorar eficientemente el transporte público urbano y metropolitano:
- Financiará servicios de transporte y movilidad que cumplan determinados requisitos de sostenibilidad.
- El protagonista de nuestra movilidad diaria debe ser el transporte público. Con este fondo priorizaremos inversiones eficientes en la red local y autonómica de autobús, metro, metro ligero, ferrocarril o tranvía.
responses.translated_justification: We will move forward with green taxation, contributing to the commitment of our country to the climate emergency and to the future of our young people. Green taxation will be based on the principle of "the polluter pays,
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification:
- Aprobaremos una ley para identificar, junto a las comunidades autónomas y las entidades locales, las áreas idóneas para el desarrollo de renovables y facilitar el acceso de los beneficios a las comunidades locales, garantizando el respeto al medio ambiente.
- Impulsaremos la innovación en el sector energético a través del fomento de las nuevas tecnologías necesarias para la descarbonización de la energía, como el almacenamiento energético, la gestión de la demanda, así como el hidrógeno renovable y otros gases renovables.
- Fomentaremos, en el seno de la Unión Europea, las reformas del mercado eléctrico necesarias para poder trasladar el beneficio de las energías renovables a los consumidores y proporcionar la estabilidad necesaria para atraer a los inversores.
responses.translated_justification: - We will approve a law to identify, together with the autonomous communities and local entities, the suitable areas for the development of renewable energies and facilitate the access of benefits to local communities, ensuring respect for the environment. - We will promote innovation in the energy sector through the promotion of new technologies necessary for the decarbonization of energy, such as energy storage, demand management, as well as renewable hydrogen and other renewable gases. - We will promote, within the European Union, the necessary market reforms for the electricity sector in order to transfer the benefits of renewable energies to consumers, and to provide the necessary stability to attract investors.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: Impulsaremos una reforma de las reglas fiscales europeas que permita conjugar la estabilidad presupuestaria a lo largo del ciclo y la consolidación de la deuda pública con el crecimiento económico, la creación de empleo y la agenda de inversiones sociales, verdes y digitales. Estas reglas fiscales deben acometerse a través de planes nacionales adaptados a la realidad de cada Estado miembro.
responses.translated_justification: We will promote a reform of the European fiscal rules that allows us to balance budgetary stability throughout the cycle and the consolidation of public debt with economic growth, job creation, and the social, green, and digital investment agenda. These fiscal rules should be implemented through national plans adapted to the reality of each Member State.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: El PSOE recoge firmas para impulsar un impuesto en Europa a las grandes fortunas.
responses.translated_justification: The PSOE collects signatures to promote a wealth tax in Europe on large fortunes.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: Apoyaremos a nivel global un marco adecuado de regulación y supervisión de la inteligencia artificial, que impulse la innovación, pero proteja nuestra seguridad, derechos y valores democráticos. Apoyaremos la creación de mecanismos de supervisión de algoritmos a nivel europeo e impulsaremos la creación de una Agencia Internacional de Regulación de la Inteligencia Artificial.
responses.translated_justification: We will support on a global level an appropriate framework of regulation and supervision of artificial intelligence that promotes innovation, but protects our security, rights, and democratic values. We will support the creation of monitoring mechanisms for algorithms at the European level and will promote the creation of an International Artificial Intelligence Regulation Agency.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: Apoyaremos un refuerzo del presupuesto europeo con nuevos recursos propios que garanticen una financiación suficiente para los programas y acciones de la UE.
responses.source:
https://www.psoe.es/media-content/2023/07/PROGRAMA_ELECTORAL-GENERALES-2023.pdf#%5B%7B%22num%22%3A47%2C%22gen%22%3A0%7D%2C%7B%22name%22%3A%22XYZ%22%7D%2C82%2C567%2C0%5D
Lina Gálvez Múñoz (Eurodiputada con el PSOE): "La existencia del Euro, de una moneda común, es posiblemente uno de los mayores y más costosos logros de la Unión Europea."
responses.translated_justification: We will support a reinforcement of the European budget with new own resources that ensure sufficient funding for the EU's programs and actions.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: Ante el convulso panorama actual de los mercados internacionales, apostamos decididamente por aumentar la diversificación de las cadenas de suministro y de los mercados de exportación de España y la UE y por promover relaciones comerciales abiertas, predecibles y transparentes, evitando restricciones injustificadas al comercio. Defensa ante la UE de un mayor control de las importaciones para que los productos importados cumplan los mismos estándares ambientales, sociales y laborales que los productores europeos.
responses.translated_justification: Faced with the current volatile scenario of international markets, we decisively bet on increasing the diversification of Spain and the EU's supply chains and export markets, and on promoting open, predictable, and transparent commercial relations, avoiding unjustified restrictions to trade. We defend before the EU a greater control of imports so that imported products meet the same environmental, social, and labor standards as European producers.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: Impulsaremos la toma de decisiones en política exterior y de seguridad común por mayoría cualificada.
responses.translated_justification: We will promote qualified majority decision-making in common foreign and security policy.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Trabajaremos para conseguir a nivel europeo la adopción de un nuevo Pacto de Migración y Asilo, que esté en línea con los valores de dignidad humana y solidaridad establecidos en nuestros tratados.
responses.translated_justification: We will work to achieve at the European level the adoption of a new Pact on Migration and Asylum, which is in line with the values of human dignity and solidarity established in our treaties.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: El presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, ha advertido este miércoles de la necesidad de reforzar la “industria de seguridad y defensa” del país para “garantizar la seguridad” de Europa. “El continente registra un déficit en Defensa de 56.000 millones de euros”, ha advertido.
responses.translated_justification: The President of the Government, Pedro Sánchez, warned this Wednesday of the need to strengthen the "security and defense industry" of the country to "guarantee the security" of Europe. "The continent records a defense deficit of 56,000 million euros," he warned.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: La UE aprueba un refuerzo de Frontex que no convence a España e Italia. España no quiere ceder competencias a la UE en materia de controles fronterizos, rechaza que la UE se inmiscuya en la gestión de su frontera con Marruecos.
responses.translated_justification: The EU approves a reinforcement of Frontex that does not convince Spain and Italy. Spain does not want to cede competences to the EU in terms of border controls, rejects that the EU interferes in the management of its border with Morocco.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Los eurodiputados españoles del PSOE votarán este miércoles en el Parlamento Europeo a favor de la propuesta de poner fin a la venta de turismos y vehículos comerciales nuevos con motor de combustión en el año 2035, mientras que el PP se posicionará en contra, ya que considera que para ese año se debería llegar al 90% de dicho objetivo de reducción de emisiones y no al 100%.
