responses.translated_justification: Spanish MEPs from the PSOE will vote this Wednesday in the European Parliament in favor of the proposal to end the sale of new cars and commercial vehicles with a combustion engine in 2035, while the PP will take a stance against it because they believe that by that year, the goal of reducing emissions should be 90% instead of 100%.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: Sánchez plantea que Europa no se puede permitir que Putin gane la guerra en Ucrania. Ha augurado que, si Europa no refuerza su apoyo a Ucrania, este país perderá posiciones “en primavera”, y ha expresado un temor: “La vigilancia rusa va a ir in crescendo, con más ciberataques a nuestras infraestructuras críticas, con más campañas de desinformación para polarizar nuestras democracias, con más intentos de desestabilización en Moldavia, en los Balcanes Occidentales, en Georgia, en Libia y en el Sahel”. Con estos argumentos, Sánchez ha defendido los 5.000 millones de euros adicionales de apoyo a Ucrania y el nuevo programa de desarrollo militar con 1.500 millones de euros que ha aprobado el Consejo Europeo.
responses.translated_justification: Sánchez argues that Europe cannot afford for Putin to win the war in Ukraine. He has predicted that, if Europe does not strengthen its support for Ukraine, this country will lose positions "in the spring,
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: Seguiremos apoyando el proceso de adhesión a Europa de los países de los Balcanes Occidentales, dando un impulso con la celebración, durante la Presidencia española del Consejo de la UE, de la reunión ministerial UE-Balcanes Occidentales.
responses.translated_justification: We will continue to support the accession process to Europe of the Western Balkan countries, providing a boost by holding, during the Spanish Presidency of the Council of the EU, the EU-Western Balkans ministerial meeting.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: Impulsaremos la toma de decisiones en política exterior y de seguridad común por mayoría cualificada.
responses.translated_justification: We will promote qualified majority decision-making in common foreign and security policy.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.justification: Seguiremos apoyando a Ucrania en su defensa de la paz, la libertad, su soberanía e integridad territorial y trabajaremos para lograr la paz. Seguiremos acompañándola en su camino hacia la integración europea.
responses.translated_justification: We will continue to support Ukraine in its defense of peace, freedom, its sovereignty and territorial integrity and we will work to achieve peace. We will continue to accompany it on its path towards European integration.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: Sánchez ha trasladado una visión muy inquietante de la situación de inestabilidad del mundo, que le ha llevado a defender un aumento del gasto en defensa. “En este contexto internacional tan delicado, para garantizar nuestra seguridad, para disuadir a quienes no comparten nuestro proyecto de paz y de democracia que es Europa, los europeos tendremos que reforzar también nuestra industria de la seguridad y de la defensa”
responses.translated_justification: Sánchez has conveyed a very worrying vision of the situation of instability in the world, which has led him to defend an increase in defense spending. "In this delicate international context, to guarantee our security, to deter those who do not share our project of peace and democracy, which is Europe, Europeans will have to strengthen our security and defense industry as well.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: En esta legislatura, la Administración pública ha sufrido presiones indebidas por parte del Ejecutivo. Además, su estructura se ha tenido que adaptar a las necesidades políticas del Gobierno más costoso de la democracia, que no solo ha incrementado innecesariamente el número de ministerios para dar cabida a los socios de la coalición, sino que ha multiplicado funciones y gastos. Desde el Partido Popular nos comprometemos a revertirlo recuperando el principio de Buena Administración, afrontando una reducción del número de ministerios, altos cargos y asesores, y una bajada del gasto burocrático e improductivo.
responses.translated_justification: During this legislature, the public administration has suffered improper pressures from the Executive. Additionally, its structure has had to adapt to the political needs of the most expensive government of democracy, which has not only increased unnecessarily the number of ministries to accommodate coalition partners, but has also multiplied functions and expenses. From the Popular Party, we are committed to reversing this situation by recovering the principle of Good Administration, facing a reduction in the number of ministries, high-ranking officials, and advisors, and a decrease in unproductive bureaucratic spending.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: El PP votó en contra del decreto que aumentaba la cuantía del subsidio mínimo por desempleo a los 570 euros al mes (desde los 480 euros actuales).
responses.translated_justification: The PP voted against the decree that increased the amount of the minimum unemployment subsidy to 570 euros per month (from the current 480 euros).
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: Para el presidente de los populares, no es "razonable" tener la mayor presión fiscal de nuestra historia, con 58.000 millones de euros más pagados por los españoles en el impuesto sobre la renta en los últimos cinco años. Además, el líder del PP criticó el "tener el Gobierno más caro" con 22 ministros, un gasto "burocrático indecente" y un "déficit descontrolado" con 200 millones de euros de deuda pública al día.
responses.translated_justification: For the president of the People's Party, it is not "reasonable
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: El líder del PP, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, ha calificado este miércoles en las jornadas del Cercle d’Economia en Barcerlona de “injusto” el impuesto sobre el patrimonio avanzando que lo primero que haría si fuese presidente del Gobierno es devolverlo a las comunidades autónomas y, además, ha sugerido que eliminaría los impuestos a la banca y a las eléctricas, todo ello conteniendo al mismo tiempo la deuda.
responses.translated_justification: The leader of the PP, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, described this Wednesday at the Cercle d'Economia event in Barcelona as "unfair
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification: El portavoz de la dirección, Borja Sémper, ha criticado este lunes las diferencias en el Gobierno de coalición sobre las medidas a adoptar para controlar la inflación o, por lo menos, abaratar el coste para quienes van al supermercado. Pero preguntado por el planteamiento de la también ministra de Derechos Sociales, Sémper ha zanjado: “Los lugares donde se han intervenido los precios uy la economía se han generado más problemas que beneficios”.
responses.translated_justification: The spokesperson for the management, Borja Sémper, criticized this Monday the differences in the coalition government regarding the measures to be adopted to control inflation or, at least, reduce the cost for those who go to the supermarket. However, when asked about the proposal of the also Minister of Social Rights, Sémper concluded: "Places where prices or the economy have been intervened have generated more problems than benefits."
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: LUCHAREMOS CONTRA TODO TIPO DE DISCRIMINACIÓN, con nuevos protocolos educativos con el fin de que ningún menor sufra exclusión o humillación alguna. Además, impulsaremos cambios en el código penal y campañas de sensibilización en todos los estamentos de la sociedad, también entre los empleados públicos.
responses.translated_justification: WE WILL FIGHT AGAINST ANY TYPE OF DISCRIMINATION, with new educational protocols with the aim that no minor suffers from exclusion or humiliation. In addition, we will promote changes in the criminal code and awareness campaigns in all the social estates, also among the public employees.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: El diputado del PP Eduardo Carazo ha pedido a los socialistas que "no cedan ante los socios radicales de su Gobierno" y ha advertido que el consumo de esta sustancia destruye familias y sociedades, informa Efe.
responses.translated_justification: Eduardo Carazo, a member of the People's Party, has asked the socialists not to "yield to the radical partners of their government" and has warned that the consumption of this substance destroys families and societies, reports Efe.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: El Partido Popular ha propuesto la creación de un nuevo programa de “inmigración legal cualificada” basado en un “sistema de puntos” en caso de gobernar tras las elecciones del 23J. El objetivo es premiar “la formación académica, las competencias lingüísticas y la capacidad innovadora” de quienes buscan emigrar a España, según sostiene su programa electoral difundido este martes. A través de este mecanismo, Alberto Núñez Feijóo busca “promover una inmigración basada en la igualdad de oportunidades y el mérito”.
responses.translated_justification: The People's Party has proposed the creation of a new program of 'qualified legal immigration' based on a 'points system' in the event of governing after the elections of 23J. The objective is to reward 'academic training, linguistic skills, and innovative capacity' of those seeking to immigrate to Spain, according to its electoral program disseminated this Tuesday. Through this mechanism, Alberto Núñez Feijóo seeks to 'promote an immigration based on equality of opportunities and merit'.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: INTRODUCIREMOS EN LA LEGISLACIÓN EN MATERIA DE INTERRUPCIÓN VOLUNTARIA DEL EMBARAZO EL CONSENTIMIENTO de los titulares de la patria potestad previo a la realización del aborto en las jóvenes menores de edad.
responses.source:
https://www.pp.es/sites/default/files/documentos/programa_electoral_pp_23j_feijoo_2023.pdf
El portavoz popular dice que el aborto “no es un derecho” y fuentes oficiales del partido sostienen después que sí lo es porque así lo ha reconocido el Tribunal Constitucional.
responses.translated_justification: We will introduce into the legislation on voluntary termination of pregnancy the prior consent of the holders of parental responsibility before performing an abortion in minors.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: AGILIZAREMOS EL CUMPLIMIENTO DE LAS ÓRDENES DE RETORNO de inmigrantes irregulares o expulsión de los que hayan cometido un delito a través de acuerdos mejorados con los países de origen o de tránsito para prevenir amenazas a la seguridad y evitar el efecto “llamada”.
responses.translated_justification: WE WILL FACILITATE THE COMPLIANCE OF RETURN ORDERS for irregular immigrants or expulsion of those who have committed a crime through improved agreements with countries of origin or transit. This is to prevent threats to security and avoid the 'pull' effect.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: El presidente del Partido Popular (PP), Alberto Núñez Feijóo, ha instado al presidente del Gobierno a "no imponer a los demás la paridad, sino a sí mismo", y ha criticado que hayan presentado como una idea novedosa una ley que simplemente cumple con la obligación de trasponer una directiva europea que fue propuesta por el Partido Popular Europeo. Por su parte, Cuca Gamarra, portavoz de los populares, ha añadido que debe ser consensuada en el Parlamento y con los agentes sociales porque afecta a las empresas.
responses.translated_justification: The president of the Popular Party (PP), Alberto Núñez Feijóo, has urged the President of the Government to 'not impose parity on others, but on himself', and has criticized the fact that they have presented as a novel idea a law that simply fulfills the obligation to transpose a European directive that was proposed by the European People's Party. On the other hand, Cuca Gamarra, spokesperson for the popular, has added that it must be agreed upon in Parliament and with social agents because it affects companies.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: Trabajaremos para racionalizar los objetivos y flexibilizar el calendario de aplicación del Pacto Verde Europeo y de la estrategia europea “De la Granja a la Mesa”, impulsando por medidas que sean realizables y sin marcar objetivos inalcanzables.
responses.translated_justification: We will work to rationalize the objectives and flexibilize the application schedule of the European Green Deal and the European strategy 'From Farm to Table', promoting measures that are achievable and without setting unreachable goals.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification: IMPULSAREMOS MEDIDAS DE APOYO Y REFUERZO DEL SECTOR PRIMARIO que ayuden a reducir los costes de la energía, los combustibles y las materias primas, para mantener la rentabilidad de las explotaciones, la calidad de nuestros productos y la excelencia del conjunto del sistema agroalimentario. Trabajaremos para racionalizar los objetivos y flexibilizar el calendario de aplicación del Pacto Verde Europeo y de la estrategia europea “De la Granja a la Mesa”, impulsando por medidas que sean realizables y sin marcar objetivos inalcanzables.
responses.translated_justification: We will promote measures to support and strengthen the primary sector, which will help reduce the cost of energy, fuels and raw materials, in order to maintain the profitability of farms, the quality of our products and the excellence of the entire agri-food system. We will work to rationalize the objectives and flexible the application schedule of the European Green Deal and the European strategy 'From Farm to Fork', promoting measures that are achievable and without setting unreachable goals.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: “No entendí cómo durante cinco años o cuatro en Europa desaparecieron todas las reglas”, dijo Feijoo en los micrófonos de 'La Brújula' de Onda Cero.
responses.translated_justification: I don't understand how during five years or four in Europe all the rules disappeared,
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: Queremos participar activamente en el proceso legislativo de la UE, señalando las prioridades de la autonomía estratégica abierta y planteando para nuestro país una Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial que aproveche todo su potencial, poniendo siempre a la persona en el centro.
responses.translated_justification: We want to actively participate in the EU legislative process, pointing out the priorities of open strategic autonomy and proposing an National Artificial Intelligence Strategy that takes full advantage of its potential, always placing the person at the center.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: DEFENDEREMOS EL REFUERZO DE LAS POLÍTICAS DE COHESIÓN económica, social y territorial a través del presupuesto comunitario.
responses.translated_justification: We will defend the reinforcement of economic, social, and territorial cohesion policies through the community budget.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: El sector primario es un elemento fundamental de la economía española, de la vertebración de nuestro territorio, de nuestra estructura social y de nuestra cultura. Es preciso reconocer y proteger el sistema agroalimentario, con medidas que aseguren su futuro, tanto en el seno de la Unión Europea, como en el escenario global, en el que las cadenas alimentarias están sufriendo fuertes tensiones.
responses.translated_justification: The primary sector is a fundamental element of the Spanish economy, of the vertebration of our territory, of our social structure, and of our culture. It is necessary to recognize and protect the agri-food system, with measures that ensure its future, both within the European Union and in the global scenario, in which food chains are suffering from strong tensions.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: TRABAJAREMOS POR UNA UE CAPAZ DE DEFENDER SUS INTERESES Y PROYECTAR SUS VALORES en el mundo con una sola voz. Europa se juega su futuro fuera de sus fronteras y debe ser capaz de transformase en un actor global eficaz.
responses.translated_justification: WE WILL WORK FOR A EUROPEAN UNION CAPABLE OF DEFENDING ITS INTERESTS AND PROJECTING ITS VALUES in the world with a single voice. Europe is playing its future beyond its borders and must be able to transform itself into an effective global actor.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification:
We also advocate a fundamental change in European asylum law. We are committed to the fundamental right to asylum, but the EU, together with its Member States, must have the right to decide to whom and where is it granted. Anyone applying for asylum in the EU could also be transferred to a safe third country and undergo the asylum process there. Following the successful implementation of the third country concept, we propose to admit into the EU a quota of people in need of protection through annual humanitarian quotas of vulnerable individuals.
También abogamos por un cambio fundamental en la ley de asilo europea. Estamos comprometidos con el derecho fundamental al asilo, pero la UE, junto con sus Estados miembros, debe tener el derecho de decidir a quién y dónde se le concede. Cualquier persona que solicite asilo en la UE también podría ser trasladada a un tercer país seguro y someterse al proceso de asilo allí. Tras la exitosa implementación del concepto de tercer país, proponemos admitir en la UE una cuota de personas necesitadas de protección a través de cuotas humanitarias anuales de individuos vulnerables.
responses.translated_justification: We also advocate for a fundamental change in European asylum law. We are committed to the fundamental right to asylum, but the EU, together with its Member States, must have the right to decide to whom and where it is granted. Any person applying for asylum in the EU could also be transferred to a safe third country and undergo the asylum process there. Following the successful implementation of the third country concept, we propose to admit into the EU a quota of people in need of protection through annual humanitarian quotas of vulnerable individuals.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: ASUMIREMOS UN PAPEL ACTIVO DE ESPAÑA EN LA ALIANZA ATLÁNTICA y en la construcción de la Europa de la Defensa. Cumpliremos el compromiso adquirido por los aliados de destinar un 2% del PIB nacional en seguridad y defensa.
responses.translated_justification: WE WILL TAKE AN ACTIVE ROLE OF SPAIN IN THE NORTH ATLANTIC TREATY ORGANIZATION (NATO) and in the construction of the European Defense. We will fulfill the commitment acquired by the allies to allocate 2% of the national Gross Domestic Product (GDP) to security and defense.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: POTENCIAREMOS LA INSPECCIÓN FRONTERIZA, incrementando el número y formación del personal, impulsando la implantación del nuevo Sistema Europeo de Registro de Entradas y Salidas y del Sistema Europeo de Información y Autorización de Viaje, así como la coordinación y participación en las actividades de FRONTEX. Asimismo, fortaleceremos las capacidades en medios, tecnología y coordinación de la Policía Nacional y la Guardia Civil en la gestión integrada de fronteras, potenciando los cometidos de la Autoridad Nacional de Coordinación para la inmigración irregular.
responses.translated_justification: We will strengthen border inspections, increasing the number and training of personnel, promoting the implementation of the new European Entry and Exit System and the European Travel Information and Authorization System, as well as coordination and participation in FRONTEX activities. We will also reinforce the National Police and Civil Guard's capabilities in terms of means, technology, and coordination in the integrated management of borders, strengthening the responsibilities of the National Coordination Authority for irregular immigration.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Feijoo: "Sería un gravísimo error, poner en riesgo y perder la industria de automoción Europea (en referencia a la pregunta "¿Está de acuerdo la UE en eliminar los coches de combustión en 2035?").
responses.source:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gl7bTIvE9SI&ab_channel=TheObjective
Europe’s biggest conservative force, the European People’s Party, wants to massively bulk up the EU’s external guard force and drop plans to phase out the combustion engine across the bloc by 2035, according to a draft of the party’s manifesto obtained by POLITICO.
La mayor fuerza conservadora de Europa, el Partido Popular Europeo, quiere fortalecer masivamente la fuerza de guardia externa de la UE y abandonar los planes para eliminar gradualmente el motor de combustión en todo el bloque para 2035, según un borrador del manifiesto del partido obtenido por POLITICO.
responses.translated_justification: Feijoo: 'It would be a very serious mistake to put at risk and lose the European automotive industry' (in reference to the question 'Do you agree with the EU to eliminate combustion engines in 2035?').
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.translated_justification: The leader of the PP (People's Party), Alberto Núñez Feijóo, has expressed his support for Spain making a new arms delivery to Ukraine, as announced by the head of the central government, Pedro Sánchez.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.justification: El presidente del Partido Popular, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, ha celebrado el acuerdo alcanzado este jueves por los líderes de la Unión Europea para abrir las negociaciones de adhesión a la UE de Ucrania y Moldavia asegurando que es una "magnífica noticia".
responses.translated_justification: The president of the People's Party, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, has celebrated the agreement reached this Thursday by the leaders of the European Union to open accession negotiations to the EU of Ukraine and Moldova, ensuring that it is "a magnificent news.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.justification: “Hoy un Gobierno europeo va a dejar impunes delitos gravísimos contra el corazón de la UE, entre ellos terrorismo, malversación de dinero público y una declaración de independencia de una parte de un estado miembro”, ha dicho Feijóo sobre el acuerdo, a pesar de que deja fuera los delitos de terrorismo recogidos en la directiva europea al respecto de 2017. “Todos los integrantes de la delegación española nos sentimos reconfortados al sabernos al abrigo de una Europa que no puede permitir que fructifiquen los ataques al estado de derecho y la independencia del Poder Judicial y que un primer ministro europeo consiga su puesto en la impunidad judicial”, ha rematado.
responses.translated_justification: Today, a European government is going to leave grave crimes against the heart of the EU unpunished, including terrorism, embezzlement of public funds and a declaration of independence from a member state's region,' Feijóo said regarding the agreement, despite the fact that it excludes the terrorism crimes listed in the 2017 European directive on the matter. 'All members of the Spanish delegation feel relieved knowing that they are under the wing of a Europe that cannot allow attacks on the rule of law and the independence of the Judicial Power, and a prime minister from a European country will achieve his position with judicial impunity,' he concluded.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: Reforzaremos las Fuerzas Armadas como garantía del prestigio nacional, la disuasión y la defensa ante toda amenaza.
responses.translated_justification: We will strengthen the Armed Forces as a guarantee of national prestige, deterrence, and defense against any threat.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: En VOX pondremos fin al infierno fiscal y burocrático que sufren los españoles bajando radicalmente todos los impuestos y recortando drásticamente el gasto político innecesario para impulsar nuestra competitividad y reforzar nuestras infraestructuras y servicios públicos.
responses.translated_justification: In VOX, we will put an end to the fiscal and bureaucratic hell that Spaniards suffer by radically lowering all taxes and drastically cutting unnecessary political spending to boost our competitiveness and strengthen our infrastructure and public services.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: Conectaremos estrechamente el sistema de enseñanza superior y universitaria y las empresas, y combinaremos el apoyo económico de las prestaciones por desempleo con medidas eficaces de formación y actualización profesional.
responses.source:
https://www.voxespana.es/programa/programa-electoral-vox
La vicepresidenta de Sumar ha repetido en varias ocasiones que “el voto en contra de Vox, PP y Podemos” deja sin subsidio a varios colectivos que ahora hubieran pasado a percibirlo con la nueva regulación y también sin el permiso de lactancia de 28 días que recogía el mismo decreto de reforma. “Han votado que no, en definitiva, a una mejora sustancial de la protección del subsidio por desempleo en nuestro país. La política son hechos, no son palabras”, criticó ya este miércoles Díaz en Onda Cero. “El único motivo real es fastidiar a Yolanda Díaz y hacerlo a costa de los parados españoles”, interpretaba una voz autorizada del Ministerio de Trabajo.
responses.translated_justification: We will closely connect the higher education and university system and businesses, and we will combine financial support from unemployment benefits with effective measures for professional training and updating.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: Para poder llevar a cabo la rebaja radical de impuestos que alivie a las familias españolas, las Administraciones Públicas deben acometer un plan de reducción del gasto político que se fije en la eliminación de las partidas de carácter improductivo, duplicado o meramente ideológico, que en nada benefician al bienestar socioeconómico de las familias españolas.
responses.translated_justification: In order to carry out the radical tax reduction that will relieve Spanish families, Public Administrations must undertake a plan to reduce political spending, focusing on the elimination of items that are unproductive, duplicated, or merely ideological, which in no way benefit the socioeconomic well-being of Spanish families.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: Suprimiremos el Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio, el Impuesto sobre Sucesiones y Donaciones y Plusvalías municipales en todo el territorio nacional, impuestos que suponen confiscaciones injustas, duplicadas o desproporcionadas del patrimonio de los españoles.
responses.translated_justification: We will eliminate the Wealth Tax, the Inheritance and Gift Tax, and Municipal Capital Gains Tax in the entire national territory, taxes that represent unjust, duplicated, or disproportionate confiscations of the Spanish people's assets.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: Vox ve bien la propuesta del Círculo de Empresarios de retrasar la edad de jubilación de forma voluntaria y, a la vez, reivindica la necesidad de una reforma "estructural" del sistema de pensiones para garantizar su viabilidad en las próximas décadas.
responses.translated_justification: Vox welcomes the Círculo de Empresarios' proposal to voluntarily postpone the retirement age and, at the same time, claims the need for a "structural" reform of the pension system to guarantee its sustainability in the coming decades.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification: Proposición no de Ley relativa a la mejora del mercado inmobiliario español a través de medidas como la lucha contra la ocupación, la agilización de los trámites de licencia y obra, la liberación del suelo, incentivos al alquiler, rechazar el control de precios del alquiler y el incremento de vivienda pública.
responses.translated_justification: Non-legislative proposal relating to the improvement of the Spanish real estate market through measures such as the fight against occupation, the streamlining of license and construction procedures, the liberation of land, incentives for renting, the rejection of rental price control and the increase in public housing.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: Paralizaremos la tramitación de la Ley de Familias impulsada desde el Ministerio de Ione Belarra y por la cual la institución familiar queda conscientemente desdibujada por el reconocimiento de dieciséis tipos diferentes de familias, pretendiendo la desnaturalización de la célula básica de la sociedad. Si todo es familia, nada lo es.
responses.translated_justification: We will halt the processing of the Families Act promoted by the Ministry of Ione Belarra, which deliberately blurs the concept of family by recognizing sixteen different types of families, attempting to denaturalize the basic cell of society. If everything is family, then nothing is.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: Promoveremos un estilo de vida saludable, que proporcione a los miembros de las familias las herramientas necesarias para ser libres y no caer en adicciones, cuyas consecuencias para la persona y su familia pueden ser devastadoras.
responses.translated_justification: We will promote a healthy lifestyle that provides family members with the necessary tools to be free and avoid falling into addictions, whose consequences for both the person and their family can be devastating.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: Cualquier persona que quiera venir y permanecer en España en búsqueda de oportunidades debe cumplir la ley y tener una clara voluntad de integración y adaptación. Inmediata expulsión de todos los inmigrantes que accedan ilegalmente a nuestro país. A España solo se entra de forma legal, ordenada y con la voluntad de integrarse y aportar al desarrollo de la Nación.
responses.translated_justification: Any person who wishes to come to and stay in Spain in search of opportunities must comply with the law and have a clear will to integrate and adapt. Immediate expulsion of all immigrants who enter our country illegally. Only legal, orderly entry into Spain is allowed with the will to integrate and contribute to the development of the Nation.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: Defenderemos el derecho a la vida desde su concepción hasta la muerte natural y acabaremos con la cultura de la muerte. Para ello, comenzaremos por la derogación de la Ley de la Eutanasia y la Ley del aborto libre.
responses.translated_justification: We will defend the right to life from conception until natural death and put an end to the culture of death. To accomplish this, we will start by repealing the Euthanasia Law and the Abortion on Demand Law.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: Inmediata expulsión de todos los inmigrantes que accedan ilegalmente a nuestro país.
responses.translated_justification: Immediate expulsion of all immigrants who enter our country illegally.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: Eliminación de toda legislación de género y que establezca diferencias laborales entre españoles atendiendo a su sexo, raza u orientación o identidad sexual, tales como cuotas, preferencia en la contratación o prevalencia en caso de empate en una oposición.
responses.translated_justification: Elimination of all gender legislation and any that establishes labor differences among Spaniards based on their sex, race or sexual orientation or identity, such as quotas, preference in hiring, or preference in case of a tie in a competitive examination.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: Terminaremos con las medidas injustas que impiden a los españoles desplazarse en el medio de transporte que libremente elijan por no contar con los recursos económicos suficientes para adquirir un vehículo propulsado por las fuentes de energía que más interesan y que imponen las agendas globalistas.
responses.translated_justification: We will put an end to the unjust measures that prevent Spaniards from moving around in the means of transport of their free choice because they do not have the sufficient economic resources to acquire a vehicle powered by the energy sources that are of most interest and that are imposed by the globalist agendas.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification: Supresión de los impuestos que pesan sobre la factura de la luz y que fueron establecidos por los sucesivos gobiernos del bipartidismo que asumieron los costes del desarrollo de las energías renovables, costes que siguen pagando los españoles con la factura más cara de la historia.
responses.translated_justification: Elimination of the taxes weighing on the electricity bill, which were established by the successive governments of the bipartisan system that assumed the costs of the development of renewable energies, costs that are still being paid by the Spaniards with the most expensive bill in history.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: La Unión Europea debe respetar la soberanía nacional de los Estados miembros singularizada en sus Parlamentos. Impulsaremos un nuevo tratado europeo que devuelva a los Estados miembros el protagonismo frente a la burocracia de una Comisión Europea que nadie elige y a la que nadie puede fiscalizar.
responses.translated_justification: The European Union must respect the national sovereignty of its Member States, which is embodied in their Parliaments. We will promote a new European treaty that returns the leading role to the Member States in the face of the bureaucracy of a European Commission that is not elected by anyone and cannot be held accountable by anyone.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: La Unión Europea debe estar al servicio de los Estados miembros y de los ciudadanos, no de sus élites. Rechazaremos cualquier tendencia federalista de la Unión Europea.
responses.translated_justification: The European Union should be at the service of the member states and of the citizens, not of its elites. We will reject any federalist trend of the European Union.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: Inteligencia artificial | Víctor Sánchez: ‘¡Imaginen si la dotamos de una ausencia de normas!’. Ha señalado que «cuando hicimos una intervención en el Pleno sobre el tema del 5G, cuando un servidor mencionó China como un potencial riesgo, gritaron desde sus bancadas y me llamaron de todo». Sin embargo, ahora en esta PNL «ustedes dicen que China es un ejemplo que ha logrado un desarrollo en IA y lideraba esta nueva tecnología que ustedes definen como de riesgo».
responses.translated_justification: Artificial Intelligence | Víctor Sánchez: 'Imagine if we endowed it with a lack of rules!'. He pointed out that 'when we intervened in the Plenary session on the topic of 5G, when a server mentioned China as a potential risk, they shouted from their benches and called me all sorts of things'. However, in this PNL 'you all say that China is an example that has achieved development in AI and leads this new technology that you define as a risk'.". Víctor Sánchez's quote in Spanish contains idiomatic expressions and wordplay, making it difficult to capture the same style in English. However, I have tried to convey the meaning as faithfully as possible while maintaining readability. In the final part, I translated "ustedes
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: El lastre sobre esas variables producido por el consenso socialdemócrata se vio amortiguado por dos shocks de oferta positivos e irrepetibles: la incorporación al Mercado Común en 1986 y a la Unión Monetaria en 1999.
responses.translated_justification: The burden on those variables produced by the social-democratic consensus was cushioned by two positive and unrepeatable supply shocks: the incorporation into the Common Market in 1986 and into the Monetary Union in 1999.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: Exigiremos la recuperación y aplicación del principio de preferencia comunitaria como principio jurídico de alcance general y absoluto en todos aquellos acuerdos comerciales que nos afecten, así como medidas para combatir la competencia desleal de productos de terceros países.
responses.translated_justification: We will insist on the recovery and application of the principle of Community preference as a general and absolute legal principle in all commercial agreements that affect us, as well as measures to combat unfair competition from products from third countries.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: Abogaremos por la recuperación de la competencia exclusiva del Estado en lo que se refiere a relaciones internacionales.
responses.translated_justification: We will advocate for the recovery of the exclusive competence of the State in terms of international relations.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Defenderemos en el Consejo de la Unión una reforma completa de la política inmigratoria y de asilo de la Unión Europea.
responses.source:
https://www.voxespana.es/programa/programa-electoral-vox
Vox llevará a votación la próxima semana al Pleno del Congreso su plan para expulsar de inmediato a los inmigrantes que entren ilegalmente en España, eliminar subvenciones a organizaciones no gubernamentales que les atiende, y suspender la cooperación y las ayudas a países africanos de donde proceden. Se trata de una proposición no de ley de 19 puntos que Vox ha querido incluir en el orden del día del Pleno del próximo martes para su debate y votación en el hemiciclo. Su idea es "acabar con las políticas de efecto llamada" e "impulsar que todas las administraciones públicas trasladen el mensaje claro de que cualquier inmigrante que entre de manera ilegal en España nunca podrá regularizar su situación en nuestro país ni recibir ningún tipo de ayuda pública".
responses.translated_justification: We will defend a complete reform of the European Union's immigration and asylum policy in the Council of the Union.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: Reforzaremos la cooperación policial en materia de lucha contra el terrorismo.
responses.source:
https://www.voxespana.es/programa/programa-electoral-vox
Vox aseguró que “el islamismo ha declarado la guerra a Europa” y volvió a culpar al Ejecutivo de Pedro Sánchez de "no hacer nada para garantizar la seguridad”. Garriga denunció que “no se puede tolerar levantarse cada dos días con noticias de atentados o intentos de asesinato”, en clara referencia a lo ocurrido, por ejemplo, en Bruselas hace una semana cuando dos ciudadanos suecos fueron asesinados a tiros. Pero en Vox se muestran convencidos de agitar la bandera de la seguridad, seña de identidad de la mayor parte de los partidos de extrema derecha en Europa. “No podemos normalizar esa realidad, como tampoco podemos normalizar la avalancha de migrantes en nuestras costas, por más silencio mediático o intento de despiste”, continuó Garriga. “No podemos tolerar estas circunstancias y que el Gobierno no garantice la seguridad”, zanjó.
responses.translated_justification: We will strengthen law enforcement cooperation in the fight against terrorism.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: Un Mando Integrado de Gestión de las Fronteras salvaguardará la inviolabilidad del territorio nacional mediante la vigilancia, control e inspección de personas y mercancías extranjeras en el acceso a España por vía terrestre, marítima y aérea. Despliegue militar en las fronteras de Ceuta, Melilla y Canarias para garantizar la protección de esos territorios ante invasiones promocionadas desde estados vecinos u organizaciones internacionales.
responses.translated_justification: An Integrated Command for Border Management will safeguard the inviolability of the national territory through the surveillance, control, and inspection of foreign persons and goods entering Spain by land, sea, and air. Military deployment on the borders of Ceuta, Melilla, and Canarias to guarantee the protection of those territories against invasions promoted by neighboring states or international organizations.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Exigiremos el fin de la prohibición de fabricar coches de combustión a partir de 2035.
responses.translated_justification: We will demand an end to the ban on manufacturing gasoline/diesel cars from 2035.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: Hay que apoyar a Ucrania con todos nuestros medios, con toda la convicción, con toda la contundencia necesaria, con los medios económicos y militares que sean precisos, defensivos y ofensivos y con las sanciones más severas a la agresión criminal de Putin.
responses.translated_justification: We must support Ukraine with all our means, with all our conviction, with all the necessary forcefulness, with the necessary economic and military means, both defensive and offensive, and with the most severe sanctions against Putin's criminal aggression.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: La Unión Europea debe respetar la soberanía nacional de los Estados miembros singularizada en sus Parlamentos. Impulsaremos un nuevo tratado europeo que devuelva a los Estados miembros el protagonismo frente a la burocracia de una Comisión Europea que nadie elige y a la que nadie puede fiscalizar. La Unión Europea debe estar al servicio de los Estados miembros y de los ciudadanos, no de sus élites. Rechazaremos cualquier tendencia federalista de la Unión Europea.
responses.translated_justification: The European Union must respect the national sovereignty of its member states, which is embodied in their Parliaments. We will promote a new European treaty that returns the protagonism to the member states in front of the bureaucracy of a European Commission that no one chooses and that no one can hold accountable. The European Union must serve the member states and their citizens, not its elites. We will reject any federalist tendency of the European Union.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: Exigiremos que la adopción de acuerdos en el Consejo europeo y el Consejo de la UE garantice el pleno consentimiento de todos los Estados miembros, recuperando la regla de la unanimidad allí donde sea precisa para asegurar el respeto a la soberanía nacional.
responses.translated_justification: We will demand that the adoption of agreements in the European Council and the Council of the EU ensures the full consent of all the member states, recovering the rule of unanimity where necessary to ensure the respect of national sovereignty.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
responses.justification: Defenderemos la primacía de la Constitución sobre el Derecho europeo y, en general, del Derecho nacional en cuestiones que afecten el Bien Común de España y los intereses generales del Estado.
responses.translated_justification: We will defend the primacy of the Constitution over European law and, in general, over national law in matters that affect the Common Good of Spain and the general interests of the State.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law

responses.statement: European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: Aumentaremos la inversión en Defensa y aseguraremos sueldos dignos y ayudas a la movilidad geográfica y a la vivienda y alojamiento, que serán deducibles. Dotaremos adecuadamente los programas de modernización para las Fuerzas Armadas, impulsando el desarrollo y la contratación de servicios e industria nacional de Defensa en los ámbitos terrestre, naval, aeronáutico, espacial y de inteligencia.
responses.translated_justification: We will increase investment in Defense and ensure dignified salaries and mobility allowances, as well as housing and accommodation assistance, which will be deductible. We will adequately fund the modernization programs for the Armed Forces, promoting the development and contracting of national Defense services and industry in the terrestrial, naval, aerospace, spatial and intelligence fields.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: Incrementar la capacidad de recaudación del sistema fiscal: acercar paulatinamente la presión fiscal a las medias de los países del entorno.
responses.translated_justification: Increase the collection capacity of the fiscal system: gradually approach the tax pressure to the averages of the countries of the surrounding area.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification:
Programa de subvenciones masivo para el fomento de la contratación juvenil en sectores nuevos y estratégicos.
Plan de choque para atender adecuadamente a las personas desempleadas de larga duración. Planificaciones especializadas para atender a las comarcas con mayores tasas de desempleo así como impulsar Planes de Empleo municipales y comarcales.
responses.translated_justification: Massive grant program to promote youth employment in new and strategic sectors. Shock plan to adequately address long-term unemployed persons. Specialized planning to address the comaras with the highest unemployment rates, as well as to boost Municipal and Comarcal Employment Plans.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: Garantizar y aumentar la capacidad recaudatoria del sistema tributario, en cierto sentido de progresividad tributaria, de modo que en función de la capacidad económica y patrimonial paga proporcionalmente más a quien más tiene, para fortalecer un sistema de bienestar que asegure el acceso de toda la población a los beneficios y servicios sociales audiencias de calidad.
responses.translated_justification: Guarantee and increase the revenue-generating capacity of the tax system, in a sense of tax progressivity, so that in proportion to economic and patrimonial capacity, those who have more pay more, in order to strengthen a welfare system that ensures access for the entire population to quality social benefits and services.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: Incrementar la justicia del sistema tributario, promoviendo la función redistributiva de la renta y la riqueza y como elemento activo en la corrección de las desigualdades sociales.
responses.source:
https://www.bng.gal/media/bnggaliza/files/2024/01/24/24_bng_galegas_programa_goberno.pdf
EH Bildu pide un incremento de presión fiscal sobre las rentas más altas para apoyar el Impuesto a las Grandes Fortunas. El portavoz de EH Bildu en las Juntas Generales de Bizkaia, Iker Casanova, ha asegurado que el Impuesto de Grandes Fortunas propuesto por las tres diputaciones forales vascas "a día de hoy" no contaría con el apoyo de la coalición soberanista "si no sufre una modificación para que haya un incremento de la presión fiscal sobre las 17.000 personas con más patrimonio de este país".
responses.translated_justification: Increase the justice of the tax system, promoting the redistributive function of income and wealth and as an active element in correcting social inequalities.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: Pensiones dignas y sistema público garantizado: el sistema público de pensiones es perfectamente sostenible y su futuro es una cuestión de voluntad política, no de viabilidad económica.
responses.translated_justification: Dignified pensions and a guaranteed public system: The public pension system is perfectly sustainable, and its future is a matter of political will, not economic viability.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification: El lanzamiento de un programa de mediación por parte del IGVS que asegure la puesta en alquiler de viviendas particulares vacías a precios limitados.
responses.source:
https://www.bng.gal/media/bnggaliza/files/2024/01/24/24_bng_galegas_programa_goberno.pdf
Se creará una comercializadora pública para vender la energía renovable proveniente del sector público. A través de la misma, se ofrecerá energía a precios asequibles para garantizar una transición justa, prestando especial atención a las personas vulnerables.
responses.translated_justification: The launch of a mediation program by the IGVS that ensures the rental of vacant private housing at limited prices.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification: Impulso das asociacións LGTBI e estabelecemento dun diálogo continuo e estreito con elas para o tratamento das diversas necesidades do colectivo e elaboración de medidas lexislativas e campañas de concienciación e contra a discriminación. Facilitación de espazos públicos para as súas actividades.
responses.translated_justification: Promote LGTBI associations and establish a close and continuous dialogue with them for the treatment of the diverse needs of the community and the elaboration of legislative measures and awareness-raising campaigns against discrimination. Facilitate public spaces for their activities.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: Promover una regulación del cáñamo con fines industriales y el cannabis no psicoactivo que proteja a las personas que son cultivadoras, comercializadoras y usuarias.
responses.source:
https://static.esquerra.cat/uploads/20230905/e2023-programa.pdf
La Comisión de Agricultura en el Congreso debatirá este miércoles una proposición no de ley de Unidas Podemos, Esquerra Republicana y Bildu para pedir la regulación del cannabis no psicoactivo o cáñamo —aquel cuyo porcentaje de tetrahidrocannabinol (THC), la droga euforizante, es inferior a 1%—, con el fin de ofrecer seguridad jurídica a los productores y comercializadores.
responses.translated_justification: Promote regulation of industrial hemp and non-psychoactive cannabis that protects growers, sellers, and users.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification: Nuestro país es una tierra acogedora. Los gallegos hemos vivido a lo largo de la historia -y aún hoy- la emigración, por eso conocemos mejor que nadie el valor de la diversidad y la acogida.
responses.translated_justification: Our country is a welcoming land. The people of Galicia have experienced emigration throughout history, and even today, we understand the value of diversity and hospitality better than anyone else.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: Garantir para todas as galegas o dereito ao aborto na sanidade pública e no interior do territorio galego, independentemente da semana de xestación cumprindo con garantías a lei e de mellora na súa atención evitando situacións de violencia nos procedementos de interrupción voluntaria, terapéutica ou euxenésica do embarazo.
responses.translated_justification: Guaranteeing for all Galician women the right to abortion in the public health system and within the Galician territory, regardless of the gestational week, complying with guarantees of the law and improving its attention, avoiding situations of violence in the procedures of voluntary, therapeutic or eugenic interruption of pregnancy".
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: En 2022 llegaron a Galicia casi 40.000 personas procedentes de otras partes del mundo. Gracias a la inmigración, la sociedad gallega es hoy más diversa que nunca.
responses.source:
https://www.bng.gal/media/bnggaliza/files/2024/01/24/24_bng_galegas_programa_goberno.pdf
Euskal Herria es una tierra que alberga diferentes orígenes y culturas, y esta realidad multicultural conlleva numerosos cambios sociales. Los desplazamientos forzosos que se están provocando en los países de la periferia meridional como consecuencia del capitalismo globalizado nos llevan a validar como derecho aquel derecho que toda persona tiene para el libre tránsito, así como a proclamar el derecho que toda persona tiene a vivir de manera digna en su lugar de origen.
responses.translated_justification: In 2022, nearly 40,000 people arrived in Galicia from other parts of the world. Thanks to immigration, Galician society is today more diverse than ever.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: Introdución de medidas específicas para garantir a promoción e acceso de mulleres a postos de responsabilidade e toma de decisións. estabelecemento de cotas (50:50) en postos de toma de decisións para promover o acceso das mulleres a postos de liderado e dirección.
responses.translated_justification: Introduction of specific measures to ensure the promotion and access of women to positions of responsibility and decision-making. Establishment of quotas (50:50) in decision-making positions to promote women's access to leadership and management positions.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: Establecer un sistema de tributación ambiental en las áreas de energía, transporte, contaminación y recursos naturales, cuyo propósito, más que recaudar ingresos, sea cambiar comportamientos que tienen un impacto negativo en el medio ambiente.
responses.translated_justification: Establish an environmental taxation system in the areas of energy, transportation, pollution, and natural resources, whose purpose, more than to collect revenues, is to change behaviors that have a negative impact on the environment.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification: Para hacer frente a la emergencia climática, tenemos que llevar a cabo una transición energética basada en cuatro pilares: consumir menos energía, ir dejando atrás los combustibles fósiles, promover una amplia y rápida difusión de las energías renovables y democratizar el ámbito energético, que en la actualidad se encuentra bajo el control de pocas manos.
responses.source:
https://www.bng.gal/media/bnggaliza/files/2023/07/05/23_bng_xerais_programa.pdf
Analizar las opciones existentes en la fiscalidad verde y dar pasos adelante, por ejemplo, desarrollando la tasa turística.
responses.translated_justification: To address the climate emergency, we must carry out an energy transition based on four pillars: consume less energy, gradually phase out fossil fuels, promote widespread and rapid dissemination of renewable energies, and democratize the energy sector, which is currently controlled by a few hands.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: Una gobernanza económica orientada a garantizar el estado del bienestar, con la superación del pacto de estabilidad actual mediante un pacto por la prosperidad inclusiva que, entre otros, incluya un plan europeo de inversiones públicas sociales y ecológicas financiadas por un presupuesto europeo reforzado.
responses.translated_justification: An economic governance aimed at ensuring the welfare state, with the overcoming of the current stability pact through a pact for inclusive prosperity which, among other things, includes a European plan for social and ecological public investments financed by a strengthened European budget.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: Una política fiscal europea que impedeixi la competència deslleial entre estats membres i una agència europea per combatre el frau fiscal transnacional i el blanqueig de capitals.
responses.translated_justification: A European fiscal policy that prevents unfair competition between member states and a European agency to combat transnational tax fraud and money laundering.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification:
No podemos olvidar que el mundo del empleo está inmerso en un profundo cambio a través de la robótica, la inteligencia artificial y la digitalización. El control de este cambio es imprescindible para llevar a cabo una transición ordenada a favor de los sectores populares, lejos de las estrategias que se han seguido hasta ahora y que han posibilitado que estos avances tecnológicos se utilicen al servicio del capitalismo neoliberal salvaje para aumentar la precariedad a cuenta de los beneficios de unos pocos.
Cada vez está siendo más exacerbado el empleo de dispositivos de control, vigilancia, sistemas de inteligencia artificial y algoritmos aplicados a funciones de seguridad. Herramientas que precisan de control público, garantía de su calidad y veracidad, así como protocolos claros sobre su empleo, tanto para la institución policial, como para garantizar los derechos fundamentales de la ciudadanía frente a ella.
responses.translated_justification: We cannot forget that the world of employment is immersed in a deep change through robotics, artificial intelligence, and digitalization. The control of this change is indispensable to carry out an orderly transition in favor of the popular sectors, far from the strategies that have been followed so far and that have made it possible for these technological advances to be used at the service of savage neoliberal capitalism to increase precariousness at the expense of the benefits of a few. The use of control devices, surveillance, artificial intelligence systems, and algorithms applied to security functions is becoming more and more exacerbated. Tools that require public control, guarantee of their quality and veracity, as well as clear protocols on their use, both for the police institution and to guarantee the fundamental rights of citizenship in front of it.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: La Unión Económica y Monetaria es y será inevitablemente ineficaz, salvo que la eurozona tenga una capacidad fiscal para reaccionar correctamente a los choques macroeconómicos y proporcione a las economías de sus Estados miembros más herramientas de estabilización.
responses.translated_justification: Economic and Monetary Union will inevitably be ineffective unless the eurozone has a fiscal capacity to respond correctly to macroeconomic shocks and provides its member states' economies with more stabilization tools.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: Galicia debe ser capaz de proteger su mercado alimentario interior, evitando la importación de productos que tiene capacidad de producir, y consolidando un modelo de producción agrícola basado en la proximidad, la reducción de intermediarios y la ruptura con el modelo implantado en la Organización Mundial del Comercio (OMC), fuertemente influenciada por las grandes multinacionales alimentarias y los mercados financieros.
responses.translated_justification: Galicia must be able to protect its internal food market, avoiding the importation of products that it has the capacity to produce, and consolidating a model of agricultural production based on proximity, reduction of intermediaries, and breaking away from the model implemented in the World Trade Organization (WTO), strongly influenced by large food multinationals and financial markets.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: En este escenario tan complejo, si pretendemos que nuestro pueblo sea soberano, es evidente que tenemos que entablar relaciones por todo el mundo y darnos a conocer. Si queremos tomar el lugar que nos corresponde en el mundo, sin olvidar nuestros intereses y lo limitado de nuestra capacidad, también debemos representar el papel que nos toca.
responses.translated_justification: In this complex scenario, if we aspire for our people to be sovereign, it is clear that we have to establish relationships around the world and make ourselves known. If we want to take our rightful place in the world, without forgetting our interests and the limited nature of our capacity, we also have to play the role that corresponds to us.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Velar por que la presidencia española del Consejo de la UE avance en el nuevo Pacto Europeo de Migración y Asilo, poniendo el foco en los derechos humanos, y en especial al derecho al refugio.
responses.source:
https://static.esquerra.cat/uploads/20230905/e2023-programa.pdf
Euskal Herria es una tierra que alberga diferentes orígenes y culturas, y esta realidad multicultural conlleva numerosos cambios sociales. Los desplazamientos forzosos que se están provocando en los países de la periferia meridional como consecuencia del capitalismo globalizado nos llevan a validar como derecho aquel derecho que toda persona tiene para el libre tránsito, así como a proclamar el derecho que toda persona tiene a vivir de manera digna en su lugar de origen.
responses.translated_justification: Ensure that the Spanish presidency of the Council of the EU moves forward with the new European Pact on Migration and Asylum, with a focus on human rights, and in particular the right to asylum.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: O BNG defenderá a derrogación da “Política Común de Defensa e Seguranza” da UE, así como o fin das misións militares no exterior do “euroexército”: Ucraína, Iraque, Malí, Libia, etc.
responses.translated_justification: BNG will defend the repeal of the "Common Defense and Security Policy" of the EU, as well as the end of the military missions outside of the "euroarmy": Ukraine, Iraq, Mali, Libya, etc.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: Renegociar los acuerdos de Schengen en favor de una acción decisiva en favor de nuevas políticas internacionales de migración y desarrollo. De la misma manera, oponernos rotundamente a cualquier reforma regresiva en materia de derechos y libertades individuales y civiles con la excusa de las amenazas antiterroristas.
responses.translated_justification: Renegotiate the Schengen agreements in favor of a decisive action in favor of new international migration and development policies. In the same way, we firmly oppose any regressive reform in matters of individual and civil rights with the excuse of the antiterrorist threats.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: La prohibició de venta de motors de combustió necessita, com a resposta, el desenvolupament d’una xarxa de punts de recàrrega de vehicles elèctrics, el desenvolupament i producció de bateries i també l’expansió d’una xarxa d’hidrogen verd pel transport pesant i pel transport públic.
responses.translated_justification: The prohibition of the sale of combustion engines requires, as a response, the development of a network of charging points for electric vehicles, the development and production of green batteries, and also the expansion of a green hydrogen network for heavy transport and public transport.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: Cese inmediato del envío de armas a Ucrania (que sólo puede contribuir a prolongar este conflicto) y refuerzo del envío de material humanitario.
responses.translated_justification: Immediate cessation of arms shipments to Ukraine (which can only contribute to prolonging this conflict) and reinforcement of humanitarian aid shipments.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: A soberanía das nacións en Europa, entre elas Galiza, é o xeito máis seguro para avanzar a un modelo de sociedade máis democrático, xusto e igualitario.
