responses.translated_justification: Sovereignty of nations in Europe, among them Galicia, is the safest way to move forward to a model of society that is more democratic, just and egalitarian.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: Es necesario eliminar el requisito de unanimidad para todas aquellas medidas orientadas a impedir, precisamente, que un Estado miembro pueda beneficiarse a costa de los demás; como ocurre hoy con los incentivos fiscales para atraer capital y empresas que, obteniendo rentas y beneficios en otros países, les acaban declarando donde menos tributan.
responses.translated_justification: It is necessary to eliminate the requirement of unanimity for all measures aimed at preventing, precisely, that a Member State can benefit at the expense of the others, as is the case today with fiscal incentives to attract capital and companies that, obtaining revenues and benefits in other countries, end up declaring where they pay the least in taxes.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power

responses.statement: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine
responses.justification: Unha neutralidade activa do Estado español na guerra de Ucraína e o apoio decidido ás iniciativas que busquen a paz mediante unha saída diplomática e negociada para este conflito.
responses.translated_justification: An active neutrality of the Spanish State in the Ukraine war and its decided support for initiatives seeking to achieve peace through a diplomatic and negotiated solution to this conflict.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should be enlarged to include Ukraine

responses.statement: The EU should sanction member states whose governments undermine the rule of law
European Union should increase military spending
responses.justification: Cancelar el compromiso del gobierno español de incrementar el gasto militar hasta alcanzar el 2% del PIB estatal, para que estos fondos se destinen al incremento de diferentes partidas de gasto social.
responses.translated_justification: Cancel the commitment of the Spanish government to increase military spending to reach 2% of the national GDP, so that these funds are allocated to increase different social welfare expenses.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European Union should increase military spending

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: Aumento de la inversión en atención a la dependencia, la vida plena, y su intensidad protectora, financiando con cargo a impuestos los cuidados ofrecidos por el sistema. En los últimos tres años, la aportación de la Administración General del Estado a la financiación del sistema ha pasado de apenas el 15% a cerca del 30%.
responses.translated_justification: Increase in investment in care for dependency, full life, and its protective intensity, financing with taxes the care offered by the system. In the last three years, the contribution of the General State Administration to the financing of the system has gone from just around 15% to nearly 30%.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification:
Proponemos establecer de forma permanente un mecanismo que permita financiar en mejores condiciones las políticas necesarias para hacer frente a este tipo de perturbaciones, incluyendo el posible establecimiento de un sistema europeo de aseguramiento frente al desempleo. Ademas de reconfigurar las prestaciones no contributivas, incluidas las de desempleo, con el fin de simplificar y garantizar la protección a todas las personas que lo necesiten.
El Ingreso Mínimo Vital (IMV) ha sido un avance muy importante y vamos a conseguir que sea una verdadera garantía de ingreso para toda la ciudadanía. Para ello es necesario realizar mejoras como incluir a las personas jóvenes de entre 18 y 23 años como potenciales beneficiarios de la prestación y garantizar que las menores de 30 años puedan acceder al IMV con los mismos requisitos que se exigen al resto de población adulta. La cobertura del IMV se debe ampliar a personas migrantes en situación irregular, con especial énfasis en aquellas familias migrantes con hijos a su cargo. En general, debe asegurarse la protección de todas las personas y familias con bajos ingresos.
responses.translated_justification: We propose to establish a permanent mechanism that allows for the better financing of the necessary policies to address this type of disruption, including the possible establishment of a European unemployment insurance system. Additionally, we propose to reconfigure non-contributory benefits, including unemployment, with the aim of simplifying and guaranteeing protection to all those who need it. The Minimum Living Income (IMV) has been a very important advance, and we will ensure that it becomes a true income guarantee for all citizenship. To achieve this, improvements are necessary such as including young people aged between 18 and 23 years as potential beneficiaries of the benefit and ensuring that women under 30 years of age can access the IMV with the same requirements as the rest of the adult population. The coverage of the IMV should be expanded to include undocumented migrants, with special emphasis on those migrant families with children in their care. In general, the protection of all persons and low-income families must be ensured.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: Es necesario reformar la ley en vigor, diseñada para institucionalizar la austeridad en España. Lo que se necesita, al contrario, es hacer compatible la sostenibilidad de las finanzas públicas y la estabilidad de la deuda con la inversión y el papel proactivo que debe tener la política fiscal para abordar las transiciones ecológica y digital e impulsar el pleno empleo. La experiencia de la última década pone de manifiesto que los efectos negativos sobre el crecimiento de los recortes de gasto acaban siendo contraproducentes para la estabilidad fiscal, que la política fiscal debe aplicarse con flexibilidad para adaptarse a las circunstancias, y que los efectos positivos de la inversión pública son la mejor fórmula para una reducción progresiva de las ratios de deuda.
responses.translated_justification: It is necessary to reform the current law, designed to institutionalize austerity in Spain. What is needed, on the contrary, is to make the sustainability of public finances and the stability of debt compatible with investment and the proactive role that fiscal policy should have to address the ecological and digital transitions and promote full employment. The experience of the last decade shows that the negative effects on growth of spending cuts are ultimately counterproductive for fiscal stability, that fiscal policy should be applied flexibly to adapt to circumstances, and that the positive effects of public investment are the best formula for a progressive reduction of debt ratios.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: Democratizar la economía es también reequilibrar la balanza fiscal mediante un sistema fiscal justo y progresivo, en el que aporten más quienes más tienen y menos impuestos pagan en la actualidad.
responses.translated_justification: To democratize the economy is also to rebalance the fiscal balance through a fair and progressive tax system, where those who have more contribute more and fewer taxes are paid in the current situation.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: Yolanda Díaz advierte al PSOE: "Sumar no permitirá que se alargue la edad de jubilación"
responses.translated_justification: Yolanda Díaz warns the PSOE: 'Sumar will not allow the retirement age to be extended'
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification:
- Establecer una cesta de la compra básica a precios asequibles, variada y de calidad, que permita el acceso de todas las familias a bienes esenciales y, a la vez, contribuya al objetivo de contención de la inflación. Existen ya algunas experiencias internacionales en este sentido, que requieren el impulso político necesario y el liderazgo impulsado desde el Gobierno. 1. Impulsaremos la firma de un gran pacto de rentas por la estabilidad de precios. Tanto el comportamiento salarial hasta el momento, como la firma del AENC, garantizan que el origen de las tensiones inflacionistas no se encuentra en los salarios y su crecimiento.
- La firma de un gran pacto de rentas por la estabilidad de precios debe tener como objetivo acordar un reparto adecuado de las implicaciones del encarecimiento de los precios de importación y cortar los efectos de segunda ronda. Existe margen suficiente para que los salarios recuperen el poder adquisitivo perdido en 2022 sin afectar a los precios finales.
responses.translated_justification: - Establishing a basic shopping basket with affordable, varied, and high-quality prices, which allows all families to access essential goods and, at the same time, contributes to the objective of containing inflation. There are already some international experiences in this regard, which require the necessary political impulse and leadership driven from the Government. 1. We will promote the signing of a great pay pact for price stability. The wage behavior so far, as well as the signing of the AENC, guarantee that the origin of inflationary pressures is not in wages and their growth. - The signing of a great pay pact for price stability should aim to agree on an appropriate distribution of the implications of the rising prices of imports and cut off the effects of the second round. There is sufficient margin for wages to recover the purchasing power lost in 2022 without affecting final prices.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification:
- Familias diversas pero iguales en derechos. Favorecer el reconocimiento, el respeto y el trato legal y social en condiciones de igualdad de los diversos modelos de familia y convivencia que ya son una realidad para muchas familias LGTBI+.
- Examinar el concepto jurídico de «familia» para que incorpore otros tipos de relaciones no recogidas en la noción de matrimonio (convivientes, cuidadores y cuidadoras). Trabajar para que sean legalmente posibles las paternidades y maternidades diversas.
responses.translated_justification: - Diverse but equal families in rights. Promote the recognition, respect, and legal and social treatment in conditions of equality of the various family and cohabitation models that are already a reality for many LGTBI+ families. - Examine the legal concept of 'family' so that it includes other types of relationships not included in the notion of marriage (cohabitants, caregivers). Work so that diverse paternities and maternities become legally possible.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: Se legislará para acabar con el vacío legal existente, despenalizando la producción y el consumo propio y sin ánimo de lucro para no favorecer a las mafias que se enriquecen con el tráfico ilegal, y se fomentará la información sobre los efectos del consumo de drogas para un consumo responsable y libre. Legalizaremos el uso del cannabis con fines medicinales. El cannabis se regulará íntegramente en el nuevo contexto nacional e internacional, desde planteamientos respetuosos con los derechos humanos, la evidencia científica, la realidad social, la salud individual y colectiva y la necesaria protección de las personas en situación de vulnerabilidad.
responses.translated_justification: Legislation will be enacted to end the existing legal vacuum, decriminalizing the production and personal, non-profit consumption in order not to favor mafias that enrich themselves with illegal trafficking, and will promote information on the effects of drug consumption for responsible and free consumption. We will legalize the use of cannabis for medicinal purposes. Cannabis will be fully regulated in the new national and international context, with a respectful approach towards human rights, scientific evidence, social reality, individual and collective health, and the necessary protection of vulnerable individuals.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification:
Impulsaremos una ley integral contra el racismo, cuyo objetivo sea prevenir y, en su caso, denunciar, sancionar y reparar la discriminación racial, el racismo institucional y estructural, y las formas conexas de intolerancia en aras del fomento de la igualdad y la justicia racial.
Promover la participación política de las personas migrantes en los diferentes procesos electorales.
responses.translated_justification: We will promote a comprehensive law against racism, whose objective is to prevent and, where appropriate, denounce, sanction and repair racial discrimination, institutional and structural racism, and related forms of intolerance, in order to promote racial equality and justice. Promote the political participation of migrant persons in different electoral processes.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: Declaraciones de Yolanda Díaz, líder de Sumar: "no lo fue fácil para el movimiento feminista cuando las mujeres pelearon por el derecho a voto no lo fue cuando las mujeres pelearon para conseguir el derecho al divorcio nunca lo fue cuando las mujeres empezaron a pelear en favor del derecho al aborto quiero hoy aquí recordar a todas las profesionales que lo hicieron en la clandestinidad a todas aquellas también parteras que lo hacían con lágrimas en los ojos y hoy nos debemos a ellas y a ellos Hoy estamos agradecidas por lo que han hecho en nuestro país y ahora como ha hecho nuestra querida portavoz Ay naval querida Melanie queremos ser como las mujeres francesas queremos que sí que la libertad de ser madres o no que la libertad también alcance un derecho constitucional que se llama la Constitución Gracias por el trabajo que habéis llevado"
responses.translated_justification: Statements by Yolanda Díaz, leader of Sumar: “It was not easy for the feminist movement when women fought for the right to vote, it was not when they fought for the right to divorce, it was never easy when women began to fight for the right to abortion. I want to remember today all the professionals who did it in clandestinity, all those women who did it with tears in their eyes. We owe it to them and to them. Today, we are grateful for what they have done in our country. And now, as our beloved spokeswoman Ay naval, beloved Melanie, have done, we want to be like French women, we want the freedom to be mothers or not, for this freedom to also reach a constitutional right that is called the Constitution. Thank you for the work you have carried out.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: Con ánimo de reducir o evitar en la medida de lo posible las migraciones internacionales irregulares, inseguras para los migrantes, se desarrollará el artículo 38 de la Ley de Asilo y se establecerá un procedimiento para atender los casos que se presenten fuera del territorio estatal. En el futuro procedimiento, los consulados y las embajadas de España recibirán las solicitudes de manera presencial o virtual y garantizarán el acceso físico a la representación diplomática o habilitarán un espacio seguro para atender a las personas solicitantes. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores, Unión Europea y Cooperación facilitará el traslado a España de las personas a las que se otorgue protección o de las que se autorice su traslado durante la tramitación del procedimiento.
responses.translated_justification: With the aim of reducing or avoiding, to the greatest extent possible, irregular and unsafe international migrations, Article 38 of the Asylum Law will be developed and a procedure will be established to address cases that arise outside of the national territory. In the future procedure, consulates and embassies of Spain will receive applications in person or virtually and will guarantee physical access to the diplomatic representation or will enable a safe space to attend to applicants. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union, and Cooperation will facilitate the transfer to Spain of those who are granted protection or those who are authorized to be transferred during the processing of the procedure.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: Sumar se dotó este sábado en su asamblea fundacional de un Plan Estratégico Feminista que se compromete, entre otras cosas, a la paridad de sexos en sus listas electorales, sus órganos de dirección y en la contratación de personal para equipos a todos los niveles.
responses.translated_justification: Sumar was endowed this Saturday in its founding assembly with a Feminist Strategic Plan that commits itself, among other things, to gender parity in its electoral lists, its direction bodies, and in the hiring of personnel at all levels.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: Apostamos por priorizar el transporte colectivo y el de propulsión humana para desplazamientos personales y la electromovilidad en el transporte de pasajeros y de mercancías por carretera, con criterios de transición justa, y para impulsar la descarbonización del transporte aéreo y marítimo. Para ello impulsaremos exenciones y penalizaciones fiscales con criterios de progresividad que sirvan para consolidar los sectores motores de la transición ecológica justa (energías renovables y autoconsumo, alimentación ecológica, rehabilitación energética, bombas de calor, vehículos eléctricos, sistemas de gestión y agregación de la demanda) y desincentivar comportamientos de consumo que hemos de sustituir o moderar (bienes y servicios vinculados a los combustibles fósiles, la aviación de corta y media distancia en la Península, la ganadería intensiva o los productos de un solo uso).
responses.translated_justification: We bet on prioritizing collective and human-propelled transportation for personal travel and electromobility in road passenger and freight transport, with criteria of a fair transition. We will also promote the decarbonization of air and maritime transport. To do this, we will boost tax exemptions and penalties with progressive criteria to consolidate the driving sectors of the fair ecological transition (renewable energies and self-consumption, organic food, energy rehabilitation, heat pumps, electric vehicles, demand management, and aggregation systems) and discourage consumption behaviors that we must replace or moderate (goods and services related to fossil fuels, short and medium-haul aviation in the Peninsula, intensive livestock or single-use products).
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification:
Incrementar la ambición de la Ley de Cambio Climático y Transición Energética. Modificar la Ley de Cambio Climático y Transición Energética para aumentar su ambición marcándose estos objetivos:
● 55% de reducción de emisiones en 2030.
● 50% de electrificación de la demanda total de energía en 2030.
● 55% de mejora de la eficiencia en el uso final de la energía.
● 90% de energía renovable en la generación de electricidad en 2030.
● Emisiones netas nulas en 2040.
responses.translated_justification: Increase the ambition of the Climate Change and Energy Transition Law. Modify the Climate Change and Energy Transition Law to increase its ambition by setting these objectives: • 55% reduction of emissions in 2030. • 50% of energy electrification of the total energy demand in 2030. • 55% improvement in energy efficiency in final energy use. • 90% of renewable energy in electricity generation in 2030. • Net zero emissions in 2040.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: Promoveremos una reforma más ambiciosa de las reglas fiscales europeas para abandonar definitivamente la austeridad y hacer de la inversión pública un elemento fundamental. Del mismo modo, deben reforzarse las políticas públicas y la capacidad de estabilización de las políticas fiscales. Las reglas no deben imponer requisitos uniformes de reducción del déficit y la deuda a corto plazo, sino centrarse en planes nacionales a medio plazo que garanticen unas finanzas públicas sostenibles mediante un crecimiento suficiente. Igualmente, la política fiscal y la inversión pública no pueden estar condicionadas por el mantenimiento de los límites arbitrarios del 3% de déficit y el 60% de deuda pública, que no tienen ningún fundamento económico. La reforma de las reglas fiscales debe aprovecharse también para abrir un debate sobre las funciones del Banco Central Europeo, en la línea del mandato dual de la Reserva Federal, y partiendo tanto de la experiencia positiva que ha supuesto su apoyo a la implementación de las políticas públicas durante la pandemia como del efecto negativo de las últimas subidas del tipo de interés.
responses.translated_justification: We will promote a more ambitious reform of the European fiscal rules to definitively abandon austerity and make public investment a fundamental element. Likewise, public policies and the stabilization capacity of fiscal policies must be strengthened. The rules should not impose uniform requirements for reducing the deficit and debt in the short term, but should focus on national medium-term plans that guarantee sustainable public finances through sufficient growth. Similarly, fiscal policy and public investment cannot be subject to the maintenance of arbitrary limits of a 3% deficit and a 60% public debt, which have no economic basis. The reform of fiscal rules should also be used to open a debate on the functions of the European Central Bank, in line with the dual mandate of the Federal Reserve, starting from the positive experience of its support for the implementation of public policies during the pandemic, as well as from the negative effect of the last interest rate hikes.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: Sumar defiende que la "necesidad de regular" la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) es "imperante debido al daño potencial que un mal uso de la misma puede ocasionar en grupos que resultan especialmente vulnerables a sus repercusiones, como lo son los menores y las mujeres".
responses.translated_justification: Sumar argues that the 'need to regulate' Artificial Intelligence (AI) is 'imperative due to the potential damage that improper use of it can cause in groups that are particularly vulnerable to its effects, such as minors and women'.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: La ruptura de las cadenas de producción y de algunos suministros durante la pandemia, en el momento de abrirse las restricciones y tras la invasión de Ucrania, pone de manifiesto los riesgos que supone ignorar este principio en la especialización de nuestro aparato productivo. Especialmente, en presencia de riesgos tan importantes como el cambio climático, se considerará fomentar la soberanía agroalimentaria nacional, por su papel fundamental en la economía del sector agroalimentario español y sus singulares ventajas comparativas.
responses.translated_justification: The disruption of production chains and some supplies during the pandemic, at the moment of lifting restrictions and after the invasion of Ukraine, highlights the risks of ignoring this principle in the specialization of our productive apparatus. Especially, in the presence of such important risks as climate change, the promotion of national food sovereignty will be considered, due to its fundamental role in the Spanish agri-food economy and its unique comparative advantages.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice
responses.justification: Es hora de construir una Europa con voz propia en el planeta, una Europa más democrática, feminista y comprometida con la justicia social, que expanda el destello de lucidez de la gestión expansiva de la pandemia y entierre de una vez los dogmas neoliberales y las lógicas de explotación y abuso que durante demasiado tiempo han regido su relación con las otras regiones del planeta.
responses.translated_justification: It is time to build a Europe with its own voice in the world, a more democratic, feminist, and committed to social justice Europe. It should expand the brilliance of lucidity of the management of the pandemic and bury once and for all neoliberal dogmas and the logic of exploitation and abuse that for too long have governed its relationship with the other regions of the planet.
responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Con ánimo de reducir o evitar en la medida de lo posible las migraciones internacionales irregulares, inseguras para los migrantes, se desarrollará el artículo 38 de la Ley de Asilo y se establecerá un procedimiento para atender los casos que se presenten fuera del territorio estatal. En el futuro procedimiento, los consulados y las embajadas de España recibirán las solicitudes de manera presencial o virtual y garantizarán el acceso físico a la representación diplomática o habilitarán un espacio seguro para atender a las personas solicitantes. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores, Unión Europea y Cooperación facilitará el traslado a España de las personas a las que se otorgue protección o de las que se autorice su traslado durante la tramitación del procedimiento.
responses.translated_justification: With the aim of reducing or avoiding, to the extent possible, irregular and unsafe international migrations, article 38 of the Asylum Law will be developed, and a procedure will be established to address cases that arise outside the national territory. In this future procedure, Spanish consulates and embassies will receive applications in person or virtually and will ensure physical access to the diplomatic representation or will enable a safe space to attend to applicants. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation will facilitate the transfer to Spain of those who are granted protection or of those who are authorized to be transferred during the procedure processing.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification:
● Lideraremos los esfuerzos internacionales destinados a abolir las armas nucleares, impulsando la ratificación del Tratado sobre la Prohibición de Armas Nucleares y reforzando la aplicación de los diferentes instrumentos relativos a la reducción y no proliferación. 
● Promoveremos la revisión y auditoría de los Programas Especiales de Armamento y otros gastos asociados a planes de defensa con el fin de dotarlos de mayor transparencia.
● Revisaremos en profundidad la política de exportación de armamento, tanto a nivel estatal como europeo, para prohibir la venta de armas a países que vulneren los derechos humanos, y aseguraremos la plena aplicación del Tratado sobre el Comercio de Armas.
● Impulsaremos una educación para la paz y la no violencia como un aspecto transversal de la acción gubernamental, en la línea establecida por la Resolución 53/243 de la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas.
responses.translated_justification: ● We will lead international efforts aimed at abolishing nuclear weapons, promoting the ratification of the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons and strengthening the implementation of various instruments related to reduction and non-proliferation. ● We will promote the review and audit of Special Weapons Programs and other associated defense plans with the aim of increasing transparency. ● We will thoroughly review the policy of arms export, both at state level and European, in order to prohibit the sale of arms to countries that violate human rights, and we will ensure the full application of the Arms Trade Treaty. ● We will promote an education for peace and non-violence as a cross-cutting aspect of governmental action, in line with Resolution 53/243 of the General Assembly of the United Nations.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: Promoveremos la transformación del espacio de libertad, seguridad y justicia en la Europa de las personas, para privilegiar el respeto de los derechos fundamentales. Un programa internacional. España, potencia de paz y progreso Una política exterior para cuidar la democracia y el planeta de la ciudadanía europea como de los de terceros países, frente a la securitización de la inmigración, el asilo y el control fronterizo.
responses.translated_justification: We will promote the transformation of the space of freedom, security, and justice in the Europe of citizens, in order to prioritize the respect of fundamental rights. An international program. Spain, a power of peace and progress. A foreign policy to care for the democracy and the planet of both European and third-country citizens, facing the securitization of immigration, asylum, and border control.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Implementaremos un plan nacional de transición energética, para reducir drásticamente las emisiones de CO2, reducir la dependencia externa de los combustibles fósiles, democratizar el sistema de producción y distribución energética y abaratar los precios de la energía. Ley de Financiación del Transporte Colectivo, Público o de Bajas Emisiones, para avanzar en una movilidad sostenible que reduzca el uso del vehículo privado (especialmente en las ciudades) y siga desarrollando la electrificación del parque móvil, con el objetivo de que en 2040 no circulen en España vehículos con motores de combustión interna.
responses.translated_justification: We will implement a national energy transition plan, with the purpose of drastically reducing CO2 emissions, reducing external dependency on fossil fuels, democratizing the energy production and distribution system, and lowering energy prices. Public Transport Financing Law, focused on promoting sustainable mobility that reduces the use of private vehicles (especially in cities) and continues to develop the electrification of the vehicle fleet, with the aim that by 2040, no combustion engine vehicles circulate in Spain.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: Continuaremos con la solidaridad integral con Ucrania y fortaleceremos la vía diplomática para lograr, cuando las circunstancias lo permitan, una paz justa y duradera alineada con las aspiraciones del pueblo ucraniano y con las resoluciones de la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas.
responses.translated_justification: We will continue with comprehensive solidarity with Ukraine and will strengthen the diplomatic channel in order to achieve, when circumstances allow, a just and lasting peace aligned with the aspirations of the Ukrainian people and with the resolutions of the United Nations General Assembly.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes
responses.justification: Aumento global del presupuesto en sanidad pública, así como de los recursos humanos, para alcanzar en el conjunto de los territorios una financiación sobre el PIB y una ratio de profesionales por habitante equiparables a la media europea.
responses.translated_justification: A global increase in the public health budget, as well as human resources, in order to achieve in all territories a financing on the GDP and a ratio of professionals per inhabitant comparable to the European average.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Social programs should be maintained even at the cost of higher taxes

responses.statement: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers
responses.justification: Desde Podemos hemos propuesto una nueva Renta Garantizada de ámbito estatal para superar los importantes problemas encontrados con el Ingreso Mínimo Vital.
responses.translated_justification: From Podemos, we have proposed a new Guaranteed Income of national scope to overcome the significant problems found with the Minimum Living Income.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should provide stronger financial support to unemployed workers

responses.statement: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes
responses.justification: El Acuerdo de Coalición establecía una estrategia para reforzar las inversiones que nuestro país necesita de cara a hacer frente al cambio climático, para impulsar la digitalización y la modernización del tejido productivo, para reforzar la I+D y también para desarrollar nuevas políticas que reorganicen las tareas de cuidados. No obstante, ninguno de estos retos es sostenible en el medio plazo si España no cuenta con una estructura fiscal y tributaria similar a la que tienen los países de nuestro entorno. Poder tener un Estado de Bienestar como los países más avanzados de Europa requiere tener también un sistema tributario similar al de estos países.
responses.translated_justification: The Coalition Agreement established a strategy to strengthen the investments that our country needs to address climate change, to boost digitalization and the modernization of the productive fabric, to strengthen R&D and also to develop new policies that reorganize care tasks. However, none of these challenges are sustainable in the medium term if Spain does not have a fiscal and tax structure similar to that of the countries in our environment. Having a Welfare State like the most advanced European countries requires having a tax system similar to that of these countries.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Government spending should be reduced in order to lower taxes

responses.statement: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased
responses.justification: Existen algunas tipologías fiscales que se pueden mejorar para aumentar la progresividad, para hacer que paguen los que más tienen y para mejorar los ingresos públicos.
responses.translated_justification: There are some tax classifications that can be improved to increase progressivity, so that those who have more pay, and to improve public revenues.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Taxation on the wealthiest part of the population should be increased

responses.statement: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable
responses.justification: El documento remitido por Podemos al PSOE también propone "aumentar la cuantía de las pensiones mínimas y no contributivas" mediante un incremento extraordinario del 20%. Y, asimismo, se plantea "avanzar en la eliminación de la brecha de género de las pensiones" evitando que las "lagunas de cotización" que tienen algunas mujeres que dejan de trabajar unos años para cuidar a familiares les perjudiquen en el "cálculo de la pensión final".
responses.translated_justification: The document sent by Podemos to the PSOE also proposes "to increase the amount of the minimum and non-contributory pensions
responses.statement_codebook_text: Retirement age should be raised in order to make the pension system more sustainable

responses.statement: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities
responses.justification:
La intervención pública en los mercados mediante entidades empresariales y de otro tipo no solamente permite ofrecer servicios más baratos a la ciudadanía poniendo en primer lugar el interés general, sino que, además, también sirve como una eficaz palanca pública para crear empleo de calidad.
Creación de supermercados públicos. En los últimos meses hemos visto como los grandes supermercados privados se hacen de oro mientras la cesta de la compra no para de subir. Esto es posible porque operan en situación de cuasi oligopolio, con un 40 % de la cuota de mercado en manos de tan solo tres empresas. La existencia de operadores públicos lo suficientemente potentes como para competir de tú a tú con los grandes supermercados privados haría, en términos coloquiales, que se les acabase el chollo, pudiendo ofrecer precios más bajos a las familias y condiciones laborales más dignas a los trabajadores y trabajadoras, así como mejores precios a los pequeños y medianos productores agrícolas y ganaderos locales.
responses.translated_justification: Public intervention in markets through business and other entities not only allows for the offer of more affordable services to citizens, placing the general interest first, but it also serves as an effective public lever for creating quality employment. Creation of public supermarkets. In recent months, we have seen how large private supermarkets are making a fortune while the shopping cart keeps rising. This is possible because they operate in a situation of quasi-oligopoly, with 40% of the market share in the hands of just three companies. The existence of public operators powerful enough to compete face to face with the large private supermarkets would, in colloquial terms, put an end to this favorable situation, allowing them to offer lower prices to families and more dignified conditions to workers, as well as better prices to small and medium local agricultural and livestock producers.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The state should intervene directly to control the rising prices of basic commodities

responses.statement: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing
responses.justification:
Garantía de seguridad a través de la sensibilización pública y la difusión de campañas a nivel municipal y regional respecto a la persecución de delitos de odio contra las personas LGTBI. Creación de la campaña «municipios seguros» para personas LGBTI, como reacción a lo sucedido en Polonia. // Fomento de contenidos y proyectos impulsados por personas LGTBI en promoción de la cultura y equipamientos culturales municipales.
Sensibilización y formación del personal de todos los servicios públicos municipales en materia de igualdad de trato, diversidad y no discriminación.
responses.translated_justification: Guarantee of security through public awareness-raising and dissemination of hate crime campaigns at the municipal and regional levels against LGTBI people. Creation of the "safe municipalities" campaign for LGTBI people, as a reaction to what happened in Poland. // Promotion of LGBTQI-led contents and projects in the promotion of cultural and municipal cultural facilities. Sensibilization and training of staff of all municipal public services on issues of equal treatment, diversity, and non-discrimination.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of same sex marriages is a good thing

responses.statement: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed
responses.justification: El pasado 19 de diciembre Podemos presentó, de nuevo tras hacerlo la pasada legislatura, otra proposición de ley. En el Ejecutivo hay voces que creen que puede haber margen para dar algún paso más allá del medicinal, según ha podido saber elDiario.es.
responses.translated_justification: Podemos presented, once again after doing so during the last legislature, another bill on December 19th. According to information gathered by elDiario.es, there are voices within the Executive that believe there may be room to take a step further than just the medicinal.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The legalisation of the personal use of soft drugs is to be welcomed

responses.statement: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values
responses.justification:
Consideración de los inmigrantes y refugiados como ciudadanos de pleno derecho. Adopción de políticas que apuesten por la integración, la igualdad de derechos y la convivencia.
Construiremos un Sistema Vasco de Acogida que se caracterice por [entre otras ítems y objetivos], garantizar el derecho de acceso al aprendizaje de las dos lenguas cooficiales de Euskadi (Fuente: programa electoral para las elecciones al Parlamento Vasco).
responses.translated_justification: Consideration of immigrants and refugees as full-right citizens. Adoption of policies betting on integration, equality of rights, and coexistence. We will build a Basque Reception System that is characterized by [among other items and objectives], guaranteeing the right of access to the learning of the two co-official languages of the Basque Country (Source: electoral program for the elections to the Basque Parliament).
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigrants from outside Europe should be required to accept our culture and values

responses.statement: Access to abortion should become more restricted
responses.justification: Garantía del derecho al aborto libre y gratuito en todas las comunidades autónomas mediante la implementación a nivel autonómico de los principales cambios introducidos en la Ley Orgánica 1/2023, como es garantizar el acceso a prácticas anticonceptivas, el acceso en centros públicos, el registro de objetores de conciencia o las medidas de coeducación.
responses.translated_justification: Guarantee of the right to free and gratuitous abortion in all the autonomous communities through the implementation at the autonomous level of the main changes introduced in Organic Law 1/2023, such as guaranteeing access to contraceptive practices, access in public centers, the registry of objectors of conscience or the coeducation measures.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Access to abortion should become more restricted

responses.statement: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive
responses.justification: Garantizar del acceso de todas las mujeres migrantes a todos los servicios públicos y derechos en materia de salud, vivienda, educación, conciliación y recursos especializados mediante la creación de una oficina específica de atención.
responses.translated_justification: Guaranteeing access to all public services and rights in terms of health, housing, education, reconciliation, and specialized resources for all migrant women through the creation of a specific office for attention.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Immigration into European Union should be made more restrictive

responses.statement: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed
responses.justification: Podemos quiere que la Ley de Paridad imponga cuotas también en el CGPJ y en el Constitucional [ademas de las cuotas ya existentes].
responses.translated_justification: We Can wants the Parity Law to impose quotas in the CGPJ and in the Constitutional Court [in addition to the existing quotas].
responses.statement_codebook_text: Gender quotas (e.g. a minimum share of positions to be filled by women) are to be welcomed

responses.statement: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)
responses.justification: La reforma que plantea Unidas Podemos reserva un espacio a la fiscalidad verde. Entre otras medidas, propone un incremento de 10 puntos porcentuales en el tipo impositivo de las empresas eléctricas en Sociedades durante al menos cinco años cuya recaudación se destine a abaratar los recibos de la luz. También plantea reformar el IRPF para establecer desgravaciones por el uso de abonos de transporte público y por la adquisición de electricidad 100% renovable.
responses.translated_justification: The reform proposed by Unidas Podemos reserves a space for green taxation. Among other measures, it proposes an increase of 10 percentage points in the corporate tax rate for energy companies in Sociedades for at least five years, with the revenue going towards lowering electricity bills. It also proposes a reform to the IRPF to establish tax deductions for the use of public transport subscription and for the acquisition of 100% renewable electricity.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The promotion of public transport should be fostered through green taxes (e.g. road taxing)

responses.statement: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs
responses.justification: Inversión 100 % pública y municipal de placas fotovoltaicas y rehabilitación energética de viviendas en edificios y viviendas particulares de ingresos medios bajos, así como un plan de subvenciones para eliminar las instalaciones domésticas de gas natural.
responses.translated_justification: 100% public and municipal investment in photovoltaic panel installation and energy rehabilitation of homes in buildings and low-income individual residences, as well as a grant plan to eliminate domestic natural gas installations.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Renewable sources of energy (e.g. solar or wind energy) should be supported even if this means higher energy costs

responses.statement: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules
responses.justification: La agenda política europea sigue precisando de un mecanismo de desendeudamiento global, para lo cual se celebrará una Conferencia Europea de la Deuda. En ella, se impulsará un acuerdo para que el BCE reestructure y mutualice aquella parte de la deuda pública de todas las economías de la zona euro que exceda el 60 % del producto interior bruto (PIB).
responses.translated_justification: The European political agenda continues to require a global debt relief mechanism, for which a European Debt Conference will be held. During this conference, an agreement will be promoted so that the European Central Bank restructures and mutualizes that portion of the public debt of all the economies in the euro zone that exceeds 60% of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP).
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should rigorously punish member states that violate the EU deficit rules

responses.statement: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers
responses.justification: Impuesto europeo para operaciones de la economía digital. Se creará un impuesto europeo para las empresas digitales que grave en un 3 % su facturación, teniendo en cuenta el número de usuarios, y que suponga el pago de impuestos por los beneficios obtenidos en Europa en un porcentaje equivalente a la presencia que estas empresas tienen en el espacio digital europeo.
responses.translated_justification: European tax on digital economy operations. A European tax on digital companies will be created that will levy a 3% tax on their billing, taking into account the number of users, and that will imply the payment of taxes on the profits obtained in Europe in a percentage equivalent to the presence that these companies have in the European digital space.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should acquire its own tax raising powers

responses.statement: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation
responses.justification: Unidas Podemos ha registrado en el Congreso la primera proposición de ley orgánica para regular el mal uso de la inteligencia artificial y penar las vulneraciones al honor, la dignidad o la intimidad personal.
responses.translated_justification: Unidas Podemos has registered in Congress the first organic law proposal to regulate the misuse of artificial intelligence and to penalize violations of honor, dignity, or personal privacy.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should strenghten the regulation of Artificial Intelligence technology even if this means slowing down innovation

responses.statement: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing
responses.justification: Será una cámara formada por representantes de los distintos Parlamentos nacionales de acuerdo con criterios de población, de características territoriales y de pluralidad política. Contará con una verdadera capacidad legislativa y de control político, así como de debate y de decisión sobre la agenda política y económica de la zona euro, incluyendo nuevos pasos en los procesos de integración.
responses.translated_justification: It will be a chamber made up of representatives from the different national Parliaments in accordance with criteria of population, territorial characteristics, and political plurality. It will have real legislative and political control capacity, as well as for debate and decision-making on the political and economic agenda of the euro zone, including new steps in the integration processes.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The single European currency (Euro) is a bad thing

responses.statement: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices
responses.justification: El gobierno debería hacer cumplir la Ley de Cadena Alimentaria que logramos aprobar en el congreso, con mucho esfuerzo y trabajo de Podemos. Una Ley de Cadena Alimentaria que evita la venta a pérdidas. No tiene mucho sentido, como trasladan los agricultores, que estemos exigiéndole a la producción local una serie de criterios medioambientales y sanitarios muy exigentes, que son correctos y se tienen que mantener, mientras, a través de los acuerdos de libre comercio, les abrimos la puerta a productos de otros países que no cumplen con esa normativa.
responses.translated_justification: The government should enforce the Food Chain Law that we managed to approve in Congress with a lot of effort and work from Podemos. A Food Chain Law that prevents loss-leading sales. It doesn't make much sense, as farmers point out, that we are demanding that local production meets very demanding environmental and health criteria, which are correct and must be maintained, while, through free trade agreements, we open the door to products from other countries that do not meet that regulatory framework.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The EU should protect European farmers from external competition even if this leads to higher food prices

responses.statement_codebook_text: On foreign policy issues the EU should speak with one voice

responses.statement: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system
responses.justification: Para garantizar el derecho de asilo, Podemos también propone agilizar la tramitación de los procesos de reunificación familiar y fomentar el desarrollo de una política común de asilo en la Unión Europea. Las iniciativas proponen, además, aplicar el reglamento de Dublín III e instan a la Unión Europea a permitir que las personas refugiadas puedan elegir el país en el que van a ser ubicados (siempre que sea posible).
responses.translated_justification: In order to guarantee the right of asylum, Podemos also proposes to streamline the processing of family reunification procedures and promote the development of a common asylum policy in the European Union. The initiatives also propose to apply the Dublin III Regulation and urge the European Union to allow refugees to choose the country in which they will be located (as long as it is possible).
responses.statement_codebook_text: Asylum-seekers should be distributed proportionally among EU member states through a mandatory relocation system

responses.statement: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy
responses.justification: El gasto militar en España ha vuelto a abrir una grieta entre los socios de la coalición después de que el Consejo de Ministros aprobara un fondo especial de casi 1.000 millones de euros del Fondo de Contingencia para el Ministerio de Defensa. La ministra de Derechos Sociales y Agenda 2030 y secretaria general de Unidas Podemos (UP), Ione Belarra, expresó su rechazo y enumeró sus propuestas “de urgencia” para los presupuestos del próximo año, que “son diferentes al planteamiento que se ha hecho estos días de duplicar el gasto militar en España, que ya está por otra parte en niveles récord”, dijo durante un acto de partido (min. 15:18).
responses.translated_justification: Military spending in Spain has once again opened a divide among the partners of the coalition after the Council of Ministers approved a special fund of nearly 1.000 million euros from the Contingency Fund for the Ministry of Defense. The Minister of Social Rights and Agenda 2030, and general secretary of Unidas Podemos (UP), Ione Belarra, expressed her rejection and listed her "urgency
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should strengthen its security and defence policy

responses.statement: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders
responses.justification: Rechaza crear un salvamento marítimo público y refuerza el papel de FRONTEX, Agencia Europea de la Guardia de Fronteras y Costas, acusada en incontables ocasiones de violar los derechos de las personas migrantes y refugiadas.
responses.translated_justification: Rejects the creation of a public sea rescue and strengthens the role of FRONTEX, the European Border and Coast Guard Agency, which has been accused on numerous occasions of violating the rights of migrants and refugees.
responses.statement_codebook_text: To fight the problem of illegal immigration, the European Union should take responsibility in patrolling its borders

responses.statement: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035
responses.justification: Programa europeo de inversiones, cambios normativos y la adopción de las medidas necesarias para destinar un 2,5 % del PIB de la UE a una transición ecológica que enfrente el cambio climático, la reducción de ecosistemas y la desaparición de especies. Para ello, (1) se desarrollarán energías renovables y se implementarán medidas de eficiencia energética; (2) se electrificará el transporte y se promoverá una movilidad sostenible; (3) se establecerán objetivos de cierre de las centrales de carbón antes del final de 2025 (y siempre garantizando el uso de carbón nacional) y de las centrales nucleares antes del final de 2024, junto con la garantía de haber creado dos empleos por cada uno que pueda perderse y el impulso de la economía circular y de programas de adaptación al cambio climático; y (4) se impulsará la I+D+i para desarrollar estas iniciativas.
responses.translated_justification: European investment program, regulatory changes and the adoption of necessary measures to allocate 2.5% of the EU's GDP to an ecological transition that addresses climate change, the reduction of ecosystems and the disappearance of species. For this, (1) renewable energies will be developed and energy efficiency measures will be implemented; (2) transportation will be electrified and sustainable mobility will be promoted; (3) carbon power plant closure goals will be established before the end of 2025 (and always ensuring the use of national coal) and nuclear power plants before the end of 2024, with the guarantee of creating two jobs for each job that may be lost and the promotion of the circular economy and climate change adaptation programs; and (4) I+D+i will be boosted to develop these initiatives.
responses.statement_codebook_text: As planned in the European Green Deal, there should be a Europe-wide ban on selling internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035

responses.statement: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine
responses.justification: Podemos ha votado en contra del apoyo a la ayuda financiera y el envío de carros de combate y material militar, así como avalar todos los esfuerzos de los países de la OTAN y la UE para que Ucrania recupere sus fuerzas.
responses.translated_justification: We can have voted against the support for financial aid and the sending of battle tanks and military material, as well as endorsing all the efforts of the NATO and EU countries so that Ukraine recovers its forces.
responses.statement_codebook_text: The European Union should continue providing military aid, such as weapons and ammunition, to Ukraine

responses.statement: European integration is a good thing
responses.justification: Los programas del PSOE, PP y Sumar (incl. Podemos) comparten una defensa por una Unión más unida, autónoma y eficaz, y apuestan por políticas europeas comunes para en cuestiones como la migración, fiscalidad, energía. Fuente: Informe del Instituto Elcano.
responses.translated_justification: The programs of the PSOE, PP, and Sumar (including Podemos) share a defense of a more united, autonomous, and effective Union, and bet on common European policies in matters such as migration, taxation, and energy. Source: Elcano Royal Institute report.
responses.statement_codebook_text: European integration is a good thing

responses.statement: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
responses.justification: El marco político actual de la UE, basado en el Tratado de Lisboa, hace del neoliberalismo ley. Consolida un funcionamiento cerrado por el que los poderes centrales de la UE dirigen la economía y la sociedad de manera tecnocrática y priorizando los beneficios de unos pocos. Por eso, es necesario abrir un proceso de refundación de la UE que incluya la aprobación de un nuevo tratado capaz de superar la visión ideológicamente sesgada que rige en la actualidad e incorpore el principio democrático en todas sus instituciones.
responses.translated_justification: The current political framework of the EU, based on the Lisbon Treaty, makes neoliberalism the law. It consolidates a closed functioning where the central powers of the EU direct the economy and society in a technocratic manner, prioritizing the benefits of a few. Therefore, it is necessary to open a process of refoundation of the EU that includes the approval of a new treaty capable of overcoming the ideologically biased vision that governs today and incorporates the democratic principle in all its institutions.
responses.statement_codebook_text: Individual member states of the EU should have less veto power
